10015.1:
Today's Mission!! 
<Hunt in the mini dungeon and obtain #b1 Special Agent Badge#k!>
Today's mission is obtaining a #bSpecial Agent Badge#k.  According to rumors, the Special Agent Badge can be found in the mini dungeon...
I should go see Agent O whom Gaga introduced me to.  If I haven't been introduced to #bAgent O#k yet, I should first go see #bAgent Gaga#k.

10016.1:
오늘의 미션! 
<메모리칩을 지키고 #b우수요원 뱃지 1개#k를 획득하라!>

오늘의 미션은 #b우수요원 뱃지#k를 획득하는 것이다. 믿을 수 있는 정보원의 첩보에 따르면 #b요원W#k의 #bMS-07 작전#k의 임무수행을 도와주면 우수요원 뱃지를 받을 수 있다고 한다.

10017.1:
오늘의 미션!
<요원특별강화프로그램에 참여해서 #b50포인트#k를 얻어라!>#k

오늘의 미션은 요원특별강화프로그램에 참여해서 #b50포인트#k를 얻는 것이다. 요원특별강화프로그램은 #b요원 냥#k과 #b요원 냐옹#k이 특별 고안한 훈련 프로그램으로 가상공간에서 단계별로 나타나는 몬스터를 퇴치하는 훈련방법이다. 몬스터의 난이도에 따라서 #b포인트#k를 얻을 수 있다. 혼자서 참여할 수도 있고, 또는 파티단위로 참여할 수도 있다.
10017.name: 요원특별강화프로그램에 참여하라!

10018.1:
Today's Mission!!
<Earn #b50 points#k on the Speed Quiz!>

Today's mission is to get #b50 points#k from the Speed Quiz.  If you go see #bAgent Cassandra#k, you can take a speed quiz on the items and monsters of Maple World.  You get 1 point per question and the quiz can be taken once every 30 minutes.  You must earn a #btotal 50 points#k for today.
10018.name: Earn 50 points on the Speed Quiz!

10019.1:
Today's Mission!!
<Obtain #bChumji's Watermelon#k from the watermelon field!>

Today's mission is to obtain Chumji's watermelons.  There has been intelligence that #rMaster#k has planted a bomb in Chumji's watermelons.  Therefore, the watermelon field is currently being managed by the #bMaple Admin#k.  Get into the watermelon field through the Maple Admin and bring back the watermelons!
10019.name: Invade the Watermelon Field!

10020.1:
Today's Mission!!
<Complete Agent E's #bSpecial Operation Quest#k!> 

Agent E frequently assigns special operations to the agents to collect information on #bMaster M#k.  In order to receive a special operation from Agent E, go to Agent E who is in each town.

10053.2: 메이플 월드의 최초 모험자들과 함께 모험을 시작한 페리온의 만지를 찾아갔다. 만지는 자신의 이야기를 구차하게 말해주고 싶지 않다면서 #b자신의 오래된 일기장#k을 건내주었다.

10054.0: 메이플 운영자가 나를 위해서 해줄 말이 있다고 한다.
10054.1: 메이플 운영자의 조언대로 메이플 월드의 최초 모험자들과 함께 모험을 시작한 '불굴의 모험가'의 그윈씨 이야기를 직접 듣는 것이 좋겠다. 지원물품인 #b드레이크의 피#k를 1개 가지고, 빅토리아 중앙던전 어딘가에 있는 #b그윈씨를 찾아가자.#k
10054.2: 메이플 월드의 최초 모험자의 일원인 그윈은 아직도 그 모험을 멈출 줄 모른다. 그윈에게 지원물품인 드레이크의 피를 구해다 주고 그윈의 모험담을 얻었다.

10055.0: 메이플 운영자가 나를 위해서 해줄 말이 있다고 한다.
10055.1: 메이플 운영자의 조언대로 오시리아 대륙의 씩씩한 모험가 에릭손씨를 찾아가서 직접 듣는 것이 좋겠다. 오르비스에 있는 #b에릭손씨를 찾아가자.#k 선물로 그가 기르는 애완동물에게 줄 #b맛좋은 사료 1개#k를 들고 가는 것이 좋을 거라는 메이플 운영자의 충고도 잊지 말자.

10056.0: 카산드라가 나에게 할 이야기가 있다고 한다. 온 동네 소문에 밝은 카산드라가 이번에는 무슨 일일까?
10056.1: 카산드라는 무언가 재밌는 일이 없는지 항상 궁금한가보다. 이번에는 몬스터들이 주는 소소한 이야기들을 100개나 모아달라고 하는데 왜 그렇게 다른 사람들의 이야기에 관심이 많은걸까...
10056.2: 카산드라에게 소소한 이야기 100개를 모아다 주고 메이플 스카프를 얻었다. 이걸 목에 두르고 있으면 정말 따뜻하겠는걸~

He was begging me for it afterall... Wait a minute! Could it be that Gaga never gave up on his secret dream of becoming a pop star himself?

10065.0: 천조각 20개를 모아 루드밀아에게 줬다. 사진첩을 받아야 한다.

I ran into Pio who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. Pio tells me to break down scrap boxes from here and there in the village and bring back a #t4031161# and an #t4031162#. I think I saw some scrap boxes in the village...

#t4031162# #c4031162# / #r1#k
#t4031161# #c4031161# / #r1#k

10081.0: 곤란한 표정의 카산드라가 하고 싶은 이야기가 있어 보인다.
10081.1: 카산드라는 요즘 가가가 너무 기운이 없는 것 같다면서 재미가 하나도 없다고 투덜댄다. 그 동안 많이 골려 먹었지만, 요새처럼 기운이 하나도 없는 가가는 재미가 없다나? 가가가 기운을 차릴 수 있도록 행운의 부적으로 알려진 '행운의 흰 원숭이 인형'을 모아다 주라고 부탁하면서 절대로 가가에게 미안해서 그러는 것이 아니라고 강조했다.\n\n#i4032087# #t4032087# #b#c4032087# / 10
10081.2: 카산드라는 요즘 가가가 너무 기운이 없는 것 같다면서 재미가 하나도 없다고 투덜댄다. 그 동안 많이 곯려 먹었지만, 요새처럼 기운이 하나도 없는 가가는 재미가 없다나? 카산드라의 부탁으로 가가가 기운을 차릴 수 있도록 행운의 부적으로 알려진 '행운의 흰 원숭이 인형'을 모아서 가져다 주었다.\n카산드라는 절~대 가가에게 미안해서 그러는게 아니라고 하지만 진심은 아닌 것 같다. 가가는 인형을 받고 행운이 찾아올지도 모른다고 기대하는 것 같다. 가가에게 정말 행운이 왔으면 좋겠다. 가가는 행운은 나누는 것이라며, 무엇이 나올지 모르는 두근두근 상자를 선물로 주었다.

10343.0: Cassandra seems to be greatly distressed. You wonder what's going on…
10343.1: Cassandra is panicking because her album is missing, and it may have to do with Gaga. You…need to find all 12 Aran Memory Fragments, but…you should help Cassandra out first, right? If you keep hunting monsters for dropped items, you should find the album sooner or later.
10343.2: For bringing back Cassandra's album, you received another Aran Memory Fragment.
10343.name: Cassandra's Album

10344.0: For questions about Aran, you'd better go talk to #bCassandra#k.
10344.1: She says if you want to know more, then you must collect Dim Aran Memories.
10344.2: You got another Aran Memory Fragment. What will happen when you gather all 12 of them?
10344.name: Dim Aran Memories

10345.0: Signs of Aran's revival are slowly surfacing. For details, you should talk to Cassandra.
10345.1: Apparently, the blocks of ice that sealed Aran have been cracking near town. Where exactly?
10345.2: Aran Memory Fragments... When will you be able to gather all 12 of them?
10345.name: Signs of the Revival

10346.0: Memories about Aran are slowly fading from people's consciousness…but you don’t want to give up, and that's why you should go see #bCassandra#k.
10346.1: Cassandra instructs you to collect Faint Aran Memories.
10346.2: You think you're about halfway there…
10346.name: Faint Aran Memories

10347.0: If you want to obtain another Aran Memory Fragment, you should go see Cassandra.
10347.1: What? Go find a wolf awaiting its master?
10347.2: You found a wolf that seemed to be waiting for its master, but when you approached, he howled really loudly and ran away, leaving an Aran Memory Fragment in the snow.
10347.name: The Wolf In Waiting

10348.0: If you want to obtain another Aran Memory Fragment, you should go see Cassandra.
10348.1: You'd better find some Cloudy Aran Memories.
10348.2: You got another Aran Memory Fragment.
10348.name: Cloudy Aran Memories

10349.0: Cassandra tells you she needs your help. You wonder what's going on…
10349.1: Cassandra tells you to purchase a weapon from a nearby weapon shop for Aran.
10349.2: The weapon you got for Aran…is that the weapon he'll actually be using? No way…it's actually giving you goose bumps thinking about it.
10349.name: Preparing for the Arrival

1035.0: At the East entrance of the Mushroom Town, there's a fella named #bTodd#k who can teach me how to hunt in the world of Maple. I better go see him right now.
1035.1:
Todd instructed me that the #bCtrl#k key allows me to hunt in a basic manner, and told me to hunt the Jr. Sentinel nearby. I should hunt #rJr. Sentinel#k, grab 1 piece of #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k and bring them to #bPeter#k to learn hunting methods using skills. 

Jr. Sentinel #r#a1##k   

#i4031802# #t4031802# #b#c4031802##k/1
1035.2: I have learned that skills can be accessed through pressing #bK#k to open the skill window, and unlike regular attacks, skills can only be accessed by raising the skill level by assigning skill points. He also told me that it's much easier to use the skill by saving it on the Quick Slot. I better do that.
1035.name: Todd's Hunting Method

10350.0: You don't think you have enough Aran Memory Fragments yet. This means you should visit Cassandra, right?
10350.1: You need to find some Lingering Aran Memories.
10350.2: You got another Aran Memory Fragment.
10350.name: Lingering Aran Memories

10351.0: All of a sudden, you find yourself gathering the 12 Aran Memory Fragments Cassandra talked about, but…you still don't have enough yet. You'd better go talk to #bCassandra#k.
10351.1: Wait a minute, she was acting like she was going to give you an Aran Memory Fragment… That kind of annoys you, but you guess you should talk to Cassandra if you want to collect more Aran Memory Fragments.
10351.2: You can see 12 Aran Memory Fragments being gathered up in one place, but these fragments…seem a lot more interesting…
10351.name: The Hero's Memory

10352.0: You are short one Aran Memory Fragment. You'll have to ask Cassandra for even the very last one, right?
10352.1: You'd better locate those Flickering Aran Memories for Cassandra.
10352.2: Finally… You gathered all 12 Aran Memory Fragments, but what now?
10352.name: Flickering Aran Memories

10353.0: You gathered the 12 Aran Memory Fragments. They seem like meaningless little things. What are they for anyway? You're sure Cassadra knows something about this.
10353.1: What? These fragments are each supposed to have their own place? You'll have to reorder the fragments.
10353.2: December 10th, 2009… Will Aran really be revived?
10353.name: The Truth About Memory Fragments

10354.0: You've been busy digging up artifacts.
10354.1: That's when you found Cassandra's album. Hmm, should you give this to Cassandra or to Gaga?
10354.2: You returned the album to Cassandra, and she gave you an Aran Memory Fragment.
10354.name: To Whom Should Cassandra's Album Go?

10355.1: The album holding Cassandra's baby pictures... Oh my, is this really her? You have a hunch that Gaga would love to see this!
10355.2: When you gave Cassandra's old photo album to Gaga, he seemed elated to finally be free from Cassandra after this.
10355.name: Delivering Cassandra's Album

10356.1: Of course, it's Cassandra's, so you should return it to her! You'd better return the album to her immediately!
10356.2: Cassandra breathed a sigh of relief, knowing she finally had her album back.
10356.name: Delivering Cassandra's Album

1036.0: #bRobin#k, who exudes confidence as he stands at Snail Hunting Ground 1, apparently knows a lot about job advancements and stats. I better go talk to him right now.
1036.1: Robin told me that he'll teach me all I need to know about the stats, AP, and job advancement, then quiz me on it. I better learn some things about Ap first before continuing with the quest of Robin the Walking Encyclopedia.
1036.2: I was able to pass Robin's quiz. Phew...
1036.name: Robin the Walking Encyclopedia

10360.0: To commemorate the launch of Aran, Cassandra has prepared an event that has the odds of you winning at 100%!
10360.1: In celebration of the legendary hero Aran's release, Cassandra has prepared a foolproof lottery event!
10360.2: In celebration of the legendary hero Aran's release, Cassandra  prepared a huge event. #bFrom December 10th through January 19th#k, this daily event is a guaranteed win for everyone who participates!

#rSelect one of the following:#k
MapleStory-skinned Laptop
Canon Digital Camera
Apple iPod
$25 NX Game Card
Various Cash Items
Aran Paper Box

1037.2: I told Maria I took care of the snails.
1037.name: Help Hunt the Snails

1038.1: Maria said that she feels relieved that the snails are gone, and that she can now concentrate on collecting the mushrooms. To make sure no one worries about her, she told me to give this letter to #bChief Lucas#k of #bAmherst#k.

10425.0: 달이 어떻게 생겼는지 궁금해 하는 귀여운 #b아기 월묘#k를 찾아가 보자.
10425.1:
대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 마을 어딘가에 보름달이 보인다고 했는데.. 보름달 가까이 가면 #i2430031:#를 더블클릭하여 달사진을 찍어오자.

사진찍는데, 실패했다면 #b아기 월묘#k에게 부탁하여 폴라로이드를 다시 얻을 수 있다.
10425.2: 달사진을 보고 신기해 하는 월묘는  달사진을 보자 매우 기뻐했다. 하루에 한번씩 아기 월묘를 찾아가서 사진을 찍어주자.
10425.name: 달은 어떻게 생겼죠?

10426.0: 달사진을 찍을 폴라로이드가 필요하다면 #b아기 월묘#k를 찾아가 보자.
10426.1: 달사진을 찍을 폴라로이드가 필요하다면 #b아기 월묘#k를 찾아가 보자.
10426.2: 폴라로이드는 보름달 가까이에서 더블클릭해야 사진을 찍을 수 있다.

1043.name: Mai's Third Training

10430.0:
드디어 시작된 레인보우 위크! 그림 그리기에 서툰 카산드라가 특별히 부탁하고 싶은 일이 있다고 하는데 무슨 일일까?
\r\n#b<이벤트 기간>\r\n 2009년10월17일 ~ 2009년11월1일
10430.1:
그림 그리기는 좋아하지만 색칠하기에는 서툰 카산드라가 레인보우위크에 사용할 무지개 그림을 마저 완성해 달라고 부탁했다. 천하의 카산드라도 못하는 일이 있다니... 7색의 크레파스는 가가가 가지고 있다고 하는데 카산드라의 부탁이라고 솔직하게 말하면 크레파스를 안 빌려줄지도 모른다. 

또, 요일마다 빌려주는 크레파스의 색이 다르다는데 무슨 수로 크레파스를 빌려서 그림을 완성하지?
#b
- 월요일 : 빨간색
- 화요일 : 주황색
- 수요일 : 노란색
- 목요일 : 초록색
- 금요일 : 파란색
- 토요일 : 남색
- 일요일 : 보라색
#r* 특별히 10월31일, 11월1일에는 원하는 색을 빌릴 수 있다.

그림 그리기는 좋아하지만 색칠하기에는 서툰 카산드라가 레인보우위크에 사용할 무지개 그림을 마저 완성해 달라고 부탁했다. 천하의 카산드라도 못하는 일이 있다니... 7색의 크레파스는 가가가 가지고 있다고 하는데 카산드라의 부탁이라고 솔직하게 말하면 크레파스를 안 빌려줄지도 모른다. 

또, 요일마다 빌려주는 크레파스의 색이 다르다는데 무슨 수로 크레파스를 빌려서 그림을 완성하지?
#b
- 월요일 : 빨간색
- 화요일 : 주황색
- 수요일 : 노란색
- 목요일 : 초록색
- 금요일 : 파란색
- 토요일 : 남색
- 일요일 : 보라색
#r* 특별히 10월31일, 11월1일에는 원하는 색을 빌릴 수 있다.

2000.0: I heard that Blackbull is fixing his house...
2000.1: Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named Blackbull. He told me he needs to fix is house and wondered if I could help him out by getting him #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. If I do him a favor, I get myself a nice shield that he has, but what if I say no? I wouldn't ... be ... EATEN BY HIM ... no?? I really hope not...
2000.2: I got Blackbull of Perion #b30 tree branches and 50 firewoods#k. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward ... and ... well, scratchmarks here and there, and it looks pretty old ... is this even usable?
2000.name: Fixing Blackbull's House
2000.summary: You must collect the materials to fix Blackbull's house.

20000.0: I have decided to become one of the Knights serving the young Empress and battle the indestructible Black Mage. I better first meet up with #b#p1101000# and formally introduce myself.
20000.1: #p1101000# expressed her gratitude on my decision to become a Cygnus Knight and made a promise that she will always be there for me.
20000.2: #p1101000# claims that it is ultimately in my hands in terms of defeating the Black Mage. She says that her trustworthy Tactician, #p1101002#, will be responsible for molding me into a formidable Knight.
20000.name: Greetings from the Young Empress.

20001.0: Now I'll have to meet up with #p1101000#'s Tactician, #b#p1101002##k, and discuss what I have to do in the future.
20001.1: #p1101002# claimed that I may be too weak to fight for Maple World, and therefore refused to name me as a Knight-in-Training. He stated that the training period towards becoming a Knight-in-Training is already set up, and that I'll need to meet up with #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.
20001.2: #p1101002# claimed that I may be too weak to fight for Maple World, and therefore refused to name me as a Knight-in-Training. He stated that the training period towards becoming a Knight-in-Training is already set up, and that I'll need to meet up with #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.
20001.name: Neinheart the Tactician

20002.0: As stated by #p1101002#, I'll have to first raise my level to 10 and become a Knight-in-Training. I'll have to visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and enter the Training Forest.
20002.1: I met with #p1102000# at the entrance of the Training Forest. According to #p1102000#, Ereve is bereft of monsters, and instead, we train against a fantasy creature created by #p1101001# called 'Mimi'. He then proceeded to give me a potion called #p1102000#...
20002.2: #p1102000# shot a warning saying that I will be having a tough time training. I better pack up the potions that he gave me and get ready for the training.
20002.name: Kiku the Training Instructor

20003.0: Let's go visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.
20003.1: The first session involved facing off against the weakest Mimi in all of Ereve, #r#o0100120##k, and defeating #r5#k of them in the process. I better hunt down those #o0100120#s in #b#m130010000##k \n\n#o0100120##r #a200031##k
20003.2: I managed to defeat all 5 #o0100120#s and return. Off to the next session.
20003.name: Kiku's First Training Session

20004.0: Let's go visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.
20004.1: The second session involved facing off against the 2nd weakest Mimi in all of Ereve, #r#o0100121##k, and defeating #r10#k of them in the process. I better hunt down those #o0100121#s at or near #b#m130010000##k. \n\n#o0100121##r #a200041##k
20004.2: I managed to defeat all 10 #o0100121#s and return. Off to the next session.
20004.name: Kiku's Second Training Session

20005.0: Let's go visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.
20005.1: The third session involved facing off against the third weakest monster of Ereve, #r#o0100122##k, and defeating #r15#k of them in the process. I better hunt down those #o0100122#s in #b#m130010100##k. \n\n#o0100122##r #a200051##k
20005.2: I managed to defeat all 15 #o0100122#s and return. Off to the next session.
20005.name: Kiku's Third Training Session

20006.0: Let's go visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.
20006.1: #p1102000#'s fourth session involves facing off against the fourth weakest... you get the drill. Anyway, an easy Mimi called #r#o0100123##k, and defeating #r20#k of them in the process. I better hunt down those #o0100123#s in #b#m130010100##k. \n\n#o0100123##r #a200061##k
20006.2: I managed to defeat all 15 #o0100122#s and return. Off to the next session.
20006.name: Kiku's Fourth Training Session

20007.0: Let's go visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive his fifth training session.
20007.1: #p1102000# told me I had done a good job, and wanted me to defeat #b3 #o0100124#s#k for the last time. He warned me that unlike other Mimis, #o0100124# has a significantly higher stamina, so I better be careful... \n\n#o0100124##r #a200071##k
20007.2: I managed to defeat the #o0100124#s and return. #p1102000# greeted me with a smile and told me I am now eligible to become a Knight-in-Training. He then advised me to go see #p1101002# again.
20007.name: Kiku's Last Training Session

20008.0: It's time for me to receive the last test given by #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k in order for me to become the Knight-in-Training.
20008.1: An eternal loyalty towards the Empress. The courage to stand up to the Black Mage. The will power required to help me keep my faith in tact. As long as I don't forget these three, I'll be able to fight until the very end as a proud member of Cygnus Knights.
20008.2: An eternal loyalty towards the Empress. The courage to stand up to the Black Mage. The will power required to help me keep my faith in tact. As long as I don't forget these three, I'll be able to fight until the very end as a proud member of Cygnus Knights.
20008.name: The Path of a Knight

2001.0: I heard that "Blackbull" in Perion is building a new house...
2001.1: I ran into "Blackbull" again, the guy I helped fix his house. He was surprised at how strong I looked, and asked me for a much harder favor. His cousins from Henesys are all trying to move to Perion, and so he needed to build a new house! To build a new house, he said he needed #b100 pieces of rock from Stone Golem, 30 screws, 30 processed wood, and Blackbull's deed to the land#k. His son had the deed to the land, only to have it stolen by Curse Eye neaer Sleepywood...hmmm...I should be looking for those wandering around the deep forest...
2001.2: To move all of "Blackbull"'s cousins to Perion, I got him all the items he requested: #b100 pieces of rock from Stone Gollem, 30 screws, 30 refined wood, and 1 deed to the land#k. I got him all these...and yet what if he asks me to actually BUILD a house for him next time up?? Anyway for that, he gave me a little bit of EXP, 15,000 mesos, and a scroll for weapon with 10% success rate. Even my fame went up +2...not bad...
2001.name: Building a New House For "Blackbull"

20010.0: You have entered Maple World with a determination to become a #p1101000# Knight. But where is this place? Double-click #b#p1102004##k and start a conversation.
20010.1: At the request of the Empress, #p1102004#, with his brothers, guides Noblesses who aspire to become a part of  #p1101000# Knights. If you #bfollow the arrow to the left#k you'll meet #p1102004#'s brother #b#p1102005##k.
20010.2: You met #p1102005# as you were asked to do in the quest you received from #p1102004#. #p1102005# seems to have some information for you as well.
20010.name: Welcome to Ereve

20011.0: Let's get some information on hunting from #b#p1102005##k.
20011.1: #p1102005# briefly explained the basics of hunting and asked that you hunt #r#o100120##ks, the weakest creatures in Ereve, as a test. He says you can attack by pressing the #bCtrl key#k, so let's try it out!
20011.2: You have come back after hunting the #o0100120#s. #p1102005# says you can meet his brother #p1102006# if you continue to your left.
20011.name: I'll Show You How to Hunt

20012.0: Let's get some information on skills from #b#p1102006##k.
20012.1: #p1102006# informed you that you can open your Skill window by pressing the #bK key#k and suggested that you hunt #r3 #o100121#s#k and bring #b1 #t4000483##k to prove that you know how to use your skills.
20012.2: You've come back after hunting the #o0100121#s and brought back a #o0100121#'s feather. #p1102006# says #p1102007# is waiting for you. Proceed to the left.
20012.name: How Well Do You Know Your Skills?

20013.1: #p1102007#, after telling you about acquiring items from boxes, has asked that you collect a #b#t4032267##k and a #b#t4032268##k from the boxes scattered around the field. He says you can only break the boxes using #bRegular Attacks#k.
20013.2: Upon receiving a #t4032267# and a #t4032268#, #p1102007# made you a fantastic chair using the materials. If you continue to your left, you'll meet the last brother, #p1102008#. Let's rush over.
20013.name: A Box with Goodies Inside

20014.1: In a courteous tone of voice, #p1102008# said he wanted to quiz you on your newly-gained knowledge to make sure that you learned the necessary basics of Maple World. When you completed the quiz, #p1102008# gave you a #t4032269# and asked you to report to #bEmpress #p1101000##k.
20014.2: You went to see Empress #p1101000#, and the pale and fragile Empress welcomed you with a warm smile.
20014.name: The Empress is Waiting

20015.0: Start a conversation with #bEmpress #p1101000##k, who is sitting quietly next to #p1101001#.
20015.1: #p1101000# thanked you for becoming one of her Knights and asked that you stay by her side for a long time. She then went on to say that her tactician, #b#p1101002##k, is going to help you become a competent Knight.
20015.2: #p1101002# said you weren't strong enough to fight for Maple World, let alone appoint you as a Knight-in-Training. He said you must undergo a training course that has been prepared for you. Let's go see #p1102000#, the training instructor.
20015.name: Greetings From the Young Empress

20016.0: If you've finished exchanging pleasantries with #p1101000#, it's time to meet #p1101000#'s tactician, #b#p1101002##k, and ask about your immediate duties.
20016.1: #p1101002# said you weren't strong enough to fight for Maple World,  let alone appoint you as a Knight-in-Training. He said you must undergo a training course that has been prepared for you.  Let's go see #p1102000#, the training instructor.
20016.2: #p1101002# said you weren't strong enough to fight for Maple World, let alone appoint you as a Knight-in-Training. He said you must undergo a training course that has been prepared for you. Let's go see #p1102000#, the training instructor.
20016.name: Do You Know the Black Mage?

20017.0: As #p1101002# has said, you must reach Lv.10 before you can become a Knight-in-Training. Let's head over to #b#m130010000##k to find #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.
20017.1: You met #p1102000#, the Training Instructor, in #m130010000#. According to #p1102000#, there isn't a single monster in Ereve, so you must train against illusory creatures named Mimis, which #p1101001# summons. Then #p1102000# asked that you hunt #r#o100122##ks.
20017.2: You met #p1102000#, the Training Instructor, in #m130010000#. According to #p1102000#, there isn't a single monster in Ereve, so you must train against illusory creatures named Mimis, which #p1101001# summons. Then #p1102000# asked that you hunt #r#o100122##ks.
20017.name: The First Knight Training

20018.0: Let's start the second knight training with #b#p1102000##k.
20018.1: The second knight training requires you to hunt #r#o100123#s#k. You must hunt #r20#k of them, which is a little more than what you had to do for your first training. Let's head over to #m130010100# and hunt #o100123#s.
20018.2: You have come back after hunting all 20 #o0100123#s. Let's continue with the next training.
20018.name: The Second Knight Training

20019.0: Let's begin your last knight training before you become a Cygnus Knight.
20019.1: This time, #p1102000# has asked you to hunt the strongest of the Mimis in Ereve, the #r#o100124##ks.
20019.2: You have come back after hunting the #o100124#s. #p1102000# suggested you report to #p1101002#, as you've completed your training.
20019.name: The Last Knight Training

2002.0: I hear that #p1012101# is very sick...
2002.1: I met this girl named Maya at the old, raggedy townstreet of Henesys. She's been suffering from illness for a long time, so she doesn't look too well to even live a normal life. #bWeird Medicine#k... what a strange name, and she said she'll get a little bit better by taking that... I better go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...
2002.2: Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine only after I get him a Sparkling Rock.
2002.name: Maya of Henesys

20020.0: Talk to #b#p1101002##k and see if he accepts you as a Knight-in-Training.
20020.1: #p1101002# showed you the 5 different paths of Cygnus Knights, suggesting that you decide what kind of knight you wish to become. A Dawn Warrior of sword and soul, a Blaze Wizard of magic and flame, a Wind Archer of bow and storm, a Night Walker of night and darkness, or a Thunder Breaker of knuckle and lightning. Which fits you the best? The choice is entirely up to you.
20020.2: #p1101002# showed you the 5 different paths of Cygnus Knights, suggesting that you decide what kind of knight you wish to become. A Dawn Warrior of sword and soul, a Blaze Wizard of magic and flame, a Wind Archer of bow and storm, a Night Walker of night and darkness, or a Thunder Breaker of knuckle and lightning. Which fits you the best? The choice is entirely up to you.
20020.name: 5 Different Paths of Cygnus Knights

2003.1: Around "The Victoria" in Lith Harbor, I met this heavily-bearded crewmember called Teo. He said he has the #bWeird Medicine#k but he wasn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he said he'll trade with me for a #bsparkling rock#k. I mean, he does look like he knows Maya pretty well, but he still wants to make a deal with me, knowing how sick she is ...?? That's strange... anyway, to get that #bsparkling rock#k, I need to head over to Perion and talk to the #rSophia#k, the daughter of the owner of the department store there.
2003.2: I finally met Sophia, who's working at the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs #bArcon's blood#k.
2003.name: Finding Sophia

2004.1: I finally met Sophia, who's working on her dream as an alchemist inside the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs #b50 squishy liquid's, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs#k and #b1 Arcon's blood#k. Everything else looks reasonable enough except ... Arcon's blood ...??? Fortunately, Sophia knew where to get it. She told me to look for this man named Manji somewhere around Perion. Manji, huh ... where must he be ... ??
2004.2: Sophia told me that Manji has the Arcon's Blood, which is what the sparkling rock is made of.
2004.name: Making a Sparkling Rock

2005.1: I found Manji at Perion. Just as I thought, he was unwilling to give away #bArcon's blood#k for free. He wants me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island and gather up #b40 Charms of the Undead#k for him ... by the way, who does he think he is, treating me like that??? I'm starting to regret saying yes to Maya in the first place ...
2005.2: Manji asked for the Charms of the Undead in return to Arcon's Blood.
2005.name: Arcon's Blood?

2006.1: I gathered up #b40 Charms of the Undead#k from the underground tunnel and got them to Manji of Perion. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through his promise, he hands over #bArcon's blood#k to me. Maybe he isn't so horrible a guy afterall. Anyway, now I need to gather up #b50 squishy liquids, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs, and 1 Arcon's blood#k for Sophia.
2006.2: I brought the Charms of the Undead to Manji and I finally got Arcon's Blood. I should hurry back to Sophia...
2006.name: Getting Arcon's Blood

2007.1: Sophia looks genuinely surprised that I gathered up every single material needed for that #bsparkling rock#k. Well, it wasn't easy at all ... anyway, she handed me the piece of #bsparkling rock#k made out of all the materials I got for her. Hmmm ... this #bsparkling rock#k ... it gives off a strange light, and then ... it starts glittering, and ... now I can understand why people want this ...!! Well, now that I have it, all I got left is trading it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
2007.2: Sophia looks genuinely surprised that I gathered up every single material needed for that #bsparkling rock#k. Well, it wasn't easy at all ... anyway, she handed me the piece of #bsparkling rock#k made out of all the materials I got for her. Hmmm ... this #bsparkling rock#k ... it gives off a strange light, and then ... it starts glittering, and ... now I can understand why people want this ...!! Well, now that I have it, all I got left is trading it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
2007.name: Making Sparkling Rock

2008.1: I traded the #bsparkling rock#k with Teo of Lith Harbor for the #bweird medicine#k. Now, all I need to do is get this to #rMaya#k, and I'm done, but the more I think about it, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...
2008.2: I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the weird medicine.  Hopefully she'll get better after taking this. As a sign of thanks, Maya got me 5,000 mesos and a #bbrown bamboo hat#k. This hat ... I mean, it looks like it's going to help when I'm walking under a blazing sun, but it looks so old and raggedy ... and if I put it on, it makes this weird noise that feels as if some insect is walking around and stuff ... am I going to be alright ... ???
2008.name: Delivering the Weird Medicine

2009.0: Let's start looking for Pia in Henesys
2009.1: Underneath the watchtower at Henesys park, I met Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. She was talking about how, on the way to Ellinia, she ran into a couple of blue mushrooms and had a hard time with them. She wanted me to show them who's the boss, and as a proof, she wanted #b60 blue mushroom caps and 60 green mushroom caps#k ... but I can see why she's being attacked anyway ... anyone that walks around wearing those is bound to be attacked !!!
2009.2: I got Pia, who had been chilling under the watchtower at Henesys Park, the stuff she requested, #b60 blue mushroom caps and 60 green mushroom caps#k. For that, she got me the scroll for armor def. ... she said all I need to do is click on it at item window, and drag it to the armor. Simple, but ... what if this doesn't work ????
2009.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom

2010.0: Let's go look for Jane at Lith Harbor.
2010.1: At around Lith Harbor near "The Victoria", I met this girl name Jane, who was sporting bunny ears. Jane expressed a desire to travel around the island, but her father just wouldn't let her. She thought if she got a hold of #b80 wild boar teeth and 100 horny mushroom caps#k, then maybe her father would let her go afterall. And for that, she asked me if I could get her those ... I mean, isn't SHE supposed to collect them herself? Anyway it doesn't sound too hard, so I should headover to the highland and start hunting down some wild boars ...
2010.2: I got Jane #r80 wild boar teeth and 100 horny mushroom caps#k that she requested. Seriously, though, will her dad approve of her traveling with this? Not with the bunny ears she's wearing ... hmm ... anyway, in return, she got me something she's been keeping for a long time: a scroll for weapon for ATT. If this works, then... my weapon's going to be awesome!!
2010.name: Jane and the Wild Boar

20100.0: I better go talk to #b#p1101002##k and formally receive the blessing to become a Knight-in-Training.
20100.1: There are five paths to choose from. Warrior of Light, Magician of Fire, Bowman of the Wind, Thief of Darkness, and Pirate of Thunder. What's my destiny?
20100.2: There are five paths to choose from. Warrior of Light, Magician of Fire, Bowman of the Wind, Thief of Darkness, and Pirate of Thunder. What's my destiny?
20100.name: Time to Choose

20101.0: The time has come. If I want to find out more about Dawn Warriors, the Warriors of Light, I should talk to #b#p1101003#, the Chief Knight of Light#k.
20101.1: If I want to become a Cygnus Knight as a #bDawn Warrior#k accompanied with honor and glory, I should select #p1101003#.
20101.2: I am now a Dawn Warrior!
20101.name: Path of a Dawn Warrior

20102.0: The time has come. If I want to find out more about Blaze Wizards, the Magicians of Fire, I should talk to #b#p1101004#, the Chief Knight of Fire#k.
20102.1: If I want to become a Cygnus Knight as a #bBlaze Wizard#k with flaming expectations for future missions, I should select #p1101004#.
20102.2: I am now a Blaze Wizard!
20102.name: Path of a Blaze Wizard

20103.0: The time has come. If I want to find out more about Wind Archers, the Bowmen of the Wind, I should talk to #b#p1101005#, the Chief Knight of the Wind#k.
20103.1: If I want to become a Cygnus Knight as a Wind Archer with broad perspectives on life, I should select #p1101005#.
20103.2: I am now a Wind Archer!
20103.name: Path of a Wind Archer

20104.0: The time has come. If I want to find out more about Night Walkers, the Thieves of Darkness, I should talk to #b#p1101006#, the Chief Knight of Darkness#k.
20104.1: If I want to become a Cygnus Knight as a Night Walker that embraces the darkness for the sake of light, I should select #p1101006#.
20104.2: I am now a Night Walker!
20104.name: Path of a Night Walker

20105.0: The time has come. If I want to find out more about Thunder Breakers, the Pirates of Lightning, I should talk to #b#p1101007#, the Chief Knight of Lightning#k.
20105.1: If I want to become a Cygnus Knight as a Thunder Breaker who thoroughly enjoys thrilling adventures, I should select #p1101007#.
20105.2: I am now a Thunder Breaker!
20105.name: Path of a Thunder Breaker

2011.0: I heard Jane has another goal...
2011.1: I ran into Jane again at Lith Harbor, the same Jane that I helped get wild boar's canine teeth for her to travel. She said she got busted for lying that it was her that collected those items...anyway, she gave up on her dream to travel, and now is trying to become an alchemist. She needed some materials to experiment with...and...I'm pretty sure I'm getting those for her. Anyway, she said she needed #b1 pure water, 30 medicines with weird vibe, and 20 malady's experimental frogs#k to try to make an Elixir. Oh, what the heck, I'll get them for her and see if it really works...
2011.2: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...is the whole place going to blow up??
2011.name: Jane's First Challenge

2012.1: This time, Jane promised she'll make a better item, and wants me to get #b1 Mushmom's spore, 3 of Drake's blood, 100 medicine with weird vibes, and 30 Malady's experimental frogs#k. She said something about making a Power Elixir, the one that can restore both HP and MP at once...
2012.2: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...then I don't know if really want to take it...blehhh...
2012.name: Jane's Second Challenge

2013.1: This time, the last time, she promised to make me a mysterious scroll, and that she wanted me to get #ba moon rock, 20 dragon skins, and 10 saps of ancient tree#k for her. I guess I should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the moon rock, right?
2013.2: I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the scroll. Thankfully, the scroll for glove for ATT was made without a hitch, and she readily gave it to me. If the scroll really works, then I may have myself a dandy of a glove! Anyway, Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting and become a good alchemist someday. Maybe next time I come back here, I may be able to buy an item from her that's not sold in store...nice...
2013.name: Jane's Final Challenge

2014.0: I heard there is a runaway kid called Alex in Kerning City...
2014.1: At the top of the building in Kerning City, I met this kid named Alex, who looked like a runaway kid. He left home a few days ago aftter a spat with his father. He'd been wandering around Kerning City ever since, but now, with no money and a severe case of boredom hitting him, he just wanted to go back home ... with the problem being that he was certain that a whole round of spanking would await him if he did, indeed, return home. So he asked me if I could convince his father Stan, who happened to be the chief of Henesys, to let him return home without any incident. Not only that, he asked me to get his late mother's article, her #bold gold watch#k, from him as a proof. If he had known this would happen, would he have done it nonetheless?
2014.2: As Alex has requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's #bold gold watch#k.
2014.name: Alex's Request

2015.1:
At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but he did offer to speak to me only if I get him #b30 Evil Eye's tails and 60 pig ribbons#k to fix this town. Jeez, why do I have to go through this much trouble just to talk to this grumpy old man?

#t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/30
#t4000002# #b#c4000002##k/60
2015.2: I talked with Alex's father, Stan, to settle the misunderstandings. For the return, I got Alex's mother's gold watch.
2015.name: Talking to Stan

2016.1: At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but once I got him #b50 Evil Eye's tails and 100 pig ribbons#k he requested to fix this town, that was when he decided to listen. He was even more straight-forward and difficult to talk to than I first thought, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's #bgold watch#k as the proof. Now, all I need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City, right?
2016.2: I gave Alex his late mother's #bgold watch#k. Hopefully this will get him home ... as a sign of appreciation, he got me an earing he received from friends he met while traveling here and there. Well, Alex is now forgiven by Stan, but based on the look of his face, I don't know if he really is going to head home right now ... I should check it out the next time I head over to Henesys ...
2016.name: Mother's Gold Watch

2017.0: I heard that Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...
2017.1: Arwen the fairy from Ellinia told me that a couple of days ago, on the way to Perion, she was attacked by a monster covered in flame, and lost her very precious #bglass shoe#k in the process. Fairies love glimmering, shiny objects to the point of obsession, so obviously she wants it back badly ... I better hunt some monsters around Perion, and hopefully I can find it there.
2017.2: I got Arwen from Ellinia the glass shoe she desperately wanted back. I got lucky, finding it from a nasty Fireboar ... phew. Anyway, as a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's really gorgeous and glimmering like a star ... dang, maybe I can use this to make something special ...
2017.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe

2018.0: Let's meet Luke the Security Guy at the entrance of the Henesys Dungeon.
2018.1: At the entrance of the dungeon, I met Luke the security guy. He wanted to make a healthy dish for his mom, and asked me if I could get him #b100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Stirge, and a bowl of salad#k. He claimed that he's too busy with all the security matters and stuff, but ... he looks like he's just falling asleep at work ...
2018.2: I got Luke, who is protecting the entrance of the Dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he's making the "Snake Drink" and all ... I want a taste of that myself! In return, Luke got me a nicely refined jewel he found from around the area. It's not like a refined jewel drops from the sky ... did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway I should drop by later when the "Snake Drink" gets done ...
2018.name: Luke the Security Guy

2019.0: I heard Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepwood is going through hard times... I should go check him out.
2019.1: At a VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called #bMr. Wetbottom#k. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me a nice sauna robe. He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son?? What kind of a book is it anyway... ????
2019.2: I found #bRonnie#k in the tree tunnel, which Mr. Wetbottom asked me to do.
2019.name: A Clue to the Secret Book

2020.1: Inside a tree tunnel around Ellinia I found #bRonnie#k, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. He said the red book is off limits, but he seems to be starving. In the end, we made a deal that I get him #b50 Lupin bananas, Rina's Unagi Special, and a fresh milk#k, and he gives me the book. According to Ronnie, I can find Rina at Henesys, and as for the fresh milk, I can get it from Rowen the fairy from Ellinia. I have a lot of traveling to do, but oh well...
2020.2: I got Ronnie all the food he needed, and got the #bSecret Book#k that Mr. Wetbottom had been desperately looking for. It's a weird-looking book with a red cover... I have a feeling that I should not open this book... Anyway I should hurry up and get this to Mr. Wetbottom at the VIP sauna in Sleepywood before it's too late.
2020.name: Hungry Ronnie

2021.1: To get the Unagi special and a fresh milk, I need to gather up the ingredients for those. Rina of Henesys requested #b50 Curse Eye tails and 5 pig's heads#k for the Unagi special. Rowen the fairy of Ellinia asked for a refined piece of glittering #bdiamond#k for a fresh milk. Diamond, huh... how am I supposed to get that rare, expensive item?
2021.2: Inside the tree tunnel of Ellinia, I found #bRonnie#k, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. He was adamant about not giving away the red book, but he seemed very hungry. I wound up making a deal with him where he would give me the red book after I get him #b50 Lupin's Bananas, Rina's Special Unagi, and a fresh milk#k. According to Ronnie, Rina can be found at Henesys, and the fresh milk can be obtained through a fairy in Ellinia. This looks like quite a task, but oh well... I should get going.
2021.name: Secret to Unagi Special

2023.1: I got Ronnie some yummy food for the Secret Book. I want to peek inside...
2023.2: I got Mr. Wetbottom the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... well, it'd be best for Ronnie to be with the fairies, right? Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing these cumbersome armors around sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and chill here at the sauna...
2023.name: Returned Secret Book

2024.0: I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
2024.1: I ran into #bRowen#k again, the same Rowen who I got a fresh milk from for Ronnie, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. She seemed to be keeping her guards up against humans then, but it looks like she's accepting me as Ronnie's friend...Rowen is assistant of the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and he's been concerned about the cursed dolls that Grendel the Really Old made with his black magic a long long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupin's took them and ran away. They have since turned into zombies, and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupin's and take away the #bcursed dolls#k from them ... well, I readily accepted the request of collecting #b100 cursed dolls#k, but am I going to be okay against those crazy monkeys??
2024.2: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b100 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
2024.name: Collecting 100 Cursed Dolls
2024.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

2025.1: Rowen asked me again, this time #b200 cursed dolls#k. Well, that's easy...
2025.2: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b200 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
2025.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
2025.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

2026.1: Rowen asked me again, this time #b400 cursed dolls#k. 400?? Hmmm...it's getting quite serious now...
2026.2: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b400 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very-hard-to-find ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
2026.name: Collecting 400 Cursed Dolls
2026.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

2027.1: Rowen asked me again, this time #b600 cursed dolls#k. 600?? THAT'S A LOT....
2027.2: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b600 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me the scroll for gloves. Will the forest really return to normal with this?
2027.name: Collecting 600 Cursed Dolls
2027.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

2028.1: Rowen asked me one last time, this time #b1000 cursed dolls#k. Why does she need that much? Is she trying to sell them all???
2028.2: I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all #b1000 cursed dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I've collected so many of those for her, but it looks like Zombie Lupin's aren't decreasing in any way shape or form ... what's going on? Anyway, at least it seems that the fairies may not have such animosity towards humans now ... and that's fine with me hehe ...
2028.name: Collecting 1000 Cursed Dolls
2028.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll

2029.0: I heard that I can get a job if I go see Nella at Kerning City...
2029.1: I gave Nella 1000 mesos as a commission for hooking up Kerning City citizen's request. First request was to get the materials for Don Hwang, the owner of armor shop. The materials for making new armor are #b50 Green Mushroom caps#k and #b50 Bubbling's huge bubbles#k. It wouldn't be that hard, since I can easily find Green Mushrooms near the Ellina and Bubblings at the Subway.
2029.2: I gave what Don Hwang asked for and I got bunch of lemons for return. I wonder what kind of armor would Don Hwang make. Nella said there are many more requests I can do. I should visit Nella every once in a while.
2029.name: Don Hwang's Request

2030.1: I got the second request from Nella. Shumi wants to make a house for her little puppy. To make a puppy house, she needs #b5 Processed Woods#k and #b5 Screws#k. I need to get those ASAP.
2030.2: I gave what Shumi asked for and I got bunch of cakes for return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has her own house~ I should get back to Nella for more requests.
2030.name: Shumi's Request

20314.name: Shinsoo's Teardrop

20315.0: It seems like #p1101007# has something to say about the recovered treasure...
20315.1: For defeating #o9001009# and recovering Shinsoo's Teardrop, I was promoted to Advanced Knight.
20315.2: For defeating #o9001009# and recovering Shinsoo's Teardrop, I was promoted to Advanced Knight. I'll need to embrace even the most difficult journeys with smiles and ease like an Advanced Knight would.
20315.name: Shinsoo's Teardrop

2032.1: Nella said I look much stronger than last time. First request is to get ingredients for Dr. Faymus, the owner of potion shop. He needs #b100 Horny Mushroom Caps#k and #b50 Jr. Necki Skins#k. Taking on Jr. Necki's might be little tough, but I will give it a try.
2032.2: I gave what Dr. Faymus asked for and I got bunch of white potions for return. I wonder what kind of potion would Dr. Faymus make by using those materials. I should get back to Nella for more request.
2032.name: Dr. Faymus's Request

2033.1: I got the second request from Nella. Chris got his pillow stolen few days ago and he can't sleep well since then. To make a new pillow, he wants #b50 stiff feathers#k and #b20 leathers#k. I should get them ASAP.
2033.2: I got what Chris asked for and I got refined steal and bronze. Chris can finally sleep well in his new pillow. I should get back to Nella for more requests.
2033.name: Chris's Request

2034.1: I got the third request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny wants to get #b150 Evil Eye Tails#k for his dinner. He wanted to make a bowl of Evil Eye Stew. Now that sounds delicious!
2034.2: I gave what Cutthroat Manny asked for and I got shoes for return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. I should get back to Nella for more request.
2034.name: Cutthroat Manny's Request

2035.0: I hear that Luke the Security Guy made up his mind on something...
2035.1: I met Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink back then is gone now because his mom drank it all...anyway, Luke was ready to quit the boring life of a security man and wanted to travel...and to make a glove that befits the traveling, Mr. Smith of Perion suggested #b1 black feather, 10 Orihalcon Plates, 50 dragon skins, 40 screws, and 3 horns of Taurospear!!#k That's insane...well, I'm guessing he wants me to collect them for him...oh, do the fairies of Ellinia know something about it?
2035.2: I got Luke all the materials he needed for the nice glove, and return, he gave me a very precious item that has been passed down from generaition to generation, an #bold bronze normal Helm#k. I feel like I'm losing out on this deal...but I can't get mad at him since it's been passed down from generation to generatoin. I heard Mr. Thunder can make this helmet even better...I should go there sometime later..
2035.name: Luke the Security Man's Wish to Travel

2036.0: Let's go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
2036.1: Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me a favor of gathering up materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road. #b50 of orange mushroom caps, leaves, squishy liquid, and red snail shells each#k ... I guess I can get most of these from the monsters around the prairie ...
2036.2: I got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
2036.name: First Material for Building a New House
2036.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.

2037.1: This time Ronnie wanted #b50 of octopus legs, Curse Eye tails, wild boar tooth, and the charm of the undead EACH#k. These are probably available by the monsters around the deep forest, highland, and ant tunnels.
2037.2: I got them all for Ronnie. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
2037.name: Second Material for Building a New House
2037.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.

2038.1: This time Ronnie wanted #b50 each of Drake's skull, Stone Gollem's pieces of rock, the skin of Croko, and Lupin's banana#k. I can probably get those from the monsters at the ant hole, prarie, and at swamp...this is getting quite difficult now...
2038.2: I got them all for Ronnie. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
2038.name: Third Material for Building a New House
2038.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.

2039.1: Ronnie asked for the last time. This time he wanted #b50 each of medicine with weird vibe, dark stone gollem's pieces of rock, Wild Kargo's eyes, and Tauromacis's horns, along with 1 diamond#k. I can sort of get this, but for me to hunt at subway, deep forest, the ant tunnel ... it sucks!!
2039.2: I got all the materials Ronnie needed for the last time. Is this it? For the reward, he gave me a pair of shoes he got as a gift from the fairies that found it somewhere around the forest. Somehow, he can't put the shoes on, so I'm getting it ... hopefully it works ... haha
2039.name: Last Material for Building a New House
2039.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.

2040.0: Let's go to Maya in Henesys
2040.1: I got a favor request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted #b50 each of snail shells, blue snail shells, mushroom spores, and tree branches#k. Maybe..well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prarie...
2040.2: I got all the items Maya requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??
2040.name: Maya's First Collection

20400.0: #p1101002# seems to have a new assignment for me.
20400.1: I have received a new assignment. The assignment deals with supporting Advanced Knight #p1103000# that is chasing the Black Wings that are targeting the Empress. The last trace of #p1103000# was found in #b#m211000000##k, and he has instructed me to go to #m211000000# to find #p1103000#.
20400.2: I have received a new assignment. The assignment deals with supporting Advanced Knight #p1103000# that is chasing the Black Wings that are targeting the Empress. The last trace of #p1103000# was found in #m211000000#, and he has instructed me to go to #m211000000# to find #p1103000#.
20400.name: Chasing the Knight's Target

20401.1: #p2020006# told me she's not sure where #p1103000# is now, but she was able to confirm that he did stay at #m211000000# for a lengthy period of time, and he was busy #rhunting the zombies#k. Not just a regular hunting, but with a purpose: to find a clue that may lead to something.
20401.2: According to #p2020006#, #p1103000# was actively hunting the zombies. Not just a regular hunting, but hunting with a purpose: to find a clue that may lead to something.
20401.name: Hunting the Zombies

20402.0: While slaying the zombies, I was able to obtain an item called #t4001207#. Once I did that, #p2032001# approached me.
20402.1: #b#p2032001##k warned me that #b#t4001207##k contained a curse-like power that spread all over this world, and that since it's a dangerous item, he wanted me to hand it in to him so he could break the curse. While listening to #p2032001# talk, however, I noticed #p1103000#'s name being mentioned... \n\n#i4001207# #t4001207# #b#c4001207# / 1#k
20402.2: I gave #p2032001# the #t4001207#. #p2032001# told me that #p1103000# gave him #t4001207# too the other day, and that he recently moved to #m240000000# to find out more about #t4001207#.
20402.name: Black Scale

20403.0: According to #p2032001#, #p1103000# recently moved to #m240000000#. I better head down to #b#m240000000##k and ask #b#p2081000##k about #p1103000#.
20403.1: According to #p2081000#, #p1103000# went to visit the #bDragon Outcast#k outside town. Apparently, the scale of the Dragon Outcast is similar to #t4001207#'s... I better go visit Dragon Outcast. His house is #bconnected to #m240020401# or #m240020101##k.
20403.2: When I asked #p2081012#, the Dragon Outcast, about #p1103000#, he seemed perturbed by my question and got mad at me for it. Apparently, #t4001207# is not his. He thought it might have to do instead with the stolen dragon egg incident at #m240000000#...
20403.name: Dragon Outcasts

20404.0: #o9001010#? Something about it seem suspicious... I better ask #b#p2081012##k, the Dragon Outcast.
20404.1:
#p2081012# told me if I wanted to find out more about #o9001010#, then I'll have to eliminate one #r#o8180000##k and one #r#o8180001##k. He wanted to leave the house, but not with those creatures out there... I better help #p2081012# out. 

#o8180000##r #a204041##k 
#o8180001##r #a204042##k
20404.2: The one responsible for stealing the dragon's egg in #m240000000# turned out to be #o9001010#. Even the name seemed quite suspicious. Maybe #p1103000# looked into #o9001010#. I better go visit #o9001010# right now. #b#o9001010#'s cave is located near the dragon's nest#k.
20404.name: The Stolen Egg

20405.0: I better go visit the #bCave of the #o9001010##k as instructed by #p2081012#.
20405.1: There was a note posted on the wall of the cave. After reading the note, I noticed that it may have been written by #p1103000#. The subject of the curse was not found, but the device was found, recovered, and sent back to Ereve. I may have been one step too late. #p1103000# must have completed his assignment already. I better return to #bEreve#k.
20405.2: There was a note posted on the wall of the cave. After reading the note, I noticed that it may have been written by #p1103000#. The subject of the curse was not found, but the device was found, recovered, and sent back to Ereve. I may have been one step too late. #p1103000# must have completed his assignment already. I better return to Ereve.
20405.name: The Cave of the Black Witch

20406.0: I may have failed the assignment of providing support for #p1103000#, since he already completed his assignment before I could reach him. I better return to #bEreve#k and report the results to #b#p1101002##k.
20406.1: I was going to complain to #p1101002# about doing all that work for nothing, but he seemed more concerned that #p1103000# hasn't come back and that something might be up. He then asked me if I could return to the #bCave of the #o9001010##k and find out if there's another note somewhere inside.
20406.2: #p1101002# told me #p1103000# has not yet come back and that something might be up. He then asked me if I could return to the #bCave of the #o9001010##k and find out if there's another note somewhere inside.
20406.name: The Knight That Disappeared

20407.0: ...Wait, is this Ereve? But Ereve's usually not like this. And why are the Chief Knights standing like that? No one's answering! Only #p1101001# seemed to be barely awake. I better talk to #b#p1101001##k.
20407.1: #p1101001# told me the lady in front is actually #r#p1104002# the #o9001010##k and that she has put a curse on everyone in Ereve. He mentioned that most of them on the island should be able to weather it, but the Empress might be in grave danger... I better defeat #o9001010# and break the curse now! \n\n#o9001010##r #a204071##k
20407.2: The cunning #o9001010#, after realizing that Ereve, which is protected by #p1101001#, may be hard to enter, used #p1103000# to throw in cursed items, then cursed the whole island through that! Fortunately, after defeating #o9001010#, the curse seems to have been lifted.
20407.name: The Curse of the Black Witch

20408.0: I received a call from #p1101000#, the young Empress herself.
20408.1: The young Empress thanked me for my efforts in saving Ereve and decided, through my accomplishments and past work, that I would be promoted to the position of Chief Knight. Chief Knight?
20408.2: I wound up being anointed as the new Chief Knight for the Cygnus Knights. I made a promise to the Empress that the moment the Black Mage reawakens, I will be the first in line to defeat the Black Mage.
20408.name: Chief Knight of the Empress

2041.1: This time Maya wanted #b50 each of fireboar teeth, Bubbling's huge bubbles, pig ribbons, and tablecloths#k. Apparently, I can get those by hunting down the monster around the plateau, subway station, and prairies ... well, that's easy!
2041.2: I got them all for Maya. Please don't tell me she wanted all these for free...
2041.name: Maya's Second Collection

2042.1: This time, Maya requested #b10 Lupin Dolls and 50 each of Cold Eye's tail, Tortie's shell, and Iron Hog's Steel Hoof#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the highland, beach, and prarie. This is getting harder now...
2042.2: I got them all for Maya. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
2042.name: Maya's Third Collection

2043.1: Maya requested, for the last time, #b50 each of Clang's claws, Dark Stone Gollem's pieces of rock, the eyes of Wild Kargo, and Tauromacis's horns, along with one diamond#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the beach, deep forest, and deep into the ant tunnel ... this is RIDICULOUS! It's too hard !!
2043.2: I got all the items Maya requested for the last time...or is it? As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a pair of shoes her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks solid like brand new!!
2043.name: Maya's Last Collection

2044.0: Let's go to Pia in Henesys
2044.1: I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearig Pia at the Henesys Park. I did her a favor and took care of the blue mushrooms before. This time, she wants to make a present for a friend in Ellinia who wants to go out on a journey. The claw that she wants to make for her consists of #b15 silver plates, 50 dragon skins, and 40 screws#k...and for the friend, she also wanted me to get back the #bRed Cape#k that Rina of Henesys borrowed. If I get her all these...am I going to be richly rewarded?
2044.2: I decided to go to Rina to get the #bRed Cape#k back, which she has borrowed from Pia.
2044.name: Looking for the Red Cape

2045.1: I went to see Rina at Henesys, and instead, she tells me she took that red cape because Pia didn't return the items she borrowed from her. She said, if she gets her items back, then the cape is hers again...the borrowed stuff are #b1 black crystal, 1 ancient scroll, and 30 horns of Tauromacis.
2045.2: I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she is keeping the cape until Rina brings back what she borrowed from Rina. She said she will return the cape if she gets back what Pia has borrowed from her.
2045.name: What Pia has Borrowed

2046.1: I got Rina #b1 black crystal, 1 ancient document, and 30 horns of Tauromacis#k, and in return, I got Pia's #bred cape#k back. With that and #b15 silver, 50 dragon skins, and 40 screws#k, I should go back to Pia...
2046.2: I got Pia of Henesys Park all the materials she requested for her friend's claw, and in return, got myself a thief-only clothes...wow...since that was made just for me, I should take good care of these, right? Anyway, did that friend of Pia's leave by now? Who knows? I may see him sometime...
2046.name: Pia's Present For a Friend

2047.0: Let's look for Manji in Perion
2047.1: I ran into Manji from Perion again, the same Manji that I met while I was helping the little Maya get her medicine. He was shocked by my stronger appearance, and wanted to ask me for a favor. Long long ago, he was in danger of being attacked by Balrog, only to be saved by the legendary hero Tristan. He died in place of Manji, and for that, he's been keeping that sword to this day. Too bad the sword has been soaked in Balrog's evilness and is as ragged as possible. It's too embarrassing to even call it a sword now. Anyway, he gave me the #rOld Gladius#k and wanted me to reawaken it for him. If it indeed gets reawaken, it becomes the #bHero's Gladius#k ...I should go see Chrishrama of Sleepywood just the way Manji said it...
2047.2: It seems that this Gladius which Manji told me is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing one bwtween the #bGladius#k and the #bSkull Earring#k which Manji offered me, but I will not regret.
2047.name: Hero's Gladius

7,500 EXP
#Wselect#

2047.summary: I need to rewaken the Hero's Gladius and take it to Manji.

2048.1: I found Chrishrama of Sleepywood, and showed him the #bOld Gladius#k that Manji gave me. He claimed to have made it himself, and that he needs a #bstar rock, 1 piece of ice, 1 ancient scroll, and 1 flamed feather#k. I've never heard of any of those, so I don't know how I'm going to even start with this...Chrishrama said they only way I can get is to talk to Mike who's guarding the entrance of the dungeon.
2048.2: I got all the materials needed to reawaken the sword to Chrishrama. He couldn't believe his eyes, but went on with it, and reawoke the sword into #bHero's Gladius#k. It gives off a mystic light...and it's a really nice sword! Hmmm...I don't know if I should really give it to him...
2048.name: Rewakening the Gladius
2048.summary: I need to find the materials needed to reawaken the Gladius and take it to Chrishrama.

2049.1: At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is "Mar" and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named #bTrainer Bartos#k of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...
2049.2: After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Lifel#k, and got that to "Mar" the fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now ... sweet ...
2049.name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life

2050.0: Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
2050.1: In front of Sleepywood Hotel, I met #bSabitrama#k, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on...and that he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called #bPink Anthurium#k. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower ... I better remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia ... I should go there and talk to this guy #bShane#k ...
2050.2: Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a #bscroll for the overall armor#k. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. Based on what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance ... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time ...
2050.name: Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine

2080.1: #p1002101# of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a #bMagicianr#k if I'm at least on #blevel 8#k. He tells me I'll need to see #rGrendel the Really Old#k of #rEllinia#k ... but how do I get there? I'll have to check on the world map. (#rW#k)
2080.2: I have learned what it takes to become a true Magician through the chief of all wizards, Grendel the Really Old. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...
2080.name: The Path of a Magician

2081.0: What do I have to do to choose a job of my liking? I'll have to see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
2081.1: I'll have to listen to #p1002101# carely as he describes the in's and out's of each and every job, because he'll quiz me on it afterwards.
2081.2: I answered all the questions #p1002101# asked. I'll have to be at least on #blevel 10#k in order to become a #ba Warrior, a Thief, a Bowman, or a Pirate#k, and #blevel 8#k to become a #bMagician#k. Warrior-hopefuls will need to head over to Perion for job-advancement, Kerning City for thief-hopefuls, Ellinia for magician-hopefuls, and Henesys for Bowman-hopefuls.
2081.name: A Lesson on Job Advancement

2082.0: Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
2082.1: I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary? \n\n#o0130100# #r#a20821##k
2082.2: I took out Stumps for the sake of Ayan in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
2082.name: The Stump Horror Story

2083.0: Apparently there's someone at Kerning City by the name of #p1052106# that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky 24/7.
2083.1:
I got to meet #b#p1052106##k on top of a building at Kerning City. He seems like a nice guy who has an unquenchable thirst for flying, and he wants to create a Hang Glider to fulfill his dream of flying. He asks me if I can gather up the materials for the Hang Glider, and even though the process of making the Hang Glider seems dubious at best, I can't say no to his sincere desire to fly. I'll need to get him #b50 #t4000042#s, 10 #t4003001#s, and 50 #t4003004#s#k.

#t4000042# #b#c4000042##k/50
#t4003001# #b#c4003001##k/10
#t4003004# #b#c4003004##k/50
2083.2: I got the materials needed for #p1052106# to make the Hang Glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge's wings are enough to make the Hang Glider. I don't know if this will really work, though, so I'll check up on him around the time when the Hang Glider should be ready to take flight.
2083.name: Icarus's Hang Glider

2084.0: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the glider...maybe I should go check up on him at Kerning City.
2084.1:
Icarus had failed to create a working Hang Glider, and is now attempting to create a flying balloon on his never-ending quest for flight. This looks just as preposterous as his last attempt, but I don't think I can stop him. To make the flying balloon, he needs #b100 #t4000035#s#k and #b10 #t4031164#s#k. Hope this works...

#t4000035# #b#c4000035##k/100
#t4031164# #b#c4031164##k/10
2084.2: I got the materials needed for #p1052106# to make the flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his "flying balloon" will indeed fly, but there's a chance that it may indeed work. I'll check up on him around the time when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
2084.name: Icarus and the Balloon

2085.0: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the flying balloon...maybe I should go check up on him at Kerning City.
2085.1: Icarus had failed to make the flying balloon, but his never-ending quest for flight remains. This time he wants to deviate from the scientific approach to flight and opts for the magical approach, and asks me to see his best friend #b#p1032106##k at Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently Wing the Fairy knows the way to make #b'#t4031163#'#k...I'll need to see that fairy at Ellinia for Icarus's sake.
2085.name: In search of Wing the Fairy

2086.1:
I meet Wing the Fairy at Ellinia, and he doesn't seem to like people in general. How is he best friends with Icarus in the first place?? Anyway, he says in order to make #b#t4031163##k, he'll need #b50 #t4000036#s#k and #b20 #t4031165#s#k. So that's all it takes?

#t4000036# #c4000036##k/50
#t4031165# #c4031165##k/20
2086.2: As Wing the Fairy asked, I got her mysterious medicine and leaves of witch grass. Could she make Flying Pill with these?
2086.name: The Ingredients for the Flying Pill

2087.1: #bWing the Fairy#k of Ellinia asked me to take the Flying Pill to Icarus. So this little pill is all it takes to fly? I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
2087.2: I got Icarus the Flying Pill that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.
2087.name: Delivering the Flying Pill

2088.0: I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
2088.1:
I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying the monsters and animals in general in Henesys. His bright smile and the easy-going demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding a clue on his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...

#t4000011# #b#c4000011##k/10 
#t4000001# #b#c4000001##k/40
2088.2: I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?
2088.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

2089.0: Whenever I walk past Wing the Fairy of Ellinia, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder what it is...
2089.1:
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I expect from someone in need of help. He asked me if I can get him 30 tree branches, 30 squishy liquids, and 10 slime bubbles. He needs them so he can make a potion for his homework. 

#t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/30 
#t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/30 
#t4000010# #b#c4000010##k/10

2090.0: I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
2090.1: I got to talk to Icarus of Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway? He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his set of questions.
2090.2: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
2090.name: I'm Bored 1

2091.0: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.

I answered all of Icarus's questions, but he still seemed bored out of his mind. He asked me if I could get him a toy that he could play around with. 

 #t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/40 
#t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/40
2091.2: I had fun playing around with Icarus.
2091.name: I'm Bored 2

2092.0: I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
2092.1: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however: She seems to be suffering from amnesia, Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played around while growing up, and asked me if I can give that to her.
2092.2: I found Ayan and gave her the toy sword.
2092.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
2092.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

2093.1: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from amnesia with the help of the toy sword. That's just amazing!!! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet up, but first, I got to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.
2093.2: I'm so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I'm even gladder that Bruce got to finally see his daughter again! What a moment...
2093.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
2093.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

2094.0: I heard something happened to the tribesmen of Perion. I should go talk to Ayan about this.
2094.1:
I met up with Ayan in Perion. She told me that a few days ago, a group of tribesmen went hunting in the swamps and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She was worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamps and asked me to take them out before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill #b250 #o3110100#s#k and #b40 #o2130103#s#k while taking #b20 #t4000034##k along the way.

#o3110100# #r#a20942##k
#o2130103# #r#a20941##k
#t4000034# #b#c4000034##k/20

2094.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1

2095.0: Ayan of Perion is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong??
2095.1:
I found Ayan, and she seemed to be in a state of panic. She was walking around the swamp when she ran into a bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators than the previous ones. She ran back to Perion and had been looking for me ever since, so I could help her out once more. This time, I'll need to kill #b120 #o5130103#s#k and take #b50 #t4000033#s#k along the way. 

#o5130103# #r#a20951##k
#t4000033# #b#c4000033##k/ 50
2095.2: I took out 120 #o5130103#s from the swamps, just like the way Ayan asked me to. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators before they spawn out of control.
2095.name: Taking Out the Alligators 2

2096.0: Apparently a strange vibe has been permeating deep inside the dungeon of Victoria Island. I should meet up with the Insignificant Being for details.

I need to gather up the items that the Insignificant Being needs to seal up the curse. The items are: 33 Wild Kargo's Spirit Rocks, 18 Tauromacis Spirit Rocks, and 18 Taurospear Spirit Rocks ...
