2099.0: Apparently, Camila of Henesys lost something...
2099.1: She was devastated that her friend, who lives far from here, sent her a letter, only to be stolen by the notorious Curse Eye's. She was crying as she asked me for help. I may have to find the letter for the sake of Camila, but where is that girl?\n\n#t4031239# #b#c4031239##k/1
2099.2: I recovered Camila's letter that had been stolen from the Curse Eye's. It should be fun writing letters to people far from me...
2099.name: Camila's Lost Letter
2099.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town...

2100.1: The letter that was sent to Camila was written by her pen pal, and it said she might not be able to write her again. Camila sensed something wrong might have happened to her friend, and asked me if I could visit her at Korean Folk Town, where she lived, and check on her.
2100.2: At Korean Folk Town, I was able to meet Camila's pen pal, Kong Ji. She looked ecstatic after I gave her Camila's reply letter.
2100.name: Two Ways to Get to Korean Folk Town
2100.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town...

21000.0: You hear someone scream from the ark, saying something about a kid that's gone missing. The ark can't leave until the kid's on board. What should you do?
21000.1: #p1209000# is pleading with you to find the child. The kid's apparently lost somewhere in the forest. She says you're the only one who even has a chance of succeeding... #bSo you'd better go into the forest and look for him!#k
21000.2: You barely managed to find the kid deep in the forest. You'd better take him back to the ark.
21000.name: Find the Missing Kid 1

21001.0: You barely managed to find the kid deep in the forest. You should take him back to the ark.
21001.1: You barely managed to find the kid deep in the forest. You should take him back to the ark.
21001.2: You barely managed to rescue the kid. There's not much time left! The ark must leave before the Black Mage attacks!
21001.name: Find the Missing Kid 2

2101.0: How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the sky?
2101.1: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be?
2101.2: Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from #bEllinia#k to #bOrbis#k, then to #bLudibrium#k? And once I get there, I'm supposed to walk my way down there through #bHelios Tower#k. That's pretty far...
2101.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Sky

21010.0: Where is this? What's going on? You don't even know who you are.
21010.1: #p1202001# seems to be really excited at having met a hero. A hero? Who…you? Judging from what #p1201000# is saying, maybe you really were a hero in your past life. But you have no recollection of it…
21010.2: Since drinking the potion, your HP recovered quite a bit. You still don't know what's going on, but considering how nicely everyone's been treating you, they must have good intentions. You should have no trouble going back to town now...
21010.name: The Return of the Hero
21010.rewardSummary: Go on to 'The Weapon That Disappeared' quest\r\n

21011.0: You should talk to #b#p1202002##k on your way back to town.
21011.1: #p1202002# tells you it's an honor to meet a real hero and pleads with you to say hello to his brother #b#p1202003##k, who's also eager to meet a hero.
21011.2: #p1202003# said that a true hero should never be without a weapon and gave you a sword. A hero without a weapon? Were you really a hero to begin with?
21011.name: The Missing Weapon

21012.0: You should talk to #b#p1202004##k, standing on the road to town.
21012.1: #p1202004# says that it makes perfect sense that you don't know how to hold a weapon, since you've lost your memory. He then tells you that maybe battling a monster would jog your memory and asks you to defeat #r#o9300383##k. You wonder if you can do it.
21012.2: You defeated #o9300383#, but it hasn't jogged any memories. You have a feeling that your skills and abilities were lost, just like your memories. What kind of a hero are you if you have no abilities?
21012.name: Abilities Lost

21013.0: You should talk to #b#p1202005##k, standing on the road to town.
21013.1: #p1202005# confesses that he's always wanted to build one particular gift for a hero and that he's stored all the necessary components in a box. He asks you to break open the box and bring him the items inside. Break boxes by swinging at them with regular attacks, then collect the #b#t4032309##k and #b#t4032310##k.
21013.2: You received a chair from #p1202005#. #p1202005# encouraged you by telling you that you are still a hero even though you've lost your powers.
21013.name: A Gift for the Hero

21014.0: Now that you're safely in town, you should listen to #b#p1201000#'s#k account of what happened in the past, and how you became a hero in the first place.
21014.1: According to #p1201000#, a few hundred years ago, a group of #bheroes#k valiantly fought against the #rBlack Mage#k who controlled Maple World. Apparently, you're one of them. But because of the Black Mage's curse, you lost your memories and abilities, and was frozen in ice until you were awakened recently.
21014.2: According to #p1201000#, a few hundred years ago, a group of #bheroes#k valiantly fought against the #rBlack Mage#k, who controlled Maple World. Apparently, you're one of them. But because of the Black Mage's curse, you lost your memories and abilities, and was frozen in ice until you were awakened recently.
21014.name: Lilin's Account

21015.0: #p1201000#'s debriefing allowed you to understand the gist of what happened between the heroes and the Black Mage. You have a hunch there may be another showdown with the Black Mage down the road, and that you'll be an important part of it. You should see what #b#p1201000##k thinks you should do next.
21015.1: #p1201000# tells you that you'll have to do everything you can to regain your abilities. First, however she suggests you warm up, seeing how you were frozen in ice for hundreds of years. The first level of basic training is monster hunting. You'd better head to #b#m140020000##k and start hunting.
21015.2: You were able to defeat the #o0100131#s.
21015.name: Basic Fitness Training 1

21016.0: Basic Training continues. If you want to start the second stage of Basic Training, you should talk to #b#p1201000##k.
21016.1: #p1201000# says that this time you have to go to #b#m140020100##k and defeat some #r#o0100132#s#k. Come to think of it, #p1201000# seems different from the time you first saw her, back when she had that mystical aura about her...
21016.name: Basic Fitness Training 2

21017.0: Basic Training continues. If you want to start the third stage of Basic Training, you should talk to #b#p1201000##k.
21017.1: #p1201000# wants to step up the intensity of the training and asks you to defeat #b#o0100133#s#k. This is getting more intense, but when you mentioned that to #p1201000#, your protests were ignored. Shoot, you'd better just head over to #b#m140020200##k.
21017.name: Basic Fitness Training 3

21018.0: You think you have gained some much needed stamina through training. You should talk to #b#p1201000##k and receive the test for the final stage of your Basic Fitness Training.
21018.1: #p1201000# told you battle #r#o0100134#s#k.  This time, you need to head to the other side, to the west side of town where #b#m140010200##k is. Fortunately, that doesn't seem too hard.
21018.2: You eliminated the #o0100134#s. You can see how much your stamina and power have improved. What next?
21018.name: Basic Fitness Test
