2158.0: Riel, Rael and Roel starts betting on who will be offered to King Clang. The winner gets to be the sacrifice! How can I help these girls get to their senses? Let's first meet with #bRiel#k.
2158.1: Riel secretly asks to help her win the bet. Her deal is to defeat #r50 King Clangs#k. How do I get myself into these situations? I'd better help her with this, and then talk about how ridiculous this bet is.\n\n#o4230104# #r#a21581##k
2158.2: Defeated all King Clangs for Riel.
2158.name: Helping Riel

2159.0: Riel, Rael and Roel starts betting on who will be offered to King Clang. The winner gets to be the sacrifice! How can I help these girls get to their senses? Let's meet with #bRoel#k.
2159.1: Roel looks just like Riel but with a tougher attitude! Her dare was to take out #r50 Lorangs#k. Roel asks me to help her win the bet. I'd better help her with this, and then talk about how ridiculous this bet is. \n\n#o3230102# #r#a21591##k
2159.name: Helping Roel

2160.0: Riel, Rael and Roel starts betting on who will be offered to King Clang. The winner gets to be the sacrifice! How can I help these girls get to their senses? Let's meet with #bRael#k.
2160.1: Shy Rael says her dare was to take out #r50 Torties#k. She doesn't look like a person who'd participate in this kind of bet. Looks can be deceiving. Rael hesitates to ask me to help, but I'd better get this over with and take out those Torties. Then I'll talk about how ridiculous this bet is.\n\n#o4130101# #r#a21601##k
2160.name: Helping Rael

21600.0: #b#p1202007##k, a penguin from #b#m140000000##k, apparently has something to tell you.
21600.1: #p1202007# says that one of the 'huskies' he was tending was actually a wolf. He doesn't know exactly what happened, but he doesn't want to abandon the infant wolf pup. He wants you to ask around for some tips on how to raise a wolf. Somewhere around Aqua Road, you know that #b#p2060000##k knows a little something about raising wolves...
21600.2: You were able to meet #p2060000# at #m230010201# of Aqua Road.
21600.name: Pucci's Request

21601.0: You should ask #b#p2060000##k of #b#m230010201##k about how to raise a wolf.
21601.1:
#p2060000# says that she knows a bit about raising wolves and tells you that she will make #bWolf Pup Formula#k for the weakened baby wolf. The ingredients for the formula include #b#t4000157##k, which can be found on seals, and #t4032331#, which #b#p2060005##k sells.

#i4000157# #t4000157# #b#c4000157# / 50#k
#i4032331# #t4032331# #b#c4032331# / 1#k
21601.2: Armed with all the ingredients, #p2060000# asked you to wait while she finishes making the #t4032332#.
21601.name: Formula for Your Wolf Pup

21602.0: You should head to the t#b#m230000003# of #m230000000##k and purchase some #t4032331# from #b#p2060005##k.
21602.1: #t4032331# costs 10 million mesos. It's a lot to pay, but you gladly pay it, knowing it's what's best for the wolf pup.\r\n\r\n#b10 million mesos#k
21602.name: Kenta's Wolf Pup Formula

21603.0: Is the #t4032332# ready? You should talk to #b#p2060000##k of #b#m230010201##k.
21603.1: You receive the completed #t4032332# from #p2060000#. This should be enough to raise the Wolf Pup for a bit. You should head to #b#m140000000##k right away and give #b#p1202007##k the formula. Pucci is probably waiting somewhere around the #bSnowy Field 2#k.
21603.2: Having finished the formula, the Wolf Pup seemed to have taken a liking toward you. #p1202007# ended up giving you the wolf pup, which he named #t1902015#, to raise. You vow to take good care of him.
21603.name: Ryko the Wolf Pup

21604.0: It looks like there are a couple of people who know how to handle Wolf Pups. You should head over to #b#m211000000##k and talk to #b#p2020007##k.
21604.1: #p2020007# has taught you the basics of mounting a wolf! With this, you'll be able to move around faster since you can ride on the wolf's back. Plus you gain valuable bonding time with your wolf. You'll have to gather materials for a saddle, since you won't be able to ride your wolf without one.\r\n\r\n#i4000048# #t4000048# #b#c4000048# / 50#k
21604.2: You received the #t1912011# and Mount Skill from #p2020007#. You'll be able to roam through the entire world with this.
21604.name: Wolf Mount

21605.0: #t1902015# is missing! What should you do? You'd better go to #b#m140000000##k and ask #b#p1202007##k what to do.
21605.1: #p1202007# says that #t1902015# returned to him in tears and chastised you for not taking better care of it. He then tells you that you need to buy some medication in order to restore poor, weakened #t1902015#'s health.\r\n\r\n#b20,000,000 mesos#k
21605.2: You were able to get #t1902015# back. You promise to never, ever lose it again.
21605.name: The Missing Wolf

21606.0: You've lost your #t1912011#! What should you do?
21606.1:
#p2020007# tells you to gather materials to make another #t1912011# and to also pay a service fee of #b10 million mesos#k for the replacement. What?!

#b10,000,000 mesos#k
#i4000048# #t4000048# #b#c4000048# / 50#k
21606.2: After paying the huge service fee and gathering all the materials, you received another #t1912011# from #p2020007#. Better not lose it again!
21606.name: The Missing Saddle

21607.0: #b#p1202007##k, a penguin from #b#m140000000##k, wants to talk to you about something.
21607.1:
According to the data #p1202007# has studied, wolves go through a kind of puberty during their adolescent years. They say that if you don't take special care of wolves during this time, they might not grow properly! #p1202007# then mentions that in order to raise #t1902015# well, you should ask advice from some veterans of wolf-raising.

#y21608# #b(#u21608#)#k
#y21610# #b(#u21610#)#k
21607.2: After listening to everyone's advice on how to raise a wolf, you noticed that your #t1902016# had grown a bit. You need to take good care of your wolf now that it is going through puberty.
21607.name: The Adolescent Wolf

21608.0: Since adolescent #t1902015# is now going through puberty, you decide to visit #b#p2060000##k in #b#m230010201##k and ask for some good advice.
21608.1:
#p2060000# tells you, when raising an adolescent wolf, it is an absolute must that the wolf be well-fed. She suggests that you make special formula specifically designed for adolescent wolves. #p2060000# volunteers to make some for you. Just gather the ingredients for her.

#i4000182# #t4000182# #b#c4000182# / 200#k
#i4000183# #t4000183# #b#c4000183# / 200#k
#i4000184# #t4000184# #b#c4000184# / 200#k
#i4032333# #t4032333# #b#c4032333# / 1#k
21608.2: You brought the ingredients to #p2060000# and she worked her magic to create some special formula for adolescent wolves.
21608.name: Nanuke's Advice

21609.0: You've decided to prepare a bowl of Adolescent Wolf Vitamins for #t1902015#. Head to #b#m230000003##k to buy ingredients from #b#p2060005##k.
21609.1: #p2060005# claims to have the vitamins necessary for Adolescent Wolves and agrees to sell them to you for 40 million mesos. *Sigh* It's a lot of money, but you should buy them for the sake of your wolf's health and well-being.\r\n\r\n#b40,000,000 mesos#k
21609.2: You paid 40 million mesos and bought some of Adolescent Wolf Vitamins from #p2060005#.
21609.name: Kenta's Adolescent Wolf Vitamins

2161.1: Complaining Riel soon lightens up and says that a brave warrior must appear to rescue the beautiful girl in distress. Therefore, she asks me to take the role of the warrior and defeat King Clang. What have I done to get myself into these situations!? I'm not the warrior type, but the least I can do is help defeat #rKing Clang#k. \n\n#o5220000# #r#a21611##k
2161.2: Defeated King Clang and came back to Riel. Riel joyfully says that a brave warrior saved her. It really wasn't for her sake, but Florina Beach is finally back to its peaceful state.
2161.name: A brave Warrior to defeat King Clang appears!

21610.0: Since adolescent #t1902015# is going through puberty, you should visit #b#p2020007##k of #b#m211000000##k and ask for some good advice.
21610.1: #p2020007# says that Wolf Pups need to freely run around fields every once in a while and introduces you to a great spot. Head to #m921110000#, located past the #bWolf-Shaped Rock#k in #b#m211050000##k, and let your pup get some exercise running around the field.
21610.2: You and your wolf ran across the Field of Wolves and got some good exercise. #t1902015# seemed to have really enjoyed the experience.
21610.name: Scadur's Advice

21611.0: The wolf that you lost, then recovered, seems to have decreased in size and has quite an attitude too. What should you do? Better head to #b#m140000000##k and talk to #b#p1202007##k.
21611.1: According to #p1202007#, a wolf who has lost its way is often unable to get over its trauma, to the point where it shrinks and even acquires a rebellious attitude. The owner, apparently, needs to re-teach the wolf some life lessons. They say you need to invest in some educational expenses...\r\n\r\n#b80,000,000 mesos#k
21611.2: You paid the educational fees and let the wolf just enjoy himself for once. Fortunately, the wolf seemed to be back to normal size.
21611.name: Rebellious Wolf

21612.0: #b#p1202007##k, the penguin from #b#m140000000##k, wants to have a word with you.
21612.1: A pack of wolves apparently paid a visit to #m140000000# in search of #t1902016#. It must be the family that #t1902016# lost as a pup. You should meet #b#p1202008##k and ask why they're here all of a sudden. #p1202008# is waiting at #m914030000##k, which can be accessed through #b#m140010100#.
21612.name: A Visit from the Wolf Herd

21613.0: You need to go see the pack of wolves that are here to meet #t1902016#. They are apparently waiting at #b#m914030000##k, which is connected to #b#m140010100##k.
21613.1: #p1202008# thanked you for raising their baby pup, but demanded that you return #t1902016# to them. When you told them you weren't interested in returning him, the wolf decided to give you a test to see if you're worthy of raising a wolf. Now you just need to eliminate all the #o9300354#s #p1202008# has summoned.
21613.2: You passed the test, but #p1202008# still seems to want a word with you...
21613.name: The Wolves' Test

21614.0: According to #p1202008#, #t1902016# will be in grave danger if you leave it as it is right now. What does that mean? You'd better ask #b#p1202008##k.
21614.1: #p1202008# introduced themselves as Silver Wolves, and told you that all Silver Wolves must drink #b#t4032334##k in order to properly grow into adulthood. Otherwise, these adolescent wolves' lives may be in danger. You should gather the ingredients and use the Maker Skill to make #t4032334#!\r\n\r\n#i4032334# #t4032334# #b#c4032334# / 1#k
21614.2: You made some #t4032334# and had your #t1902016# drink it. Armed with a stronger heart, #t1902016# has successfully transformed into an adult wolf.
21614.name: A Wolf's Heart

21615.0: One of the ingredients for the #t4032334# is the #t4032335#. Maybe #b#p2060005##k at the #b#m230000003# of #m230000000##k sells it? You'd better go see #p2060005#.
21615.1: #p2060005# tells you that the #t4032335# that was given by the wolves living in #m230000003# is available, but only at a price. She says it'll cost you 80 million mesos.\r\n\r\n#b80,000,000 mesos#k
21615.2: You purchased the #t4032335# from #p2060005#. You'll use it to make some #t4032334#.
21615.name: Gathering Ingredients for the Wolf's Life Water

21616.0: You may have lost, then found your #t1902017#, but you wish to raise it in a healthy environment. What should you do? You'd better head over to #b#m914030000##k of #b#m140000000##k and see #b#p1202008##k.
21616.1: #p1202008# was angry to see that one of his kids was not raised with respect and gave you a tongue-lashing. He then ordered you to make another #t4032334#...\r\n\r\n#i4032334# #t4032334# #b#c4032334# / 1#k
21616.2: You made another #t4032334# and with that,you were able to raise #t1902017# into an adult wolf. You promise to never, ever lose your wolf again.
21616.name: The Chief Wolf's Rage

21617.0: You need to make the #t4032334# again.  You know #b#p2060005##k in the #b#m230000003# of #m230000000##k sells this so you'd better go see #p2060005# for another #t4032335#.
21617.1: #p2060005# tells you it'll cost you 100 million mesos to buy the #t4032335# because the supply has become more limited since the last time you purchased it.\r\n\r\n#b100 million mesos#k
21617.2: You paid #p2060005# 100 million mesos and purchased the #t4032335#... You'd better make some #t4032334# right now.
21617.name: Reacquiring the Life Water Ingredients

21618.0: #b#p1201002##k wants to talk to you about something...
21618.1: #p1201002# says that he's noticed a formidable force surrounding you and tells you to come see him because he wants to find out what it is. You'd better head over to #b#m140000000##k right now.
21618.2: #t1902017#, the Silver Wolf, apparently grows with its master. The wolf is able to go through an awakening to get a whole new look once it gains enough strength from its master. This seems to explain your #p1201002#'s transformation into a #t1902018#.
21618.name: The Wolf's Evolution

2162.0: I found a letter in the trash, all crumpled up in a ball. It looked like someone was in the middle of writing the letter when they decided to throw it away...It's hard to read what's written there because of all the creases everywhere, but I think I see the name ''Athena Pierce'' faintly across the page. I wonder if I can find the person to whom this letter belongs?
2162.1: While I was trying to read the letter, Muirhat approached me with a suspicious look and started asking why I am reading Kyrin's letter. I told him that I had found it in the trash, and to that, he asked if I would be interested in delivering Kyrin's letter to #bAthena Pierce#k in #bHenesys#k.
2162.2: I've delivered the letter to Athena Pierce as Muirhat had asked me to.
2162.name: The Half-written Letter

2163.1: I wonder how Kyrin and Athena Pierce know each other? Let me see what Athena Pierce has to say about that.
2163.2: How surprising! Athena Pierce and Kyrin used to be practically family! I had no idea that the two had such a deep history.
2163.name: Athena Pierce's Smile

2164.1: I'd better hurry and bring this orgel to Kyrin who is onboard on The Nautilus waiting for me, especially for Athena Pierce's sake who is dying to see Kyrin. Anyhow, it's amazing how deeply their fates are intertwined...
2164.2: I've delivered the orgel to Kyrin per Athena Pierce's request. Kyrin seemed so happy- I guess it was a good thing that I picked up the letter from the trash after all?
2164.name: Athena Pierce's Gift

2165.0: There's apparently a mysterious dolphin in the corridors of the  Nautilus' lower deck. Seems very strange... What would a dolphin be doing out of the water and onboard a ship?
2165.1: The mysterious dolphin is claiming that he is actually a Whalian prince and  that he can't transform back to being a Prince because he is low on mana. Perhaps I should go find a bottle of #bmana elixir#k for the Whalian Prince?
2165.2: Finally, the Whalian Prince has been replenished with mana. I thought he was just an ordinary dolphin... I mean, who would have known that he could turn out to be such a handsome prince?
2165.name: The Prince's Request

2166.1: I can't believe that The Nautilus' power is generated by this mystical Shining Stone... That's pretty interesting, I must say. I wonder what the Shining Stone looks like. I should go check out the stone in #bThe Nautilus' Generator Room#k.
2166.2: While I was touching the Shining Stone, I could actually feel the stone's mystical powers traveling through my entire body.
2166.name: Shining Stone

2167.0: Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, hanging out on the lower deck of The Nautilus, says he's got another problem. Let me see what he has to say.
2167.1: Sharyl, the Prince of Whales tells me some mystical story about a Sea Firefly. I guess there are many other mystical objects on The Nautilus besides the Shining Stone? Anyway, according to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, the mystical Sea Firefly's powers are diminishing, which is making him worried. I'd better help Sharyl, the Prince of Whales by going to the #bMuse#k of the #bAquarium#k to fill the magic flask with some  #bVigor of the Sea#k.
2167.2: I went to see the Muse who filled the magic flask with the Vigor of the Sea.
2167.name: Sea Firefly1

2168.0: Shouldn't I be getting the bottle back from the Muse and heading back to The Nautilus?
2168.1: The Muse gave back the magic flask to me, filled with the Vigor of the Sea. I'd better get the bottle to #bSharyl, the Prince of Whales#k right away, before it starts getting dark.
2168.2: As the Vigor of the Sea is unleashed in The Nautilus, the overall atmosphere turns bright. But why is it that Sharyl, the Prince of Whales is blushing while saying that Kyrin should be so happy?
2168.name: Sea Firefly2

2169.0: Apparently Sharyl, the Prince of Whales has yet another problem. Should I go find out what it is?
2169.1: Sharyl, the Prince of Whales claims that he had left a #bMother of Pearl#k in The Nautilus' #bGenerator Room#k a long time ago. He thinks that there must be a #bLarge Pearl#k in there by now, and wants me to go get the pearl to take to Kyrin. I wonder why Sharyl, the Prince of Whales wants to give the pearl to Kyrin?  Anyway, I should remember to beware of #bMuirhat#k while I'm on my way. The Prince warned me to watch out!  \n\n#i4031843##t4031843# #b#c4031843##k / 1
2169.2: Just as I am about to enter the Captain's cabin, Muirhat appears and stands in front of the door, blocking my way. He says that Sharyl, the Prince of Whales must give up hope, and wants me to hand over the pearl! Then he tells me to comfort Sharyl, the Prince of Whales if I see him again... Stay strong, dear Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.
2169.name: The Large Pearl

2170.0: Do you know Rolonay, the smartest genius alive in all of The Nautilus? He is possibly the smartest person in all of Maple World. But he's apparently stuck in a jam, because of all the requests he's been getting from people asking for more and more information. I'd better give Rolonay a hand- But first, I should go see him in the central corridors of The Nautilus.
2170.1: Rolonay's been working hard to compile all the information #bDr. Kim#k had requested, but says he's too tied up with all the analysis he has to do, to bring the research documents all the way to the Omega Sector. I should help out Rolonay and bring all the research documents to the Omega Sector for him.
2170.2: I've delivered all the research documents to Dr. Kim, on Rolonay's behalf. That Rolonay, despite his looks, is quite a brainiac!
2170.name: Information for Dr. Kim

21700.0: You discovered that you were a hero that used to wield a Polearm, and just like that, you started to remember a number of your former skills. Your recovered skills are far from optimal, but... You should report this to #b#p1201000##k anyway.
21700.1: #p1201000# seems amazed that you was able to recover so many of your abilities and urges you to start training seriously. She then recommends that you go see #b#p1202006# the Penguin Master#k, an old penguin that's studied the intricacies of various hero skills. He's located in the west side of town at #m140010100#.
21700.name: New Beginnings

21701.0: You certainly have doubts, but you'll give #b#p1202006##k the benefit of the doubt and receive some training from him.
21701.1: According to #p1202006#, the first training lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300341#s#k. He makes it seem like it's some huge hurdle but they don't sound too difficult.\r\n\r\n#o9300341##r #a217011##k
21701.2: You eliminated the #o9300341#s with ease. Judging from how enthusiastic #p1202006# reacted, you are even less inclined to trust him.
21701.name: Train or Die! 1

21702.0: You still don't trust this #b#p1202006##k, but you might as well receive some training from him.
21702.1: According to #p1202006#, the second lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300342#s#k. Again, he still makes it sound like it's some huge hurdle, but again, they don't sound very tough.\r\n\r\n#o9300342##r #a217021##k
21702.2: You defeated the #o9300342#s with ease! #p1202006# may be giving you words of encouragement, but his words are worth very little.
21702.name: Train or Die! 2

21703.0: This #b#p1202006##k is so full of it, but you might as well receive more training from him.
21703.1: According to #p1202006#, the third lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300343#s#k. He says it's a terribly scary monster to fight, but seriously, how scary could a #o1210100# be, really... \r\n\r\n#o9300343##r #a217031##k
21703.2: You finished off the #o9300343#s without breaking a sweat! #p1202006# then tells you he's taught you everything that he knows about combat and says that you can go back down the mountain. What…?! You're not even standing on a mountain!
21703.name: Train or Die! 3

21704.0: After receiving some lessons from #p1202006#, you remembered the Combo Ability skill! You'd better relay this to #b#p1201000##k.
21704.1: #p1201000# says you were probably able to regain your memories of the skill because you swung your polearm around just like how you did in the past. Muscle memory, or something. She seems confident that the more you train, the stronger you will become and the more skills you will remember.
21704.2: The small step of remembering the Combo Ability skill has opened a world of possibilities for you. You now have the confidence to continue training in the hope of one day returning to your old, heroic self.
21704.name: Baby Steps

21705.0: Your training continues. You must keep progressing until the Black Mage is defeated once and for all. You should ask #b#p1201000##k what to do next.
21705.1:
#p1201000# says you can only train so much in #m140000000# and suggests you venture to #bVictoria Island#k. She directs you to an ally of hers, #b#p1002104# the Information Dealer#k, in #b#m104000004##k.\r\n\r\nIn order to reach #m104000000#, you must leave #m140000000# by boarding a ship. From town, head to your right and continue past the snow-covered field to arrive at a small port operated by penguins. 
Once there, talk to #b#p1200003##k to board the ship.
21705.2: #p1002104# the Information Dealer was once a resident of #m140000000# eagerly awaiting the Hero's revival, but he eventually lost hope and left town. He's a distant cousin of #p1201000#. He must have felt bad about leaving #p1201000# all by herself, because he promised to help #p1002104# anytime she needed it.
21705.name: To Victoria Island

21706.0: You should start training in Victoria Island and ask #bthe Information Dealer of #m104000000##k, named #b#p1002104##k, for some help.
21706.1: #p1002104# tells you there's no better way to learn the inner workings of the world than to be an Information Dealer, and he offers you a position working with him. #p1002104# then gives you a simple quest to introduce you to the roles of an Information Dealer and informant. The quest involves finding out the latest rumors the crewmembers of #b#p1002001##k have been talking about.\r\n\r\n#y21707# #b(#u21706#)#k
21706.2: You relayed to #p1002104# all the rumors you heard from #p1002001#. You guess this is the type of thing that informants do all the time.
21706.name: An Information Dealer's Work

21707.0: For the time being, you're working as an informant for #p1002104#. Your first task is to approach #b#p1002001##k and ask about any rumors circulating among the crewmembers.
21707.1:
#p1002001# tells you that revealing a rumor is no big deal, but he'll only do it under one condition. Turns out he wants some snail shells to treat his arthritis. Fair enough. The area surrounding #m104000000# is infested with snails, so this shouldn't be hard. 

#i4000019# #t4000019# #b#c4000019# / 10#k
#i4000000# #t4000000# #b#c4000000# / 10#k
#i4000016# #t4000016# #b#c4000016# / 10#k
21707.2: You gave him all the #t4000019#s, and in return, he told you that the crew is currently stressed about the certain revival of the Black Mage. You'd better relay this bit of info to #p1002104#.
21707.name: Teo's Information

21708.0: Now that you have an idea of what an informant does, it's time to get your hands dirty. #b#p1002104##k will tell you what to do.
21708.1: Your first information gathering assignment is to find out why the #o1210102#s near #m100000000# have started acting so wildly. They're usually so tame! #p1002104# tells you to ask the mushroom monster scholar about the occurrence and see if he can shed some light on what's been going on. #b#p1012111##k can be found in #b#m100000000##k.
21708.name: Your First Informant Assignment

21709.0: This is your first assignment as an informant. You're here to ask #b#p1012111##k in #b#m100000000##k about possible causes of the #o1210102#'s strange behavior.
21709.1: #p1012111# says that you must observe how the #o1210102#s have changed, and see if they've grown new sets of horns. You should eliminate the #r#o1210102#s#k and look for the #b#t4032314#s#k.\r\n\r\n#i4032314# #t4032314# #b#c4032314# / 30#k
21709.2: You brought the #t4032314#s you found to #p1012111#. He says he's going to start studying the horns and asked you to come back later.
21709.name: Check Out the Orange Mushroom

2171.0: Baine's job is to monitor the sound waves of The Nautilus. The way the ship sounds is a good indicator of the overall well-being of the ship. Recently, Baine had apparently detected a strange sound coming through the walls on the lower deck. Could this be an ominous sign of things to come?
2171.1: When Baine detects the strange sound waves coming from The Nautilus, he asks #bBart#k, the  #bkeeper of the Watchtower#k, whether he's noticed any changes in sight. The watchtower is apparently on the eastern end of the shipping dock so I'd better look around carefully.
2171.2: Bart says that he's noticed some strange movements. I wonder what he saw?
2171.name: Can you please give Baine a helping hand?
2171.parent: A mysterious entity onboard The Nautilus

21710.0: This is your first assignment as an informant. You wonder if #p1012111# of #m100000000# has been able to poinpoint the cause of the #o1210102#'s recent changes yet. Maybe you should go ask #p1012111# right now.
21710.1: #p1012111# says that the reason for the #o1210102#'s strange behavior may be the ongoing conflict, and a potential war, between the #o1210102#s and the #o1210100#s. He asks you to look into the #o1210100#s as well and to gather #b50 #t4032340#s#k to aid his research...\r\n\r\n#i4032340# #t4032340# #b#c4032340# / 50#k
21710.2: #p1012111#, who studied the #t4032340#s, came to the conclusion that the #o1210100#s are not properly prepared for combat, which of course threw out the whole theory of a possible monster war. He then asked you to stop by later since he'd like some time to come up with another hypothetical theory to explain this mess.
21710.name: A Monster War?

21711.0: This is your first assignment as an informant. You're hopeful that this time #p1012111# of #b#m100000000##k has found the cause of the #o1210102#s' strange change in behavior. You'd better go talk to #b#p1012111##k.
21711.1:
#p1012111# says that #ra cynical group of #o1210102##ks was seen hanging around #m100000000#. He thinks they may have influenced the regular #o1210102#s as well. He then instructs you to eliminate #r50 #o9300274#s#k and give him #banything you find that might be considered odd#k...

#o9300274##r #a217111##k
#i4032315# #t4032315# #b#c4032315# / 1#k
21711.2: You eliminated the #o9300274# and brought back the #t4032315# for #p1012111#. He found it unusual and asked you to wait while he gives it a detailed analysis.
21711.name: Enter the Cynical Orange Mushrooms!

21712.0: Since this is your first assignment as an informant, you are eager to find out whether #p1012111# of #b#m100000000##k has solved the mystery behind the #t4032315#. Go visit #b#p1012111##k and find out.
21712.1: #p1012111# says he discovered a faint noise coming out of the #t4032315#, which only #o1210102#s can hear, and that's what's been causing their aggressive behavior. In other words, #bthe #r#o1210102#s' behavior is all because of a puppet#k! Now that you have this case pretty much wrapped up, your should report the info to #b#p1002104##k.
21712.2: You notified #p1002104# about the cause of the strange behavior among the #o1210102#s, which officially concluded your first ever assignment as an informant. You should probably spend some time leveling up and training yourself now.
21712.name: First Assignment, Completed!

21713.0: You have reached Level 18, which means #p1002104# will give you your second assigment as an informant. Head over to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k.
21713.1: The second assignment involves dealing with the suddenly-violent #o1110100#s. Seems quite similar to the first assigment... You should head over to #b#m101000000##k and meet with #b#p1032101##k to discuss the cause of the #o1110100#s' distress.
21713.name: Your Second Informant Assignment

21714.0: This is your second assignment as an informant and you need to ask #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k why the #o1110100#s have suddenly turned so aggressive.
21714.1:
#p1032101# says she's heard that a lot of monsters have been going crazy and that they all seem to have something in common: their strange behavior is tied to an odd puppet. Maybe this too is tied to the puppet? You should eliminate the #r#o1110130#s#k and find a #b#o1110100# puppet#k if you can.

#o1110130##r #a217141##k
#i4032316# #t4032316# #b#c4032316# / 1#k
21714.2: You gave #p1032101# the #t4032316#. #p1032101# seemed shocked that the rumors were actually true and wanted to find out who was responsible for placing a puppet on the #o1110100#s.
21714.name: Green Mushrooms

21715.0: This is your second assignment as an informant and the question remains, who planted the puppet on the #o1110100#s? Talk to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k for some answers.
21715.1: #p1032101# believes that #b#p1032112##k in #m100040000# may have witnessed someone placing a puppet on a #o1110100# and tells you to ask the tree.
21715.2: #p1032112# stated that recently a little kid was seen carrying puppets in the South Forest. Since then, the #o1110100#s have gotten much more aggressive.
21715.name: Tree Witness

21716.0: This is your second assignment as an informant and you must relay #p1032112#'s eyewitness account to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k.
21716.1: #p1032101# is sure that the changes happening to the #o1110100#s is connected with the kid carrying the puppets and tells you to be extra cautious. Now that this case is pretty much wrapped up, you should relay the information to #b#p1002104##k.
21716.2: You told #p1002104# why the #o1110100#s have become so aggressive, and that concluded your second assignment as an informant. But you wonder, will the fairies be able to watch over the forest all by themselves?
21716.name: Second Assignment, Completed!

21717.0: You wonder how #p1032101# is doing overseeing the forest. You feel like you should head to #b#m101000000##k to see her.
21717.1:
It seems like the kid with the puppets was once again seen in #m100040000#. Time to eliminate the #r#o1110100#s#k so you can retrieve the #bpuppet#k. 


Regardless of Personality #o9101000##r #a217171##k
#i4032317##t4032317# #b#c4032317# / 1#k
21717.2: You defeated the #o1110100#s and retrieve the #t4032316#, but you were unable to apprehend the actual criminal. Hopefully the kid will show up again…
21717.name: Rowen's Request 1

21718.0: You should talk to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k and see if the puppet-toting kid has made any more appearances in the South Forest.
21718.1:
#p1032101# says that the kid with the puppet has showed up once again in #m100040003# and wants you to eliminate the #o1110100#s and retrieve the puppet yet again.


Regardless of Personality #o9101000##r #a217181##k
#i4032318# #t4032318# #b#c4032318# / 1#k
21718.2: You defeated the #o1110100# and retrieved the #t4032318#. So far, you've managed to foil the kid's plan times times. Perhaps the kid'll give up now…?
21718.name: Rowen's Request 2

21719.0: A mysterious figure starts talking to you…
21719.1: When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave...is the kid with the puppets! So that's the kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000# and #m101000000#? Talk to the kid and see what's up.
21719.2: When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave...is the kid with the puppets! So that's the kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000# and #m101000000#? Talk to the kid and see what's up.
21719.name: The Puppeteer's Invitation

2172.1: Let me take Bart's status report to #bBaine#k.
2172.2: I've delivered Bart's report to Baine. By the look on Baine's face, it seems that there's something fishy going on.
2172.name: What is it that Bart saw?
2172.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

21720.0: What would #p1002104# say about the Black Wings? You should talk to #b#p1002104##k, the Information Dealer in #b#m104000000##k, and find out.
21720.1: He tells you that the Black Wings are an organization conspiring to resurrect the Black Mage and says that this information must be relayed to #b#p1201000##k as well, so he wants you to let #p1201000# know about the situation.  In the mean time, Tru plans on utilizing his network as an Information Dealer to gather as much information on the Black Wings as possible.
21720.2: #p1201000# thought that the fact that an organization like the Black Wings even exists...means that the Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. She encouraged you to train that much harder to regain your old, heroic form. She then taught you a skill called #bPolearm Booster#k which she she learned by poring over an ancient document!
21720.name: The Puppeteer's Warning

21721.0: You have now reached Level 23, which means #p1002104# will soon be giving you your third assignment as an informant. You should head to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k.
21721.1: #p1002104# suspects that the #o1140100# case in #m102000000# is similar to the ones in #m100000000# and #m101000000# and asks you to gather some information related to the present case. To get the details, you have to head over to #b#m102000000##k and talk to #b#p1103004##k...
21721.name: Your Third Informant Assignment

21722.0: This is your third assignment as an informant and this one involves studying the strange-acting #o1140130#s with #p1103004# in #b#m102000000##k. You'd better go talk to #b#p1103004##k.
21722.1: #p1103004# seems to already know that the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior was caused by a puppet and tells you to enter #m101030101# to defeat #r100 #o1140130#s#k and retrieve #o1140130#'s puppet. She also says that if you can't find the puppet even after eliminating 100, you should just come back to see her...\r\n\r\nRegardless of Personality #o9101002##r #a217221##k
21722.2: You defeated 100 #o1140130#s but didn't find any puppets. #p1103004# told you that #o1140130#'s puppet has been detected nearby and that something seems very wrong…
21722.name: Ghost Stumps

21723.0: This is your third assignment as an informant and you're at #b#m102000000##k with #p1103004#, investigating the causes of the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior. You should talk to #b#p1103004##k.
21723.1: #p1103004# tells you that the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior was caused by a puppet, but the puppet is not necessarily on the #o1140130#s' bodies, but somewhere outside. You should search the #bPile of Relics#k in #b#m101030101##k and find the #b#t4032319##k.\r\n\r\n#i4032319# #t4032319# #b#c4032319# / 5#k
21723.2: You retrieved all of the #t4032319#s. #p1103004# seemed genuinely shocked that the puppets were used for such a purpose and told you she'd have to write a report on this. A report? What report?
21723.name: Find the Puppet

21724.0: This is your third assignment as an informant and this one involves investigating the suddenly-erratic #o1140130#s in #b#m102000000##k. With the help of #p1103004#, you were able to locate the cause of the madness. The case seems to be nearing its end. You should talk to #b#p1103004##k.
21724.1: #p1103004# says that the puppet doesn't necessarily have to be on a monster's body, it's enough just to be near a monster. She says that she will take measures to beef up security so the kid with the puppet can't get close to #m102000000# ever again. This concludes the case, and you are going to send the information to #b#p1002104##k.
21724.2: You updated #p1002104# on what happened in #m102000000#, which concluded your third assignment as an informant.
21724.name: Third Assignment, Completed!

21725.0: After the #o1140130# case closed, #p1103004# still seems to need you for something. You wonder what. Better go talk to #b#p1103004##k and find out.
21725.1: #p1103004# thanks you for helping her solve the mystery, but tells you she has a little predicament: She can't leave her post to submit her report! She wonders if you could deliver the report to her boss for her. So your task is to deliver the #t4032320# to #b#p1101002##k in #b#m130000000##k.
21725.2: You delivered the report to #p1101002# and received a reward. You noticed that he had a very peculiar way of speaking which, to you, seemed totally inappropriate yet absolutely proper in tone. It reminded you of someone…
21725.name: 10 Boogies's Request

21726.0: You have now reached Level 28, which means #p1002104# will be giving you your fourth assignment as an informant today. Head to #b#m104000000##k and meet with #b#p1002104##k.
21726.1: Many reports have been filed concerning a bunch of depressed #o2230101#s in #m105040300#. This has to be the work of the puppeteer. Head over to #b#m105040300##k and talk to the person who first discovered this. They say it's a boy named #b#p1061019##k.
21726.name: Your Fourth Informant Assignment

21727.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant and you need to gather information about the erratic behavior of the #o2230101#s in #b#m105040300##k. You'd better talk to #b#p1061019##k, the witness that reported the incident.
21727.1:
#p1061019# seems terrified to see so many #o2230101#s with such irritated faces. They are preventing him from entering the Ant Tunnel, so he's asked you to find out what has happened to the #o2230101#s. Looks like you'll have to eliminate the #r#o2230101#s#k and retrieve the #b#t4032321##k...

#o9101001##r #a217271##k
#i4032321# #t4032321# #b#c4032321# / 1#k
21727.2: You eliminated the #o2230101#s and retrieved the #t4032321#. #p1061019# seemed to know something about the puppet…
21727.name: Zombie Mushrooms

21728.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant and it involves #p1061019#, who apparently remembered something when he looked at the #t4032321# retrieved from #o2230101#. Go talk to him at #b#m105040300##k.
21728.1: #p1061019# says that he saw a kid carrying around a #t4032321# some time ago. That must have been the Puppeteer! According to #p1061019#, the puppeteer may be hiding near the Evil Eye Cave… You should #bgo up to the Evil Eye Cave and look for the Puppeteer's Headquarters#k.
21728.2: You spotted the Puppeteer's Headquarters, but you need a password to enter.
21728.name: The Puppeteer's Cave

21729.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant and while you've found the puppeteer's cave, you need a password to enter. Maybe #p1061019# knows what the password could be? Go talk to #b#p1061019##k in #b#m105040300##k.
21729.1: #p1061019# says that he doesn't know anything about the password but says that he saw the puppeteer scribble something onto #p1061006# that just might be the password. Find out what the password is by talking to #b#p1061006##k and tell #b#p1002104##k the password is as well.\r\n\r\n#y21730# #b(#u20730#)#k
21729.2: So you found out the password but decided to first return to #p1002104# and debrief him on the case. This concludes your fourth Informant Assignment. Next up, Operation Puppeteer Headquarters?
21729.name: 4th Assignment Completed

2173.1:
Baine's eyes lit up as he read Bart's report. It was as if he discovered something! He thinks that the ominous feeling he's been getting as of late may have something to do with the Disciples of the Black Magician... Baine thinks it is possible that the Black Magician's Disciples are still in Victoria Island, and asks me to hunt down 20 #rred snails#k and 20 #rpigs#k and to bring back 1 #bBlack Magician's Token#k. 

#i4031846##t4031846# #b#c4031846##k / 1 
#o130101# #r#a21731##k
#o1210100# #r#a21732##k
2173.2: I've hunted down the monsters and found the Black Magician's Token, and brought it to Baine. I'm afraid there's something much bigger going on than it appears.
2173.name: The Truth Behind the Black Shadow
2173.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

21730.0: This is your fourth assignment as an informant and  even though you found the puppeteer's cave, you couldn't enter because you didn't have the password. The code might be written on #p1061006#. Go talk to #p1061006# at #m105040300#.
21730.1: Rotating the #p1061006# might reveal the scribbles, but it's not moving. Wait a minute, the statue seems to be talking to you directly. 'I want 100 #t4000007#s.' Now you've heard of some outrageous demands, but a statue demanding something from you? Really? Oh well, better find some #t4000007#s.\r\n\r\n#i4000007# #t4000007# #b#c4000007# / 100#k
21730.2: You found the scribble on #p1061006#. It's written in a near-illegible scribble, but you can still make it out. It says: 'Francis is a genius puppeteer!' All the words in the password have to be exact, including the capitalization and spacing, so be careful.
21730.name: The Cave's Password

21731.0: You have now reached Level 29, which means it's time for you to ambush the #o9300344#, no? You should head over to #b#m104000000##k and notify #b#p1002104##k that you are ready for action.
21731.1:
#p1002104#, seeing that you're determined to attack the #o9300344#, decides to rent a powerful weapon for you. It's a disposable weapon, but it'll be put to good use. Now everything is set for the ambush in #b#m910510201##k. Remember, the password is 'Francis is a genius Puppeteer!'

#o9300344##r #a217311##k
The Black Wings' Clue #t4032322# #b#c4032322# / 1#k
21731.2: You defeated the Puppeteer, but he ran away before you could finish him off. All you have left is a document the Puppeteer dropped while running away. When you showed #p1002104# the document, he suddenly looked dead serious.
21731.name: Eliminate the Puppeteer!

21732.0: The document you extracted from #o9300344# turns out to be a Black Wings document! Unfortunately, the document is written in code. What should you do? Go to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k for some advice.
21732.1: Looks like the only person that can decode the document is #p1201000#. Head over to #b#m140000000##k and ask #b#p1201000##k to help.
21732.2: The document says that the Black Wings possess an item known as the #t4032323#. #p1204002#, the puppeteer, is utilizing his special skills in mob manipulation to look for a certain Seal Stone. But what does that mean? What exactly are the Black Wings after?
21732.name: The Black Wings' Conspiracy

21733.0: The moment you reach Level 31, you receive a message from #b#p1002104##k. Is it about a new Informant Assignment? But he's never mentioned anything about it before…
21733.1: #p1002104# says he has an urgent message for you and asks you to come to #b#m104000004##k right away. You wonder what's going on.
21733.2: So it turned out that the message was from a fake #p1002104# who belongs to the Black Wings. In other words, the whole thing was a trap laid by the puppeteer to throw you off guard. Luckily, you were able to defeat the puppeteer, but he got away at the last second again. Meanwhile, #p1002104# was ambushed while waiting for a skill from #p1201000# to arrive. Luckily, he kept it safe and gave you the #bCombo Mastery#k skill.
21733.name: Gathering Some Strange Information

21734.0: As soon as you reach Level 37, #b#p1002104##k sends you a message. Is there a new lead?
21734.1:
#p1002104# says that he's found hidden traces of the #o9300346# and that the puppeteer is hidden in a #bsmall cabin#k somewhere in #b#m105040200##k. He says you have the greenlight to finish off the #o9300346# if you run into him again.


#o9300346##r #a217341##k
21734.2: You defeated the #o9300346# without a definite clue to lead you to the #t4032323#. But then, #p1002104# flashed a comforting smile as if to tell you not to worry about a thing…
21734.name: Traces of the Puppeteer

21735.0: You weren't able to gather any information on the #t4032323#, but #p1002104# seems strangely confident about where you stand. Go talk to #b#p1002104##k.
21735.1: #p1002104# says that ever since he got ambushed by the #o9300346#s, he's been using any means necessary to find the Seal Stone. He feels that holding on to the Seal Stone would be dangerous, so he wants to store it in #b#m140000000##k, the deserted island. I'd better deliver the #bSeal Stone to #p1201000##k.
21735.2: #t4032323#. No one knows what its purpose is, but it is obvious that Black Wings want it. Desperately. You can't let that happen… Just as you're thinking this, #p1201000# hands you a new skill called the #bCombo Drain#k.
21735.name: The Seal Stone of Victoria Island

21736.0: As soon as you reach Level 45, you receive a message from #b#p1002104##k.
21736.1: #p1002104# notifies you of some new information regarding the Black Wings and asks you to head to #b#m200000000##k to meet #b#p2012012# the fairy#k. #p2012012# will probably have some more details about this.
21736.name: Orbis

21737.0: It seems that something related to the Black Wings is happening in #b#m200000000##k. You should talk to #b#p2012012##k.
21737.1: #p2012012# the fairy has noticed that the number of #r#o9300347#s#k has been steadily increasing in #b#m200060001##k and wants you to look into the #o9300347#s there. Apparently, if you're not careful and enter the wrong path from #b#m200060000##k, you may end up in #m200060001# instead, so you should head there right now, eliminate the #o9300347#s, and retrieve any strange items they might drop.\r\n\r\n#i4032324# #t4032324# #b#c4032324# / 5#k
21737.2: After defeating the #o9300347#s, you brought back a #t4032324#. #p2012012# was curious to see who would do such a thing and seemed to worry even more that the sheer weight of the Nependeaths might cause Orbis to sink. She wanted you to discuss the problem about #m200000000# with someone who might know more.
21737.name: The Giant Nependeaths Appear

21738.0: You wonder if #m200000000# will come crashing down because of the sheer weight of the #o9300347#s. You'd better talk to #b#p2032001##k who lives in #b#m200050000##k before that happens.
21738.1: #p2032001# says that she's worried about the possibility of the #o9300347#s causing #m200000000# to sink, but she says she's actually more worried another issue entirely. The fact that the Nependeaths in Orbis have grown so huge maybe connected with the path to #m920030001#. #m920030001#? This may be related to the Seal Stone somehow. You'd better keep asking #b#p2032001##k more questions.
21738.2: #p2032001# first had her doubts about whether you could be trusted and was shocked to discover your true identity. She says that she has seen your grand fate…
21738.name: Sealed Garden

21739.0: You'll find #m920030001# in #m200000000#... You wonder if it's related to the Seal Stone. You bet #b#p2032001##k in #b#m200050000##k can explain a thing or two.
21739.1: According to #p2032001#, #m920030001# is where the #bSeal Stone is hidden#k. The only way to enter #m920030001# is through a stem of the Nependeath which connects #m200060001# to #m920030001#. An intruder has actually grown the #o9300347# for this specific purpose. #p2032001# is desperately asking you to prevent the intruders from entering...
21739.2: So you came face to face with a #o9300348# in #m920030001# and successfully defeated it, but ended up losing the Seal Stone to a member of the Black Wings, #o9300349#, who snatched it away from you. When you asked #p2032001# what you should do, she told you that she doesn't know what they want the Seal Stone for and sat quietly with a grim expression.
21739.name: To the Sealed Garden

2174.0: Baine discovers that the Black Magician's Disciples have been secretly observing The Nautilus. And with that discovery, Baine's report is now ready to be delivered to Muirhat. Baine wants me to bring the report to Muirhat myself, since I gave him so much help with writing the report...
2174.1: This report contains the Black Magician's Token which I found, plus a description of the strange sound waves that Baine had heard. It also includes information about the suspicious movements that Bart saw. I should take this to #bMuirhat#k.
2174.2: When Muirhat receives the report, he is surprised and shocked to find that the Black Magician's influence has spread as far as here.
2174.name: Report to Muirhat
2174.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

21740.0: You lost the Seal Stone of Orbis. What does this mean? Head to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k to get some advice.
21740.1: After explaining to #p1002104# everything that took place in #m200000000#, #p1002104# felt that this information should be relayed to #b#p1201000##k as well.
21740.2: #p1201000# seemed glad to have discovered that the Black Wings are after the Seal Stone and that there's more than one Seal Stone out there. She encouraged you with motivating words, then taught you a new skill that she had just decoded, known as the #bCombo Smash#k.
21740.name: The Stolen Seal Stone of Orbis

21741.0: As soon as you reach Level 54, you hear from #b#p1002104##k.
21741.1: #p1002104# says they've just received word regarding the Black Wings and urges you to go to #b#m250000000##k. Talk to #b#p2090004##k in #m250000000# for more details.
21741.name: Investigating Mu Lung

21742.0: So what does #b#m250000000##k have to do with the Black Wings? You should talk to #b#p2090004##k to find out.
21742.1: #p2090004# received a #t4220151# a few days ago from a man who claimed to be the #r#o9300351##k of the Black Wings. But because he took such poor care of the #t4220151#, the contents of the scroll seems to have faded away. You think the only way chance to restore the content is through #b#p2091008# the painter#k.
21742.name: The Black Scroll

21743.0: You want to restore the #t4220151# that the Black Wings gave to #p2090004#. The one person in #b#m250000000##k who is capable of doing the restoration is #b#p2091008# the painter#k.
21743.1:
#p2091008# states that to restore the #t4220151#, one must make a #b#t4032342##k and pour it all over the scroll. He then asks you to bring the materials necessary to make the ink, so he can make some for you. 

#i4000286# #t4000286# #b#c4000286# / 50#k
#i4000287# #t4000287# #b#c4000287# / 50#k
#i4000291# #t4000291# #b#c4000291# / 100#k
21743.2: You handed #p2091008# the materials and received #t4032342# in return. You should now open the #t4220151# and pour the #t4032342# over it.
21743.name: The Special Ink

21744.0: You wonder how #p2090004# will take the contents of the #t4220151# now that it's restored? You should talk to #b#p2090004##k in #b#m250000000##k.
21744.1: #p2090004# seems to be genuinely panicking and wants you to deliver the #t4220151# to #b#p2091007##k. But how in the world are you going to meet him when he resides at the very top floor of #m925020000#? That's when #p2090004# mentioned the ultimate weakness of #p2091007#'s student, #b#p2091005##k. You'd better head over to see #p2091005#.
21744.2: You met #p2091007# and handed him #o9300351#'s Letter of Warning.
21744.name: The Shadow Knight's Letter

21745.0: The letter issued by #o9300351# of the Black Wings... In order to deliver the letter to #p2091007#, you first must win over #p2091005#, who is one of his students. You'd better head over to #b#m925020000##k and start sweet-talking #b#p2091005##k.
21745.1: You ask nicely if you can see #p2091007#, but #p2091005#'s stance remains the same: NO. That's when you decide to sweeten the pot, as instructed by #p2090004#, by offering healthy items for the body, which worked like magic. You'd better start gathering up some #b#t4000293#s#k.\r\n\r\n#i4000293# #t4000293# #b#c4000293# / 100#k
21745.2: When you brought the #t4000293#s to him, #p2091005# discreetly told you the way to #m925020000#'s back alley. In front of #m925020000# are a some flags. You need to use the portal under the green flag on the right side to get to #p2091007#.
21745.name: How to Meet Mu Gong

21746.0: You wonder what #p2091007# is going to say about #o9300351#'s letter. You should meet with #b#p2091007##k on the #btop floor of #m925020000##k and find out. You can get there via the shortcut in the back alley that #p2091005# told you about.
21746.1: When you ask #p2091007# about the Seal Stone of Mu Lung, he says that #o9300351# is a dangerous fellow, but tells you that he also has his guard up around you. He also says that he's wants to test you to see if you're trustworthy. All you have to do is beat #o9300350# in battle.\r\n\r\n#o9300350##r #a217461##k
21746.2: You emerged victorious over #o9300350#. #p2091007# seemed absolutely shocked to see someone using skills from hundreds of years ago…
21746.name: Mu Gong's Test

21747.0: You passed #p2091007#'s test. You should now talk to #b#p2091007##k in #b#m925020000##k and find out more about the Seal Stone. You can get there by going through the back alley that #p2091005# told you about.
21747.1: According to #p2091007#, the Seal Stone of #m250000000# is stored in a place called #m925040100# and the entrance is somewhere between the pillars of #m250000100# and #b#m250020300##k. Find the pillar that has "Entrance" engraved on it and say the password to enter the premises. The password is #bActions speak louder than words#k. You'd better enter #m925040100# and stop #r#o9300351##k, then return to Mu Gong.\r\n\r\n#o9300351##r #a217471##k
21747.2: You defeated #o9300351# in #m925040100#, but the Seal Stone of #m250000000# was taken from you by the Gentleman of the Black Wings. It seems to be a recurring pattern. When you told #p2091007# that the Seal Stone was stolen, he admitted that he himself did not know the true use of that stone and reassured you that all is well in #m250000000# even if the Seal Stone has been taken.
21747.name: Catch the Shadow Knight!

21748.0: You lost the Seal Stone of Mu Lung. What does this mean? You'd better head over to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k to get some advice.
21748.1: When you tell #p1002104# about everything that took place in #m250000000#, #p1002104# felt it was necessary for you to tell #b#p1201000##k in #b#m140000000##k about it.
21748.2: #p1201000# stated that you did get something significant out of this, in that you found out the heroes were the ones that personally delivered the Seal Stone to those towns, and that by making that connection, you can focus on studying those heroes which will in turn lead you to new information. She then gave you a newly-decoded skill called #bFinal Charge#k!
21748.name: The Stolen Seal Stone of Mu Lung

21749.0: When you reach Level 63, #b#p1002104##k sends you a message.
21749.1: According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. Exploring the past could reveal some information about Seal Stones. #bThe busted clocktower with the time-control room can be accessed through the ladder on the top floor of Helios Tower#k, so you should make you way over there.
21749.2: According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. Exploring the past could reveal some information about Seal Stones. #bThe busted clocktower with the time-control room can be accessed through the ladder on the top floor of Helios Tower#k, so you should make your way over there.
21749.name: Back to the Past

2175.1: Muirhat thinks that Disciples of the Black Magician are most likely still lingering by Henesys and The Nautilus. He says that they are probably hiding in deserted house in the forest, disguised. I should get rid of them myself and preserve the peace on The Nautilus. \n\n#o9300156# #r#a21751##k
2175.2: I've gotten rid of all the Disciples of the Black Magician. Have we finally restored the peace on The Nautilus?
2175.name: Disciples of the Black Magician
2175.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

21750.0: Just as #p1002104# instructed, you use the #m220000000# clocktower to travel to the past. Just as you arrive in the past, someone calls out your name…
21750.1: #p2131002# seems shocked to see you and greets you like a long-lost sibling. Do you know this person? While you stand there dumbfounded, #p2131002# tells you that #b#p2131000##k is also waiting for you, and that you should make your way to the #bCamp Conference Room#k to let #p2131000# know that you are alive and well.
21750.2: You finally met #p2131000# in Ellin Forest. #p2131000# seemed glad to see you alive and well, but then learned that you have no recollection of the past and seemed sad to hear it.
21750.name: She Remembers Me

21751.0: You ran into someone from the past who apparently knew you. Maybe #p2131000# in Ellin Forest knows something about the Seal Stone. You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k and find out.
21751.1: #p2131000# says that she did store a rock in #m300000011#, which the heroes left for her, and says the rock might be the Seal Stone. Entering #m300000011# to verify whether the rock is actually a Seal Stone requires a #b#t4032325##k. #p2132000# in #b#m300010400##k apparently has it.\r\n\r\n#i4032325# #t4032325# #b#c4032325# / 1#k
21751.2: You received the #t4032325# from #p2132000#. #p2131000# told you to head to the #m300000011#.
21751.name: Seal Stone of Ellin Forest

21752.0: Apparently, #p2132000 has the #t4032325# that can open the safe where the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest is stored. You'd better head over to #b#m300010400##k and talk to #b#p2132000##k.
21752.1: You ask #p2132000# for the keys, and he seems to panic. He tells you that he may have lost it. It looks like the #r#o5250002#s#k nearby have the key, so it's up to you to defeat them all and retrieve.\r\n\r\n#i4032326# #t4032326# #b#c4032326# / 10#k
21752.2: #p2132000# found one of keys that #p2132000# lost and gave you the #t4032325#.
21752.name: Find the Key

21753.0: It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in Ellin Forest.
21753.1: #p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. Unfortunately, you can't take the letter since #b#p2131000# and you are from two separate times#k. \n\nJust when you think it's all over, #p2131000# tells you that she's a fairy with a very long life, and that she will in fact carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# in your own time#k. You wonder where #p2131000# is? You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.
21753.2: You asked #p1002104# whether he knew anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p1002104# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.
21753.name: The Lost Seal Stone of Ellin Forest

21754.0: You met #p1204031# in the #b#m100000201# of #m100000000##k. Thankfully, the letter hadn't gotten lost, but you think #p2131000# must have been shocked to see you. You'd better to talk to #b#p2131000##k.
21754.1: #p1012100# flashed a big smile, saying that she knew she'd someday meet you again. She then handed you the letter. It's a great feeling, knowing that you have a friend that remembers you hundreds of years later. You'd better show the letter to #b#p1002104##k.
21754.2: #p1002104# tells you that the letter is unreadable and that it actually might be cursed. He recommends that you show #p1201000# the letter. Since she seems to be good with spells, she might be able to break the curse.
21754.name: Info on Another Seal Stone

21755.0: You can't read the letter given by #p2131000#. What is this, anyway? You'd better head over to #b#m104000000##k and ask #b#p1002104##k what to do with it.
21755.1: According to #p1002104#, the letter is written in a secret code. Thankfully, you have a master decoder in #b#p1201000##k, so take the letter and head over to #b#m140000000##k.
21755.2: #p1201000# said that decoding the letter may take some time and told you she'll let #p1002104# know once it's complete.
21755.name: Decoding the Letter

21756.0: When you reach Level 68, #b#p1002104##k send a message.
21756.1: Apparently, #p1201000# succeeded in decoding the letter and it contains some surprising information! Better head over to #b#m140000000##k immediately and talk to #b#p1201000##k about the contents of the letter.
21756.2: Amazingly, the letter written by the heroes was addressed to the Queen of the time. The actual content of the letter simply asked that the Queen take good care of the Seal Stone of #m130000000#.
21756.name: A Letter to the Queen

21757.0: Now that you know what's written in the letter… what should you do? You'd better go to #b#m140000000##k and talk to #b#p1201000##k.
21757.1: #p1201000# says that it's essential to warn #m130000000# about the Seal Stone and writes a letter urging them to protect it at all cost. Your job is to go to #b#m130000000##k and hand the letter to the Queen, but with that annoying strategist of the Queen, Neinheart, blocking the way, it might be difficult. Maybe you should just talk to the #bStrategist#k instead.
21757.2: You met the Queen's strategist, #p1101002#. He took the letter and told you he'd take it into consideration, but his eyes tell you otherwise.
21757.name: Neinheart the Strategist

21758.1: #p1101002# thanks you for protecting the tears of the Divine Bird and wants to give you a reward for it. You'd better head over to #b#m130000000##k.
21758.2: As a token of his appreciation, #p1101002# taught you a new skill and mumbled that he hoped you might one day join forces with him. That smile of his seemed to convey a million subtle meanings.
21758.name: Neinheart's Thanks

2176.0: Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she is in need of help. Apparently the wash cloths that she uses for cleaning the ship have become tattered from incessant cleaning and she's in need of some new wash cloths... I should go talk to Mrs. Reade myself in the upper deck corridors where she's cleaning.
2176.1: I'll go find a #bpig's ribbon#k which Mrs. Reade can use as a wash cloth.
2176.2: Looks like Mrs. Reade's making good use of the pig's ribbon I brought her, but poor Mrs. Reade, she's cleaning all day long...as usual.
2176.name: Cleaning The Nautilus 1

21766.0: #p1002001# has noticed that #p20000# has been acting weird lately. You'd better head over to Lith Harbor and talk to #p1002001# to see what's up.
21766.1: Apparently, #p20000# started displaying some strange behavior ever since he started carrying some wooden box with him. Your task now is to investigate the wooden box that's next to #p20000#.
21766.2: As you promised to #p20000#, you did not reveal to #p1002001# that the wooden box contained medication for arthritis.
21766.name: Suspicious John

21767.0: #p1002001# asked you to investigate the wooden box that #p20000# always carries around.
21767.1: You find unidentified medication inside the box.
21767.2: It turned out that #p20000# had been taking his own special arthritis medicine behind #p1002001#'s back. You made a deal with him, promising not to tell anyone about the contents of his wooden box in exchange for a small reward. You shouldn't tell #p1002001# about the wooden box. Just make something up.
21767.name: Secrets of the Wooden Box

2177.0: Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she's worried about the sanitary conditions of the ship because there has been a huge influx of mice on The Nautilus since the ship has been docked at Victoria Island. Should I help Mrs. Reade get rid of the mice?
2177.1: The Nautilus has been docked at Victoria Island for some time now, and apparently that causes more rats to board the ship. Mrs. Reade is hyper-anxious having had to deal with all the vermin. I think I'll bring her 50 #bRat Traps#k. I've heard that I could buy mouse traps from the Roches in Ludibrium... \n\n#i4000095##t4000095# #b#c4000095##k / 50
2177.2: We set up 50 mouse traps. I don't think we'll see any more mice around here... would we?
2177.name: Cleaning The Nautilus 2

2178.0: Mrs. Reade says her problems just never end...
2178.1: So we took care of all the rats on The Nautilus but there's still one more problem. And that problem happens to be the main cause of all of Mrs. Reade's problems on The Nautilus- and he still needs to be cleaned! Mrs. Reade's biggest problem is Jack, the one who's to blame for every bit of the mess on The Nautilus! Let me go get some #bPure Water#k so #bJack#k can get a good wash down. \n\n#i2022000##t2022000# #b#c2022000##k / 1
2178.2: Will Jack ever get clean? All this scrubbing doesn't seem to be making him any cleaner... and I'm scrubbing and scrubbing...
2178.name: Cleaning The Nautilus 3

2179.0: Apparently, pigs and ribbon pigs have been coming onto The Nautilus every night to eat up the ship's emergency food supply. At this rate, the people on The Nautilus may end up starving! I should go see Tangyoon, the ship's Head Chef and talk to him about this.
2179.1:
Tangyoon says pigs and ribbon pigs keep coming onto The Nautilus' emergency food supply and eating up all the food, and there's only a little bit left in storage! I'm gonna have to teach these #rpigs#k and #rribbon pigs#k a lesson they'll remember. 

#o1210100# #r#a21791##k 
#o1210101# #r#a21792##k
2179.2: I think they must've learned their lesson by now. They'd better stay away from The Nautilus' food supply!
2179.name: Protect The Nautilus' Emergency Food Supply

2180.0: According to those who've tasted Tangyoon's cooking, Tangyoon's dishes give you a mystical experience... They say that Tangyoon's dishes will either transport you to the happiest moment of your life or make you experience a flood-like rush of fantasy the moment you take a bite of it. What IS his secret?
2180.1: The secret behind Tangyoon's cooking is none other than fresh ingredients! So I guess that means that freshness is the basis of all great cooking? Tangyoon is so serious about making sure that he has the freshest ingredients that he actually raises his own milk cows on The Nautilus for milk... Now that's impressive! Tangyoon wants me to go milk the cows and bring him some milk if I want to try some of his newest dish. Well, I definitely want to try some of his food, so I guess I'll go milk the cows and fill this bottle with milk. I'd better remember that I can only fill up 1/3rd of the bottle from a single mother cow.  \n\n#i4031850##t4031850# #b#c4031850##k / 1
2180.2: Wow! I can't believe I'm telling you this, but Tangyoon's dish was truly amazing. I was touched!
2180.name: Find Fresh Milk

2181.0: Porchay, who stays with the Whalians in the Generator Room, says that there is an emergency. I wonder what it is?
2181.1: I can't believe that the Whalians have completely run out of food! According to Porchay, Kenta has plenty of food ingredients so I should go to #bKenta#k and talk to her. I should take Porchay's letter with me too, right?
2181.2: I gave Porchay's letter to Kenta.
2181.name: Porchay's Letter

2182.1: Of all the ingredients, I can't believe they ran out of sea horse tail... The Whalians are probably starving so I'd better go get #b40 cans of sea horse tails#k from #bKenta#k and get them some food to eat. \n\n#i4000161##t4000161# #b#c4000161##k / 40
2182.2: I've collected 40 cans of sea horse tail. This should be enough to cook a dish, right?
2182.name: Ingredients to Get for the Banquet

2183.1: I'm finally done cooking the special entree for the Whalians. I'd better take it to #bPorchay#k quick!
2183.2: I don't think the Whalians will have to worry about food for a while.
2183.name: A Banquet for the Whalians

2184.0: The Nautilus' First Officer and handsome muscle man, Black Bark has a worry? I should go talk to him in the conference room of The Nautilus' central corridor.
2184.1: Black Bark wants to give Kyrin a pretty dress for her birthday, something that would express everyone's warmest regards toward her. He's apparently asked his old friend and dressmaker, Mrs. Ming Ming to make the dress, but she's run out of bright white material. She says that a table cloth made of junior lace is best for the dress she's making... I should gather #b40 table cloths#k and bring it to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k. \n\n#i4000035##t4000035#  #b#c4000035#/40#k
2184.2: I've collected the table cloths and have brought them to Mrs. Ming Ming. I wonder what the dress will look like!
2184.name: Black Bark's Worry

2185.1: The dress for Kyrin is finally done. It looks so nice! I should hurry and bring the dress to #bBlack Bark#k.
2185.2: I wonder if Miss Kyrin will be wearing the dress at her birthday party. Can't wait to see her in the dress!
2185.name: Dress for Kyrin

2186.0: Apparently there's someone on the harbor, in trouble. He says he's lost something that's practically like a body part of his...
2186.1: Having lost his glasses, Abel is unable to see anything. I can't believe the pelicans all went home while he was asleep... Let me help Abel find his glasses in the bushes nearby the #bwatchtower#k, located on the east end of The Nautilus harbor where the seagulls have gathered. And remember, #bAbel's glasses#k have horn-rimmed frames!                                          \n\n#i4031853##t4031853# #b#c4031853##k / 1
2186.2: Oh~ Abel seems so happy to have his glasses back. But now that he's got his glasses back, he seems like such a different person. Do those glasses have some kind of power?
2186.name: Help Me Find My Glasses

2187.0: Code red~! There's a hole in the ship and The Nautilus is in danger!  The Nautilus' crew, Bonnie, is trying everything to stop the hole all by herself... We can't let The Nautilus sink like this! I must go and help!
2187.1: The hole on the ship must be stopped with a solid horn. I should go and find #b50 solid horns#k before Bonnie loses all her strength.  \n\n#i4000073##t4000073#  #b#c4000073#/50#k
2187.2: Whew, I can't believe we saved The Nautilus from sinking into the ocean. Bonnie and I saved The Nautilus!
2187.name: A Hole in The Nautilus

2190.0: #b#p1012003##k of #b#m100000000##k seems to be facing a pretty serious problem...
2190.1: #p1012003# says that a group of unidentified strangers have appeared on the eastern coast of #m100000000#, and wants me to find out who they are. I should go to #b#m100030000##k.
2190.2: There's a huge wooden entryway leading into #m100030000# which I'd never seen before. It almost looks like an entryway to a fortress...I should try talking to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of me. I remember him telling me that a #bpirate #p1072008##k fort is being built here.  PIRATES!?
2190.name: Unidentified Strangers

2191.0: In order to become a Brawler, I must go see Kyrin.
2191.1: Kyrin says that she wants to test how far I have gotten on my training before she will help me job advance into a Brawler. I must first hunt down the #rOctopirates#k  on the testing grounds and collect #b15 Potent Power Crystals#k . I must remember to use the #rFlash Fist#k skill in order to defeat the Octopirates.                                 \n\n#i4031856##t4031856#  #b#c4031856#/15#k
2191.2: I've passed Kyrin's test! I'm ready now to become a Brawler!
2191.name: How to become a Brawler

2192.0: In order to become a Gunslinger, I must see Kyrin.
2192.1: Kyrin says that she wants to test how far I have gotten on my training before she will help me job advance into a Gunslinger. I must first hunt down the #rOctopirates#k and collect #b15 power wind crystals#k . I must remember to use the #rDouble Shot#k skill in order to defeat the Octopirates.
2192.2: I've passed Kyrin's test! I can now become a Gunslinger!
2192.name: How to Become a Gunslinger

2193.0: I've finally become a Pirate... But I have no idea what I'm supposed to do... I should go to Kyrin, the Pirate Director of Job Advancement.
2193.1: Kyrin suggests that I go on a light monster hunt to start training. She wants me to hunt down #r11 pigs#k. There's apparently a lot of pigs near Henesys.. \n\n#o1210100# #r#a21931##k
2193.2: I've hunted down 11 pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. Hehe... That was no sweat!
2193.name: The Beginner Pirate's First Training Session

2194.0: I've become a bit stronger from the training, but I've still got a long way to go. I should go ask #bKyrin#k for some help!
2194.1: Kyrin tells me that I still need more training on the basics and suggests that I hunt down some more monsters. She wants me to hunt down #r26 pigs#k this time... \n\n#o 1210100# #r#a21941##k
2194.2: I've hunted down 26 pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. Hehe, hunting down 26 pigs? It was a total breeze!
2194.name: The Beginner Pirate's Second Training Session

2195.0: I'm finally getting used to being a Pirate, but I still have a lot more to learn. #bKyrin#k says she can help me...
2195.1: According to Kyrin, I need to train for more composure and perseverance in order to become a great Pirate. She wants me to hunt down 43 pigs this time. #r43 pigs#k indeed... That's no joke!  \n\n#o 1210100# #r#a21951##k
2195.2: Finally! I've hunted down all 43 pigs... Phew...That wasn't as easy!
2195.name: Beginner Pirate's Third Training Session

2196.0: I'm finally starting to feel more comfortable in my skin as a Pirate. #bKyrin#k is offering to help train me for this final step...
2196.1: Kyrin wants to test the skills I've acquired throughout my training. She wants me to hunt down #r10 green mushrooms#k. Green mushrooms are apparently much more powerful than the pigs so Kyrin is warning me to keep alert. \n\n#o 1110100# #r#a21961##k
2196.2: I've hunted down 10 green mushrooms. That was not an easy task, but in any case, it was a success! Kyrin, the Director of Job Advancement for Pirates, is finally acknowledging me as a real Pirate.
2196.name: Beginner Pirate's Fourth Training Session

2197.0: As soon as you arrive in  #m104000000#, find #b#p0002006##k the motor-mouth salesman.
2197.1: As soon as you arrive in  #m104000000#, find #b#p0002006##k the motor-mouth salesman.
2197.2: You have talked to #b#p0002006##k the salesman about the #bMonster Book#k.
2197.name: Tienk, the Monster Book Salesman

2198.0: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help? I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
2198.1: Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r80 Stone Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.  \n\n#o 5130101# #r#a21981##k
2198.2: I've eliminated 100 Stone Golems. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island?
2198.name: Eliminate the Stone Golems

Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r50 Drakes#k and #r50 Ice Drakes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.

2203.1:
Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r30 Tauromacis#k and #r100 Cold Eyes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.

#o 4230100# #r#a22032##k
2203.2: I've eliminated 100 Tauromacis. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island?
2203.name: Eliminate the Tauromacis

2204.0: I've lost my appetite as of late... I wonder if Tangyoon could help me find a newfound appreciation for food by cooking me something new? I'm definitely ready for the challenge now so I should go talk to Tangyoon in The Nautilus' cafeteria. Oh yea, the cafeteria's on the upper deck.
2204.1: Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish as of late, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before. He's apparently been working with Evil Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh if only I would bring him #b40 Evil Eye Tails#k... But come on, Evil Eyes? Does he even know if those things are edible? \n\n#i 4000007##t 4000007#  #b#c 4000007#/40#k
2204.2: Man, just as I'd suspected, Evil Eyes definitely aren't as tasty as I had hoped. But in a burger, well, it's not all that bad after all.

2205.0: Tangyoon says he's found a new ingredient to work with. I wonder what Tangyoon has in mind now?
2205.1: Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish as of late, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before. This time, he says he's been working with Curse Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh  if only I would bring him #b50 Curse Eye Tails#k... Hope it comes out tasty! \n\n#i 4000013##t 4000013#  #b#c 4000013#/50#k

2206.0: Tangyoon says he's found a new ingredient to work with. I wonder what Tangyoon has in mind now?
2206.1: Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish as of late, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before. This time, he says he's been working with Cold Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh  if only I would bring him #b50 Cold Eye Tails#k... Hope it comes out tasty! \n\n#i 4000023##t 4000023#  #b#c 4000023#/50#k
