2207.0: At The Nautilus, there's a kid who is forever curious and loves to make pranks. Bartol tells me now he has a good prank to pull on someone. If I want to join in, I better head over to the middle hallway of The Nautilus to find Bartol!
2207.1: All #bCalico#k ever does is sleep, sleep, sleep, when what he should be doing is keeping an eye out on the crew's bedrooms. Bartol thinks it would be funny to throw an #bEvil Eye Tail#k onto Calico and see how he reacts. Might be a fun little prank, no? \n\n#i 4000007##t 4000007#  #b#c 4000007#/10#k
2207.2: Calico awakes, in total shock. C'mon, Calico, you've got to stop falling asleep!
2207.name: Lazy Little Calico

2208.0: If I'm passing through the central corridors of The Nautilus, I should make sure to stop by and see Bartol. He said he could teach me an easier way to get there...
2208.1: Well, Bartol says that if I fulfill his request then he would give me a coupon that would allow me to use the warp machine to be warped to the Omega Sector. He says that he has some business to attend to with Shulynch, Muirhat and Black Bark and could use my help...
2208.2: I fulfilled Bartol's request and received the Omega Sector Warp Coupon in return. I can use this coupon to use the Warp Machine in The Nautilus' Control Room to be warped immediately to the Omega Sector.
2208.name: Bartol's Requests

2209.0: I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do?
2209.1: Bartol wants me to take this lemon to #bShulynch, who is in the ship's Training Room on the upper deck#k.  \n\n#i 2010004##t 2010004#  #b#c 2010004#/1#k
2209.2: I've delivered the lemon to Shulynch.
2209.name: Bring a Lemon for Shulynch

2210.0: I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do?
2210.1: I should bring the #bGold Pouch#k to #bMuirhat#k as Bartol asked me to. Muirhat is standing #bin front of the Control Room on the upper deck#k.
2210.2: I've delivered the Gold Pouch to Muirhat.
2210.name: Take the Gold Pouch to Muirhat

2211.0: I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do?
2211.1: I should deliver this #bTattered Map#k to #bBlack Bark#k in the #bCentral Conference Room of The Nautilus#k.
2211.2: I've delivered the Tattered Map to Black Bark.
2211.name: Deliver the Tattered Map to Black Bark

2212.0: What do I need to do to make the job advancement to becoming a Pirate? I should talk to #p1002101# in Lith Harbor.
2212.1: #p1002101# says that you can job advance to become a #bPirate#k once you reach #bLevel 10#k by choosing to become a Pirate in Lith Harbor. They say that in order to become a Pirate, you have to talk to #r#p1090000##k of #rThe Nautilus#k... I'd better figure out how to get to The Nautilus on the World Map (#rW#k) so I don't get lost on the way.
2212.2: I learned a lot about becoming a Pirate from #p1090000#. From here, my journey begins...
2212.name: The Path of Pirate

2213.0: #b#m103000000# #p1052002##k is looking for someone to uncover the hidden truth about the #rscheme#k...
2213.1:
JM says a monster known as the  #r#o6220000##k has been appearing in the #m103000000# sewer system, and wants someone to find out whether it is someone's evil scheme to put #m103000000# in danger. He says the person who will help identify the root of this problem must be strong enough to defeat #rthe alligators in the swamp region#k... 

#i4000032##t4000032#  #b#c4000032##k/50 #k 
#i4000033##t4000033#  #b#c4000033##k/50
2213.2: When you come back after defeating the alligators in the swamp, JM is convinced that you're strong enough to manage the task. He asks you to come back later so that he can tell you what the next step entails.
2213.name: JM's Request
2213.parent: The Monster and the Evil Scheme

2214.1: It seems like the next step entails collecting information. JM says that he is going to leave something for you inside the #bhut#k found deep inside the swamp, so you can retrieve it #bfrom 5 p.m. to 8 p.m.#k... Let's keep track of time and head over to #b#m107000300##k.
2214.2: You have a crumpled piece of paper containing the list of informants in your hands. Let's go find the informants listed on the paper.
2214.name: The Run-down Huts in the Swamp
2214.parent: The Monster and the Evil Scheme

2215.0: You have lost the list of informants you retrieved from the hut in the swamp region. What to do...? Let's go see #bJM#k again.
2215.1: JM scowls and clicks his tongue at you. He says he'll provide you with the list of informants again, but asks you to pay #ba fee of  2000 Mesos#k and instructs you to leave it inside the trash can. Let's head over to #b#m107000300##k.
2215.2: You have taken the list of informants out and left 2000 Mesos inside the trash can.
2215.name: Find the Crumpled Piece of Paper Again

2216.0: According to the information provided on the #t4031894#, #p9000008# is one of the informants that JM wants you to go see. Let's go find #b#p9000008##k.
2216.1: According to #p9000008#, #o6220000# looks a lot like #o3110100# but bigger, and it can even use magic. Anyway... He seems like a nice man.
2216.2: According to #p9000008#, #o6220000# looks a lot like #o3110100# but  bigger, and it can even use magic.
2216.name: Information from Mr. Pickall

2217.0: According to the information provided on the #t4031894#, #p1052102# is one of the informants that JM wants you to go see. Let's go find #b#p1052102##k.
2217.1: According to #p1052102#, the #m103000000# sewer has been emitting a strange odor.
2217.2: According to #p1052102#, the #m103000000# sewer has been emitting a strange odor.
2217.name: Information from Shumi

2218.0: According to the information provided on the crumpled piece of paper, #p1052103# is one of the informants that JM wants you to go see. Let's go find #b#p1052103##k.
2218.1: According to #p1052103#,  #b#p9020000##k the magician in #m103000000# seem rather anxious... Hmmm does she have something to do with the scheme?
2218.2: According to #p1052103#,  #b#p9020000##k the magician in #m103000000# seem rather anxious... Hmmm does she have something to do with the scheme?
2218.name: Information from Nella

2219.0: According to the information provided on the #t4031894#, #p1052006# is one of the informants that JM wants you to see. Let's go find #b#p1052006##k.
2219.1: While chatting away, #p1052006# suddenly mentions something regarding the #o9300003#... that #o9300003# wasn't always gigantic. He says it was a  #o210100# that exponentially grew due to the #bGrowth Powder#k...
2219.2: While chatting away, #p1052006# suddenly mentions something regarding the #o9300003#... that #o9300003# wasn't always gigantic. He says it was a  #o210100# that exponentially grew due to the #bGrowth Powder#k...
2219.name: Information from Jake

2220.0: You have gathered all the information from the informants. Let's give #bJM#k an update about the progress.
2220.1: As soon as you tell JM the information you have gathered, JM turns pale. Is he surprised at the evil scheme...? JM, with an anxious look on his face, tells you to speak with #b#p9020000##k and ask about #o6220000#.
2220.2: When asked about #o6220000#, #p9020000# is taken aback by the question and comes clean about the incident... about her accidentally dropping the Growth Powder in the sewer...
2220.name: Gathering Information Completed

2221.0: The evil scheme to put #m103000000# in danger... it only turned out to be #p9020000#'s clumsiness. Let's go inform #bJM#k.
2221.1: JM, numbed by the absurdity, asks you to defeat #o6220000#. He seems to have aged 10 years because of this. Poor JM...\n\n#o6220000##r#a22211##k
2221.2: You have defeated #o6220000# and reported your progress to JM.
2221.name: Conclusion

2222.0: #b#p1032100##k who lives in #b#m101000000##k was in a dangerous situation...
2222.1: Arwen says she was attacked by a giant monkey monster in the forest. Although she's wasn't hurt, she was angry that something like this was still happening because #p1032001# had casted the magic of darkness during his days of youth. Let's go find #b#p1032001##k.
2222.2: #p1032001# admits that he did, indeed, make a mistake a while back when he was young that is still affecting #m101000000#. He asks  you to find #b#p1040002##k the cat in #b#m101020000##k to see what information you can get regarding the monster that attacked Arwen.
2222.name: The Forest of Evil

2223.1: #p1040002# knew exactly who #r#o5220002##k the black monkey monster was. #o5220002# seems to have something to do with Arwen...  #p1040002# says to bring back #b#t4031925##k from #r#o5300100##k if you wish to find out more about #o5220002#. \n\n#i4031925##t4031925#  #b#c4031925##k/10 #k
2223.2: When given #t4031925#s, #p1040002# says to wait while it finds the entrance to the #m910100000#.
2223.name: The Name He Calls

2224.1: #p1040002# has told you that the entrance to #m910100000# is in #m100040105#. If you want to meet the ghost Fanzy was talking about, head over to #r#m910100000##k. But it seems like the ghost only appears during certain hours... Let's keep track of time since the ghost is said to appear #rfrom 5 p.m. to 7 a.m. of the following day#k.
2224.2: The ghost of the cursed forest, #t1032107#. He seems to be cursing someone ceaselessly...
2224.name: Rage, Resentment, and Revenge

2225.1: #p1032107#, once an apprentice of #p1032001#, wanted to get close to Arwen, but Arwen could not even remember #p1032107#, and #p1032107# began to take revenge by casting an evil spell on #o4230101# to turn it into #o5220002#... Let's go inform #bArwen#k.
2225.2: At first, Arwen is shocked and upset at what #p1032107# has done, but seems deep in thought now...
2225.name: The Cause and Effect

2226.1: Arwen, after much contemplation, says she can't understand Reef's actions but takes some responsibility for them. She, then, asks you for a favor... to deliver Fairy Hair to #bReef#k. She seems sincere, so perhaps you should help her out. Don't forget that Reef is a ghost who only appears #bfrom 5 p.m. to 7 a.m. of the following day#k.
2226.2: You have delivered the Fairy Hair to Reef. Reef, surprised at the unexpected gift, asks you to give his apologies to #bGrendel the Really Old#k for having harmed others.
2226.name: Arwen's Apology

2227.1: #p1032001#, who has heard everything about #p1032107#, claims that #p1032107# was once a polite and mild-tempered person... He speculates that it was the power of darkness that has consumed and changed Reef, and blames himself for it. Then, #p1032001# asks you to defeat #o5220002#... \n\n#o5220002# #r#a22271##k
2227.2: When you defeat #o5220002# and report your progress to #p1032001#, he says #p1032107#, too, probably feels relieved.
2227.name: Defeat Faust

2228.0: #p1032100# and #p1032001#, #m101000000# and #o5220002#. And Reef... The air seems to have been cleared. Although Faust still loiters around the forest,  #b#p1032108##k probably feels relieved for the time being. Let's go find #p1032108#.
2228.1: Appeased, #p1032108# thanks you for your work.
2228.2: Appeased, #p1032108# thanks you for your work.
2228.name: Reef's Gratitude

2229.1:
I met with #b#p1040001##k.  #b#p1040001##k says he can't stand guard at the dungeon entrance because he keeps falling asleep.  If this continues, something bad is bound to happen.  I need to find a potion that can fight off sleepiness and give it to #b#p1040001##k.

#i02000000##t02000000# #b#c02000000#/1
#k#i02000001##t02000001# #b#c02000001#/1
#k#i02000002##t02000002# #b#c02000002#/1#k
2229.2: I fed the potion to #b#p1040001##k but it was no use.  But  #b#p1040001##k was very appreciative of my efforts.
2229.name: A Way to Fight Off Sleep

2230.0: It sounds like someone is calling out my name. The dreamy eyes... the luscious purple hair... who are you?
2230.1: The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a #bMysterious Small Egg#k inside my inventory. Didn't she say something about it being my friend...? Anyway, better go visit the fairy at #bEllinia#k, the town of Fairies.\r\n#b<Message from the Fairy>\nThe purple bellflower that soaks in the sun in between the skyscraping trees...Follow the path to the unknown that leads you to the bellflower. I will wait for you here.
2230.2: The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Reliving the message the Fairy left for me, I went to the area and found Mar the Fairy hiding behind a huge bellflower. Mar mentioned something about being responsible for taking care of a living being, and then gave me a pet as a gift. The mysterious small egg turned out to be a Snail's egg.\r\nAlong with a message that this small snail can only be with me for 5 hours.
2230.name: A Mysterious Small Egg

2231.0: A middle-aged gentleman who laims to have been the leader of a Family for 30 mind-boggling years... the rumors about this man, #bCaptain Al#k, who can be found in #bLith Harbor#k and #bOrbis Park#k, are running rampant. What exactly is a Family and the Leader anyway? It sounds interesting... better ask #bCaptain Al#k that question myself.
2231.1: #bCaptain Al#k seemed much more pleasant the rumors suggested. I have a lot to ask... and he said ask him when I'm ready. How about now?
2231.2: Captain Al's passion for adventure the Family are palpable. Forget the tear-jerking adventures of Captain Al; I'm more interested in the concept of the Family... \nFortunately, Captain Al told me to ask him anytime about the Family. Should I become a Leader myself? Well, first I'll need to find a Junior I can support.
2231.name: Captain Al, Who Are You?

2232.0: #bCaptain Al#k told me to see him if I was ever interested in starting a Family. Better go visit him at either #bLith Harbor#k or #bOrbis Park#k.
2232.1:
Captain Al's mission was simple! He just asked me to find a Junior that I want to support. I better register at least one Junior, then report the results to him.

#rAdd at least one Junior#k
(From the Family window[HotKey : F], press the Pedigree button to check )
2232.2: I succeeded in adding a Junior under me! Of course, that's how great my leadership is... haha.
2232.name: Find a Junior!

2233.1:
#bCaptain Al#k's next mission is for me to reach #r1,000 Rep#k! It's not an easy task by any means. According to Captain Al, this number cannot be achieved without the leadership and the overall support I provide to the Juniors. Captain Al gave me a clue in that I should help Juniors acquire EXP and help them Level Up as much as they can. EXP... leveling up... HOW?

#rAchieve 1,000 Rep#k
(Open the Family window to check the Rep)
2233.2: I finally reached 1,000 in Rep! ...I have to thank the Juniors that really helped me get there.
2233.name: Raise the Rep!

2234.1:
This task is to enjoy your hard-earned #rEntitlements#k! #bCaptain Al#k's mission is for me to use the Entitlement to spend the #rcurrent Rep down to 500#k. He also wanted to make sure I stacked up enough Reps by saving all the way up to 2,000. Better return to Captain Al once I complete the mission.

#rTotal of at least 2,000 Rep
Current Rep under 500#k
(Open the Family window to see both the current Rep and the total Rep)
2234.2: Captain Al commended my efforts for successfully accomplishing all the missions, and told me I have the looks to become a great Senior. He also reiterated the fact that it's very important to provide a full support to my Juniors and everyone in the Family. I better ask Al if I have any questions about the Family. Time for me to start a big Family of my own!
2234.name: Enjoy the Entitlement!

2235.0: Manji, a solitary warrior in Perion, has asked to see you. He's never been the type to initiate a conversation, let alone a meeting! It must be something important. Let's go see Manji in Perion.
2235.1: Manji says he felt a threatening energy coming from the deep end of the dungeon, so he asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, he hasn't heard from Mu Young since! He'd like you to find the young man. If the last time Manji heard anything from Mu Young was when he was investigating the central dungeon of Victoria, couldn't he still be inside?
2235.2: Manji says he felt a threatening energy coming from the deep end of the dungeon, so he asked his young apprentice, #bMu Young#k, to investigate. Unfortunately, he hasn't heard from Mu Young since! He'd like you to find the young man. If the last time Manji heard anything from Mu Young was when he was investigating the central dungeon of Victoria, couldn't he still be inside? \r\nYou were able to find Manji's apprentice, Mu Young, in the Underground Temple of the central dungeon.
2235.name: Manji's Request
2235.summary: Let's go find Mu Young, who is somewhere in central dungeon of Victoria. He probably went down to the Underground Temple to investigate the root of a threatening and mysterious energy.

2236.0: Chrishrama in Sleepywood claims that he's felt an ominous energy. Let's go talk to him.
2236.1: Chrishrama says he feels the forces of evil coming from the dungeon and asks that you place a Charm on each of the Shaman Rocks nearby. It sounds a bit superstitious, but let's make him happy and do this favor for him.
2236.2: Chrishrama says he feels the forces of evil coming from the dungeon and asks that you place a Charm on each of the Shaman Rocks nearby. It sounds a bit superstitious, but let's make him happy and do this favor for him. Since you've stuck an Charm on all 6 of the Shaman Rocks, let's go see Chrishrama.
2236.name: How to Shoo Away the Evil
2236.summary: Place a Charm on the 6 Shaman Rocks located throughout the central dungeon of Victoria to drive out evil!

2237.0: There is a note inside the Ant Tunnel. Let's pick it up and see what it is.
2237.1: You've picked up a Mysterious Note inside the dungeon. Let's return this Note to its owner. Hm, could it belong to Mu Young?
2237.2: Chrishrama says he feels the forces of evil coming from the dungeon and asks that you place a Charm on each of the Shaman Rocks nearby. It sounds a bit superstitious, but let's make him happy and do this favor for him. You have given the Note to Mu Young, whom you met inside the dungeon.
2237.name: The Owner of the Mysterious Note
2237.summary: Let's return the piece of paper you've picked up. Could it be Mu Young's?

2238.1: While talking to Mu Young, you were suddenly transported to a foreign place and a Jr. Balrog appeared right in front of your eyes. Let's defeat the Jr. Balrog.
2238.2: While talking to Mu Young, you were suddenly transported to a foreign place and a Jr. Balrog appeared right in front of your eyes. As soon as you defeated the Jr. Balrog, Tristan's Spirit appeared. You were able to hear the story of his past life.
2238.name: Who is the Owner of the Mysterious Note?
2238.summary: Let's go into Tristan's Tomb and talk to his spirit after defeating the Jr. Balrog.

2239.0: Manji's apprentice, Mu Young, has a pensive look on his face. Shall we hear what he has to say?
2239.1: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says, Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form a Expeditionary Team to prevent Balrog from reviving.
2239.2: Mu Young says his master was right to worry. He says, Balrog, who was sealed by Tristan a number of decades ago, is preparing to reemerge. He has asked you to form a Expeditionary Team to prevent Balrog from reviving.\r\nBut as you tried to prevent Balrog's revival, he disappeared into thin air, and you had to tell Mu Young.
2239.name: Balrog and the Seal
2239.summary: Let's form an Expeditionary Team and go into the cave where Balrog is sealed. You will do what you can to prevent Balrog from reviving and report back to Mu Young.

2240.0: Mu Young seems to have another favor to ask of you. Let's see what he needs.
2240.1: Mu Young says he has to further investigate the place, so he'd like me to deliver the letters he wrote to Manji during the past few days.
2240.2: Mu Young says he has to further investigate the place, so he'd like me to deliver the letters he wrote to Manji during the past few days.\r\nLet's deliver Mu Young's message to Manji in Perion. He thanked you for all your help as you set out to deliver his letters.
2240.name: A Letter to the Master
2240.summary: Let's deliver Mu Young's messages to Manji.

2241.0: Manji, who has received Mu Young's messages, seems to have a favor to ask of you.
2241.1: Manji has asked that you deliver his request to Mu Young, who is currently in the Underground Temple inside the dungeon. Let's deliver Manji's request to Mu Young.
2241.2: Manji has asked that you deliver his request to Mu Young, who is in the Underground Temple inside the dungeon. Upon receiving Manji's request, Mu Young promised himself that he would always remain mindful of his master's request.
2241.name: A Request to His Apprentice
2241.summary: Let's go find Mu Young, who is in the Underground Temple in the central dungeon of Victoria.

2242.0: Mu Young says he's met a strange man. Could it be someone who is related to the impending revival of Balrog? Let's go find Mu Young.
2242.1: Mu Young claims that he spotted a strange man at the entrance of the Underground Temple. He has asked you to look into this and see if you can gather some information about the man. Let's investigate the strange man.
2242.2: Mu Young claims that he spotted a strange man at the entrance of the Underground Temple. At the request of Mu Young, who has asked you to look into this strange man to see if you can gather some information, you began your investigation.
2242.name: Stay Away From Strangers
2242.summary: Let's start a conversation with the strange man.

2243.0: Let's start a conversation with the strange man.
2243.1: The strange man said he'd show you something if you bring him 20 sheets of Balrog Skin.
2243.2: He made you a scroll using the sheets of Balrog Skin.
2243.name: This is something you can make with Balrog Skin.
2243.summary: Let's collect 20 sheets of Balrog Skin and take them to the strange man.

2244.0: You hear Tristan's Spirit calling you from the Underground Temple. Let's rush over to Tristan's Tomb.
2244.1: Tristan's Spirit says he'd acknowledge you as his successor if you prevent Balrog from reviving. Wow, the successor of a legendary hero of Maple World? That's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! Let's do it!
2244.2: Upon preventing Balrog's revival 200 times, you have been named Tristan's Successor.
2244.name: Tristan's Successor
2244.summary: Let's stop Balrog from reviving 200 times.

2245.0: You could not defeat the Jr. Balrog in Tristan's Tomb and you want to give it another shot.
2245.1: You could not defeat the Jr. Balrog in Tristan's Tomb and you want to give it another shot.
2245.2: You went back to Tristan's Tomb and met Tristan's Spirit after finally defeating the Jr. Balrog.
2245.name: To Tristan's Tomb

2246.0: Apparently, the #bThe Rememberer#k of Sleepywood is conducting studies on mutated Horny Mushrooms. You should go to Sleepywood to find out more.
2246.1: Some Horny Mushrooms have been acting really mean lately, and there seems to be something suspicious going on. #bThe Rememberer has noticed the change and is conducting studies on these supicious Horny Mushrooms.\r\n
2246.2: You helped #bThe Rememberer# with his research on Horny Mushrooms, but he seems to need some more information.
2246.name: Horny Mushroom Caps Research
2246.rewardSummary: EXP 7,000\r\nCan proceed to 'Raging Horny Mushrooms' quest\r\n

2247.0: The Rememberer of Sleepywood claims to be studying the changes that are taking place with the strange-looking Horny Mushrooms and needs some help.
2247.1:
The Rememberer says that he must continue his research and that the raging Horny Mushrooms must be stopped in the meantime.


#o2110200# #a22471#
2247.2: You helped the Remember of Sleepywood with his research again, but you better talk to him about the progress he's made in his studies on the strange mushrooms.
2247.name: Raging Horny Mushrooms
2247.rewardSummary: EXP 8,000\r\nCan proceed to 'Understanding the Horny Mushroom Signals'\r\n

2248.0: You'd better check in to see the progress The Rememberer of Sleepywood is making with his research on the strange mushrooms.
2248.1:
The Rememberer has completed his research, and has suggested that there may be some Horny Mushrooms that have been tainted. He's asked you to gather some Tainted Horny Mushroom Caps.


#i4032390:# #t4032390:# #c4032390# / 20
2248.2: The Rememberer told you that his study of the Horny Mushrooms has been completed, but that he still can't understood the vague mushroom signals. He told you he still doesn't know what drove the mushrooms into a rage.
2248.name: Understanding the Horny Mushroom Signals
2248.rewardSummary: EXP 8,000\r\nCan proceed to 'Zombie Mushroom Signal 1' quest\r\n

#i4032399:# #t4032399:# #c4032399# / 20
2251.2: You finally managed to figure out the signals the mushrooms sent to themselves. #b#e'Mushking of the Mushroom Castle is in danger. Watch out for King Pepe! Request help from the courageous adventurers of Maple World who are at least Level 30.' #n#k What does that mean?

2254.0: Through research, you discovered that a place known as the Mushroom Castle is in trouble, but even #bThe Rememberer#k doesn't know anything about the place. You should see what he thinks you should do next.
2254.1: Through research, you discovered that a place known as the Mushroom Castle is in trouble, but even #bThe Rememberer#k had no clue where that is. He recommends you ask #bKarcasa#k in the desert for some information…
2254.2: You met #bKarcasa#k and asked about the Mushroom Castle, to no avail.
2254.name: Karcasa of the Desert

2255.0: Karcasa has information on Mushroom Castle. You'd better go talk to him.
2255.1:
Karcasa claims he'll remember information about the Mushroom Castle if he eats some carrots right now… Really? 

#i4000325:# #t4000325:# #c4000325# / 30
2255.2: You gathered the carrots and gave them to Karcasa in exchange for information about the Mushroom Castle.
2255.name: Karcasa's Memory

2256.0: You gave in to Karcasa's demands in order to find out more about the Mushroom Castle. Now, he seems like he's going to ask you for another favor! Does he even know anything about the castle?
2256.1:
How could an oasis be created with water bought from a store? Anyway, you need to give in to his demands in order to find out more about the castle, but he seems awfully suspicious.

#i2022000:# #t2022000:# #c2022000# / 1
2256.2: Is he trying to make a fool out of you?
2256.name: Karcasa's Memory 2

2257.0: Something doesn't seem right. He keeps repeating what he's already said. Does he really know?
2257.1: You knew it! Karcasa was just spitting out rumors he heard. Maybe the Camel Cab can help you out instead?
2257.2: You visited the Camel Cab and asked for some information on the Mushroom Castle.
2257.name: Karcasa Relents
2257.rewardSummary: Complete this quest as the Meerkats Listen During the Day quest.\r\n

2258.0: You should ask the Camel Cab for information about the Mushroom Castle.
2258.1:
Apparently, Meerkats spread rumors like wildfire during the day. Defeat enough Meerkats in a limited amount of time to keep the rumor from spreading.

#o2100108# #a22581#
2258.name: Meerkats Listen During the Day
2258.rewardSummary: Go on to the Scorpions Can't Listen at Night quest.\r\n

2259.0: What? He can't tell you because the Meerkats may overhear? What to do? You'd better talk to the Camel again.
2259.1: He agrees that the Meerkats might eavesdrop and tells you to go to '#bSahel 1#k' for a private conversation.
2259.name: Scorpions Can't Listen at Night
2259.rewardSummary: Go on to the To the Mushroom Castle! quest.

2260.2: Camel Cab can finally share information about the Mushroom Castle now that you've reached Level 30! You'd better undergo job advancement and listen to the Camel Cab talk about the Mushroom Castle.
2260.name: To the Mushroom Castle!

2264.0: #eJake#k, who works at the #eKerning Ciy Subway Turnstile#k, wants to ask you for a favor. You'd better go talk to him.\r\n#bTip - At the entrance of the subway station in Kerning City, you'll see Shumi sitting down in front.
2264.1: Jake at the Kerning City subway station needs help. Up north, there's a #e#bsubway station that stopped midway through construction#k#n. Apparently the place is infested with monsters. #e#bMr. Lim#k#n has been sent there to assess the damage, and Jake wants you to follow to see how bad the damage is.\r\nYou should head over to the #e#bConstruction Site North of Kerning City#k#n and find the subway station that's under construction, so you can find Mr. Lim.
2264.2: Jake, who works at the Kerning City subway station, requested that you meet Mr. Lim at the Construction Site North of Kerning City. Mr. Lim then pleaded with you to check out the old subway platforms for him.
2264.demandSummary: You talked to #bMr. Lim#k, who was inside the #bAbandoned Subway Train#k located at the Construction Site North of Kerning City.
2264.name: Mr. Lim and the Subway

2270.0: Blake has a dream...but he wants you to talk to him about it in a little bit, since he's in the middle of something.
2270.1: Blake wants to be a singer! Will his dream come true? Talk to #bLana#k the CEO of Big Hit Records. She's shopping in Kerning Square.
2270.2: Will Blake's dream ever come true?
2270.name: My dream is to...

2271.0: #bLana#k the CEO of Big Hit Records says she needs a few moments to decide whether Blake has what it takes to make a big debut. Talk to her in a minute to see what she decides.
2271.1: Finally! Blake will be able to make his debut! But first, you must convince the seven star chef #bRobby Fray#k to cater Blake's afterparty.
2271.2: What? #bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? Well, you gotta do what you gotta do to help Blake make his debut. Talk to Robby Fray again.
2271.name: Lana's Decision

2272.0: #bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? If that's what it takes to convince a seven star chef to cater Blake's party, then that's what it takes. Get to it!
2272.1: Robby Fray needs Bubbles to make his specialty cocktails. Head over to the 1st-2nd floor of Kerning Square and collect Bubbles from the Bubble Teas.
2272.2: #bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? Well, you gotta do what you gotta do to help Blake make his debut. Talk to Robby Fray again.
2272.name: Convince Robby Fray

2273.0: You perform a favor for #Robby Fray#k so he would agree to cater the party, but when you go to turn it in, he screams in dismay. It seems like you'll have to do him another favor...
2273.1: Uh oh. Without his Secret Recipe, Robby Fray can't bear to keep living, let alone cater a party. Hopefully you can find his Secret Recipe before somebody else nabs it.\r\nIt should be with the Doll Claw Games on the 3rd-4th floor of the Shopping Center, right?\r\n
2273.2: Whew! Finally, you convinced Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to cater the party. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
2273.name: The Secret Recipe

2274.0: After all that, you were finally able to convince Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to help. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
2274.1: Next on the list is getting a makeup artist. Head over to #bTina#k and see if she'll help.
2274.2: You met and talked with #bTina#k, but it seemed like she wanted you to do something for her first.
2274.name: Reception Party Preparation, Done!

2275.0: Help #bTina#k with her request, then ask her to help with Blake's debut.
2275.1: Tina needs key chains to give out to her clients. Collect the key chains and dolls from the Doll Claw Games.
2275.2: You were able to get a makeup artist for the job. Deliver the good news to #bLana#k.
2275.name: Tina's Proposition

2276.0: You booked a makeup artist. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
2276.1: This time, you must book a hair stylist. Go over to #bMarshall#k and ask for help.
2276.2: #bMarshall#k says he can't design Blake's hair. Why not? This can't be good. Discuss it with #bLana#k.
2276.name: Makeup Artist, Booked!

2277.0: Marshall refuses to help. What is stopping him? Report the bad news to #bLana#k.
2277.1: Find the Locker Key Marshall lost and open the #bLocker#k at the subway station. He supposedly lost his Locker Key on the 5th-6th floor of the Shopping Center.
2277.2: You found the Locker Key #bMarshall#k lost, but the locker closed shortly after you opened it. Try opening the locker one more time.
2277.name: Marshall's Refusal

2278.1: When you open the Locker, you find the #bLegendary Scissors#k. Hurry and deliver the scissors to Marshall.
2278.2: #bMarshall#k was ecstatic when you delivered the Legendary Scissors and agreed to style Blake's hair in a heartbeat. Give #bLana#k the good news.
2278.name: Legendary Scissors

2279.0: Thanks to your hard work, Marshall agreed to take the gig. Give #bLana#k the good news.
2279.1: Lana suggested that you ask #bLala#k, Blake's number one fan, for help with the costumes.
2279.2: #bLala#k was thrilled to hear that Blake was finally make a debut, and asked you to give her some time to brainstorm.
2279.name: Hair Stylist, Booked!

2280.0: Lala is thrilled to hear that Blake is finally making his debut and happily agrees to help with the costumes. Assist #bLala#k to prepare the costumes.
2280.1: Collect the costumes and props for Blake's debut performance and take them over to #bLala#k.
2280.2: #bLala#k was thrilled to hear about Blake's debut and asked you to give her some time to think about which costumes would be best for the performance.
2280.name: Costume Preparation

2281.0: You've completed the costume preparation, but she says something is still missing. What could possibly be missing? Ask #bLala#k what else she needs.
2281.1: #bLala#k says she needs more than just costumes and wants you to bring perfume that would complete each costume.
2281.2: #bLala#k wasn't sure which scent would go best with which costume, so she gave you some time to think about it. \r\nHm, you don't seem too sure either. Why don't you leave it up to #bLala#k?\r\n
2281.name: Costume Preparation, Done!

2282.0: You aren't sure which scent would go best with which costume. Why don't you leave it up to #bLala#k?
2282.1: Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this rose scent would best complement.
2282.2: #bLana#k said the rose scent would go best with the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. Time to tell #bLala#k.
2282.name: Rose Scent

2283.0: Lana says the rose scent is perfect for the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. Time to let #bLala#k know.
2283.1: Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this freesia scent would best complement.
2283.2: #bLana#k said the freesia scent would go best with the Female Mannequin's Wig. Go tell #bLala#k.
2283.name: Freesia Scent

2284.0: Lana says the freesia scent is perfect for the Female Mannequin's Wig. Better tell #bLala#k.
2284.1: Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this lavender scent would best complement.
2284.2: #bLana#k said the lavender scent wasn't exactly perfect for the Fedora, but that it would work. \r\nAsk #bLana#k what other tasks are left on her to-do list.
2284.name: Lavender Scent

2285.0: Lana says she needs to pick out a song for Blake. Talk to #bLana#k for more details on what she needs.
2285.1: Blake needs a song to perform. Find the CDs at the music shop on the 7th-8th floor and deliver them to #bLana#k.
2285.2: Lana said the existing hits weren't good enough and asked you to get a new song from #bMaestro Rho#k.
2285.name: Music Preparation

2286.0: Lana wants you to request a new song from a genius composer? Maestro Rho is not only known for his talents but is also infamous for his arrogance. Oh well, gotta do what you gotta do. Go talk to #bMaestro Rho#k and request a new song.
2286.1: Destroy the Cheap Amplifiers and find Maestro Rho's lost MP3 player. Follow the sound coming from the 7th-8th floor to where #bJune#k is on duty.
2286.2: When you found the MP3 player and returned it to Maestro Rho, he said he wanted to listen to some music before helping you. How rude! But this is for Blake, so you should ask him again... And try to be nice.
2286.name: Request for a New Song

2287.0: You found and returned Maestro Rho's MP3 player. That ought to be enough to get a new song, right? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for a new song Blake can perform during his debut concert.
2287.1: A composition fee? Well, that's somewhat understandable since he's a brilliant composer. Find the Fancy Amplifier Cables on the 7th-8th floor and deliver them to #bMaestro Rho#k.
2287.2: You have paid the fee, but he still seems reluctant to give you the song. What's up with that? Talk to #bMaestro Rho#k again.
2287.name: Composition Fee

2288.0: Master Rho doesn't seem like he's ready to hand over the new song even though you've already paid the fee. Why is he so hesitant? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k if everything is okay.
2288.1: Spirit of Rock is playing Maestro Rho's music without proper approval. Defeat Spirit of Rock and listen to the last song he plays.\r\n\r\nIt is highly recommended that you turn up the volume a bit in the system options so you don't miss any important parts of the song while you're listening.
2288.2: You have destroyed Spirit of Rock as Maestro Rho requested. But he's still reluctant to let go of his Composition Notes. You don't have much time left. Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for the new song.
2288.name: Say "NO" to Plagiarism

2289.0: He must have found his Composition Notes by now. Go and get the Composition Notes from #bMaestro Rho#k.
2289.1: Deliver the #bComposition Notes#k to #bLana#k, the CEO of Big Hit Records.
2289.2: All preparations for Blake's debut performance are now complete. Go over to #bBlake#k and give him the good news.
2289.name: The New Song

2290.0: Everything seems to be in order. Confirm one more time with #bLana#k.
2290.1: Lana says everything for Blake's debut performance is good to go and wants you to give #bBlake#k the good news.
2290.2: Blake was beyond happy and gave you a special gift. He then said you should go see #bJune#k at Kerning Square.
2290.name: Debut Preparations Completed

2291.0: Could it be...? Is it really the VIP Zone in Kerning Square? Rush over to #bJune#k!
2291.1: He says he'll let you enter the VIP Zone if you bring him VIP Tickets. He says you can get them from any monster in Kerning Square.
2291.2: He says the VIP Zone can be entered once every 30 minutes. Go see #bJune#k when the 30 minutes are up.
2291.name: Admission to the VIP Zone

2292.0: Jake, who works at the subway station at the center of Kerning City has something on his mind.\r\nHead over to #bJake#k and see what's going on.\r\n
2292.1: Jake says he wants nothing more than to see Blake achieve his dream. Who's Blake anyway?\r\nPass through the turnstile and go over to Kerning Square Station.\r\n
2292.2: Blake has asked you to wait, as he was in the middle of something.
2292.name: Blake's Dream

2293.0: Try to remember the last song Spirit of Rock performed.\r\nIf you can't remember, the only thing left to do is to destroy Spirit of Rock again.
2293.1: Try to remember the last song Spirit of Rock performed.\r\nIf you can't remember, the only thing left to do is to destroy Spirit of Rock again.
2293.2: You told Maestro Rho the last song Spirit of Rock performed.
2293.name: The Last Song

28000.0: There's an awesome Maplemas party going on in Happyville!
28000.1: Extra extra! Happyville is holding an amazing party for Maplemas! For more details, please go see Rooney.
28000.2: I talked to Rooney about the impending Maplemas party. Apparently it's a dress-up party, so I better go talk to Cliff about a possible potion for transformation.
28000.name: Maplemas Surprise Party!

28001.0: I better go see Cliff so I can attend the party that takes place in Happyville.
28001.1: I have to gather up 50 Rascal's Snowflakes in order to receive the special potion required to transform.
28001.2: Now that I am ready to dress-up and transform, it's time to party!
28001.name: In Preparation for the Party

28002.0: A secret note came from the Snow Spirit of Happyville. I wonder what happened?
28002.1: I finally realized the true intent of the Snow Spirit as she strives to protect Happyville from disaster. In order to ruin Scrooge's plan, she asked Alcaster of El Nath for some much needed help. I better go find him immediately!
28002.2: I gave Alcaster a note from Snow Spirit. Now it's time for me to wait for his reply.
28002.name: A Secret Note

28003.0: Alcaster says he has something for Snow Spirit.
28003.1: He handed me a reply letter to Snow Spirit, a note that contains the exact method we should take to defeat Scrooge. I better go see her right now!
28003.2: I gave the Snow Spirit Alcaster's reply letter. She stood quietly for a moment, then gave me something called Force of the Spirit, which she said was the key to defeating Scrooge. What exactly is this?
28003.name: Alcaster's Reply

28004.0: Scrooge seems to have started putting his plan into reality. I better go see Snow Spirit.
28004.1: Protect the snowman from Scrooge and his men!
28004.2: I was able to protect the symbol of luck here in Happyville, the giant snowman. That really made my day.
28004.name: Save the Snowman!

28102.0: Hmm, there's a man who looks a little distraught... should I help him?
28102.1: I went and spoke with Ben, and he's trying to make a special flower for his wife called the Red Dahlia. He got injured and needs someone to collect the materials for him. I agreed to help, and bring back #b30 Stiff Feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k he needs to make the flower. Seems like a nice enough guy, shame he got injured, but I can get him what he wants...
28102.2: I retrieved all the materials Ben needed and he'll be able to make the Red Dahlia. In return for my help, he gave me a scroll that will help me in my travels.
28102.name: Amoria : Red Dahlia - Pirate

28103.0: The wife of a sailor, eh? I'll bet she needs some help.
28103.1: I spoke with the lovely Angelique, and I'm going to deliver #b25 Soft Feathers#k to her husband, Richard, for her. He works on Tae Gong's ship in Aqua Road. Once I have everything, I'll head there, drop everything off, and let Angelique know her husband has everything.
28103.2: I delivered the materials to Richard and he thanked me. His wife must be happy...
28103.name: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Pirate

28104.0: Okay, so now I gotta go see the sailor himself. Where must he be?
28104.1: I delivered everything to Richard and he asked me delivered his letter to his wife.
28104.2: I delivered everything to Richard and returned to Angelique. She gave me something nice, and I can go back to here anytime for a quick job.
28104.name: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Pirate

28105.0: There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
28105.1: I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons#k in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
28105.2: I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...
28105.name: Cleaning Up The Streets

28109.0: Lara is looking for a brave adventurer who wants to prove their strength and courage by a dangerous task--finding MV's Treasure.
28109.1: Lara asked me to find MV's Sabre in MV's Treasure Dungeon. She said that many monsters are guarding the treasure so I should be prepared. \n\n#i4032119# #t4032119# #b#c4032119#/1#k
28109.2: Lara was really happy when I gave her MV's Sabre, and she gave me a nice gift in return.

#o9400742# #r#a281102# #k
#o9400743# #r#a281103##k

28114.0: I think it's about time Icebyrd gave me some answers...I should go speak with him.
28114.1: I've spoken with Icebyrd, and he seems cryptic-what is he hiding?
28114.2: Icebyrd has revealed the truth to me at last-he was contacted by Subani to establish New Leaf City as well as anchor Masteria to the Maple World.  He was sworn to secrecy, and to this day, can never leave the continent.  It appears that Subani and Icebyrd are the first line of defense against the demonic Naricain, and by defeating his Twisted Masters; I am now his enemy as well.  He also mentioned that our adventures here have just begun...with the Twisted Masters out of the way, what's next?  Perhaps answers lie within the #bKrakian Jungle#k, and the mysterious city there...only time will tell!
28114.name: Cool as Ice

28115.0: This is Icebyrd Slimm, mayor of New Leaf City. I want to thank you for helping us get the city up and running. I have something for you, so come see me immediately!
28115.1: As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!
28115.2: As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!

28124.0: There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
28124.1: I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons#k in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
28124.2: I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

28128.0: I heard Kopee Relicseeker is looking to find the #bMiwok Artifact#k. Let's go ask Kopee Relicseeker what she's after.
28128.1: Kopee Relicseeker and Toh Relicseeker say they are looking for Miwok Artifacts that have been lost. Let's acquire the #bMiwok Artifact Piece#k from the monsters and take them to her.
28128.2: Kopee Relicseeker was so happy to find a sign of the Miwok Artifact. She and Toh Relicseeker said they would stay for a while and further search for the Miwok Artifact.
28128.name: In Search of the Miwok Artifact

28129.0: Happy to have found the remnant of the Miwok Artifacts, Kopee says she has something to tell me. Let's go and see her.
28129.1: Kopee offered to make me a Legendary Tribal Ring using the belongings of her Miwok ancestors! I should collect every artifact I find and take my findings to Kopee.
28129.2: Kopee, using the ancestors' belongings, made me a ring. I received a Circle of Ancient Thought from her! She told me she'd make me one every time I bring her an artifact. I'd better take what I find to Kopee.
28129.name: The Legendary Tribal Ring: Circle of Ancient Thought

28130.0: Happy to have found the remnant of the Miwok Artifacts, Kopee says she has something to tell me. Let's go and see her.

28130.2: Kopee, using the ancestors' belongings, made me a ring. I received a Circle of Ancient Strength from her! She told me she'd make me one every time I bring her an artifact. I'd better take what I find to Kopee.
28130.name: The Legendary Tribal Ring: Circle of Ancient Strength

28131.0: Kopee says she'll make a nice chair for the person who has released the seal of the #bMiwok Artifact#k. Let's go talk to her.
28131.1: Kopee says that she'll make you a #bMiwok Chief's Chair#k as a token of her appreciation for your help. She says if I go and talk to Toh Relicseeker and release the seal of the #bMiwok Artifact#k 20 times using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k, she'll make me the chair. It's a great opportunity for me to receive a reward and the Chief's Chair from the Miwok Artifact.
28131.2: Kopee gave me a Miwok Chief's Chair as a gift, thanking me for finding the Miwok Artifact. It's an impressive chair that is both soft and cozy.
28131.name: Soft and Cozy Chief's Chair
28131.summary: Release the seal on the Miwok Artifact 20 times

28136.0: I hear that #b#p2040050##k over in Sleepywood is working on a way to scroll items without equipping them.  I should go see Eurek and see how far along his research is--maybe I can learn how to do it!
28136.1:
I spoke with Eurek and he's perfected his method for scrolling unequipped items. I've agreed to gather some materials for him for a trip he's taking. I'll need to get #b#p2040050##k everything he needs: 

#t1302013#  #b#c1302013#/1#k
#t2043000#  #b#c2043000#/1#k
#t2040000#  #b#c2040000#/1#k
#t2040400#  #b#c2040400#/1#k
#t2040600#  #b#c2040600#/1#k
#b1,000,000 mesos. I can't wait for him to show me how to perform this new skill!
28136.2: I returned with the materials that #b#p2040050##k asked for and learned how to use scrolls on unequipped items! Eurek also mentioned that in his travels, he'd heard rumors of a powerful monster residing somewhere in Leafre--even stronger than Zakum.
28136.name: The Wandering Alchemist Eurek's New Skill

The ones I need to meet up are #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo#k, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks. I found #bStaff Sergeant Charlie and Sergeant Bravo#k. Now I have to find #bCorporal Easy#k next.
3002.2: I found #bCorporal Easy#k in the middle of an old-looking tower far from El Nath. He said he's been doing his duties and that, while investigating around the area, he found this piece of an ancient document that he wants me to deliver to Master Sergeant Fox.

3002.rewardSummary:

He was really happy about it, and gave me the scroll made out of those pieces. He also wished that I could drop by sometime later and see how the other men are doing...maybe I should...

3004.0: I should go see Alcaster of El Nath right now...

The only living descendant of the author of the "Book of Ancient"  #bHella#k who lives in Orbis. I better go to find her right now~

3004.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
3004.rewardSummary: Can proceed to the 'Hella's Missing'' quest

According to her, Hella hadn't been home in months, and no one knows where she went or why. She did tell me to go see her best friend, #bJade of El Nath#k, so I should go there immediately.

3005.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
3005.rewardSummary:
2,000 EXP
Can proceed to the "Where's Hella?" quest.

3006.rewardSummary:
2,000 EXP

3009.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

3,500 EXP

He told me a story of how, a long time ago, a bunch of monsters from the dead mine claimed the life of his wife, enraging his son Nick. 3 years later, he went into the dead mine, hoping to avenge his mother's death, but haven't been heard since. He wanted me to find #bNick's Ring#k somewhere at the innermost part of the lava cave. He also wants me to grant his dying wish, which would be collecting #b100 Cerebes' teeth#k. This will be VERY tough to do ...
3036.2: I went into the innermost part of the lava cave, where I found a chipped part of a statue. I have a feeling something is in here.

3036.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter

#t4000079# #b#c4000079##k/80
#t4031060# #b#c4031060##k/1

3070.0: I should go meet up with Shammos, who lives somewhere around El Nath.
3070.1: I met Shammos at the basement of Chief's Residence. Apparently a plan from back then had backfired and rendered him to where he is today ... it seems like he was planning up something sinister, and the four chiefs found out about it and sealed him up. Anyway, he looks really intimidating, and he seems to be cooking up something terrible again. He's not telling me what it is, but he wants me to head over to Perion to get the item he needs. Am I doing the right thing by helping him out?
3070.2: I met up with Manji, who knows a thing or two about the #b#t4031218##k.
3070.name: Shammos's Request

3071.0: I met up with Manji, who knows something about the #b#t4031218##k.
3071.1: Manji told me some things about the #b#t4031218##k. I couldn't believe what I was hearing. #b#t4031218##k can bring the dead's back to life, and the source of its energy is apparently #b#t4031218##k. That's why the zombies have been wandering around as if they are alive. The unfathomable force of #b#t4031218##k ... I need to find it and take them to Shammos. \n\n#t4031218# #b#c4031218##k/1
3071.2: I gathered up the #b#t4031218##k and gave them back to Shammos.
3071.name: The Secrets Behind the Contract of Darkness

3072.0: I got a hold of a letter of help from someone who had been sent somewhere near the current at Aquarium. I wonder where exactly the writer is...
3072.1: I picked up a letter of help from someone. Through the dry sand inside the glass bottle, I was able to find Robinson, who had been asking for help for a while. He seemed tired from the long solitary stay at the island, and he wanted to me to get him a bottle, too. \n\n#t2022000# #b#c2022000##k/1
3072.2: I wound up giving Robinson, who had been trapped in this island for a long time, a nice clean bottle of water. How did he end up getting lost in the first place?
3072.name: The Bottled-up Letter

3073.1: I met Robinson in the middle of the island right at the center of the ocean, and he said that he used be a pilot for the army of Omega Sector, but while in a combat against the aliens, he ran away from the scene, only to be swept by strong currents that led you to where you were. He wishes to get back to the Omega Sector, but currently we have no idea where we are, and he's been covered with scars. As a result, he asked me if I can go to the Omega Sector, notify #b#p2051001##k of his troubles, and ask for some relief. Where is the Omega Sector?
3073.2: I went to see #b#p2051001##k at the Omega Sector, and handed him a card of Robinson's ID. He said everyone's been wondering of his whereabouts, and wanted me to describe the position of the island in detail.
3073.name: Robinson's ID

3074.1: Kay of the Omega Sector complained of the lack of members available due to the battle against the aliens, and asked me if I could give this warp capsule, specially made in Omega Sector, to Robinson. A warp capsule that takes the person to the Omega Sector regardless of the place of origin? That's awesome!! I want to take it myself for a split second, until I found out that only the Omega Sector members can use it. Darn it...
3074.2: Kay needed help from me, since he couldn't send the rescuers to save Robinson, and so I got the specially-made warp capsule and gave it to Robinson. Now he can go back to the Omega Sector and get himself fixed.
3074.name: Sending Relief

3075.1: #b#p2060006##k, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me to go see her. #b#p2060006##k said she wanted to find out the whereabouts of her boyfriend #bGail#k, who has volunteered to be part of the exploration team that heads deep in the underwater, and asked me if I could go talk to #b#p2060100##k the sea witch about him.
3075.2: At the request of #p2060006#, I went to see #p2060100# the sea witch. #p2060100# lived inside the cave at #m230040000#.

She requested that I get #b3 #t4031256#s#k and #b10 #t4031251#s#k from #r#o8140600##k, and #b1 #t4031253##k that can be obtained through #r#o8510000##k while it's dying.

3077.0: I gathered up all the materials that #p2060100# asked me get. Maybe I can now find out what happened to Gail.
3077.1: According to #b#p2060100##k, something terrible indeed happened to Gail. What can possibly happen underwater? Anyway, I should let #b#p2060006##k of this immediately. I hope he takes it well...
3077.2: I told #b#p2060006##k the result of #b#p2060100##k's fortune-telling. What does it mean by the dark fog that surrounds Gail? #p2060006# was trying to act calm, but I could tell she's feeling nervous about Gail. Is #p2060100#'s stuff really worth believing?
3077.name: Carta's Fortune-Telling

3078.0: I should be able to see #p2060101# deep in the underwater... somewhere around #m230040400#.
3078.1: I met #b#p2060101##k in between #m230040400# at an empty ship that's been wrecked. He said he's been looking for the traces of his missing men. He came down here to check out the irregular activities that have been taking place here, and one day he lost contact with his men. Not only did he lose them, but he said the path to the bottom of the ocean is blocked too, so he asked me for help on looking for traces of his men. I should wander around looking for #bitems that can be used as evidence#k. If the items the men have used are still here, then maybe the #bsharks#k that have been roaming around #b#m230040400##k is the one to blame... I should find a #bflashlight#k, a #bcamera#k and a #bnotebook#k, and give them back to #b#p2060101##k.
3078.2: #p2060101#, whom I've met at #m230040400#, asked me to find traces of his men that have disappeared. I was able to gather up the flashlight, the camera, and the notebook that his men used at the time of the attack. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find any of the missing men.
3078.name: The Blocked Path of the Ocean

3086.1: I ran to the Cloud Park of Orbis just to hear the disturbing prophecy from #b#p2032001##k herself. She said nonchalantly that #m200000000# will crash to the ground soon. I asked her of the ways to save #m200000000#, only to hear her say it's all going to be in vain, and decided not to help me out. I can't let #m200000000# crash down like that! I better go talk to #b#p2032001##k again.
3086.2: I went to see #p2032001# again, but she sat down, motionless, as if she was meditating right then and there. Will #m200000000# crash and burn just like that? But then, a girl standing next to #p2032001# is looking at me as if she has something to say on this matter. Who must she be...?

I should talk to her again...

Orbis floats in the air thanks to the mythical, magical power that's laden in the clouds, but the Pixie's have been soaking up that magical power from the clouds to their advantage. The Pixies use that power to increase their magical powers, and by doing so, the clouds have been weakened to the point of Orbis making its freefall. To start the fixing, she wanted me to gather up #b25 #t4031309#s#k from #o3230200#, #o4230106#, and #o5120000# for her.\n\n#t4031309#  #b#c4031309##k / 25
3088.2: Just the way the mysterious girl at #p2032001#'s house requested, I gathered up 25 #t4031309#s from the Pixie's and gave them to her.

3089.1: The key tool used to fix the Orbis clouds is the Cloud Sprayer, but ever since Elma the Housekeeper borrowed it some 50 years ago, the sprayer hasn't been seen since. 50 years, and still no return??? I better go see #bElma the Housekeeper#k.
3089.2: I met up with Elma and received the #t4031308# that she borrowed 50 years ago. I should go back to Spiruna's house now.
3089.name: The Sprayer Elma Borrowed 1

3090.1: I received #t4031308# from Elma the Housekeeper. It looks like a significant amount of time has passed since I came here. I better get back to #p2032001#'s house immediately.\n\n#t4031308# #b#c4031308##k / 1
3090.2: I received the Cloud Sprayer from Elma the Housewife. The cloud fixing should be a breeze now with this in store. This better stop the freefall of Orbis.
3090.name: The Sprayer Elma Borrowed 2

3091.1: Kriel, a proud owner of a set of wings, was blowing off travelers that weren't fortunate enough to have them. I don't think she has a clue that there are numerous breathtaking places that just cannot be reached by flying. According to Lisa, Kriel's not to enthused with the fact that she can only hear about the rumors of Aqua Road and not being able to go there in person. Anyway, Lisa suggested that I buy Kriel "The Official Aqua Road Photo Album" from #bMuse#k. Muse, huh... Another trip underwater... \n\n#i4031310# #t4031310#   #b#c4031310##k / 1
3091.2: I gave Muse 100 snow crystals and purchased the Official Aqua Road Photo Album, then gave it to Kriel for the viewing. After seeing her admit how beautiful Aqua Road is, I must say I felt validated by it, but it also seems like she set the whole thing up for this from the get go. Oh well, at least Kriel's happy, and that's good enough for me.
3091.name: The Ocean View : Kriel's Offer

3092.1: I met with #p2060006#, the person who sells #t4031310#. Unfortunately, she mentioned that the photo album is sold out. After relentlessly asking her questions about it, she relented and told me she'll give me the photo album that she kept for herself. In return, she wanted me to show her #t4031312#, since she's never seen snow before in her life. #b#t4031312##k is made by #r#p2020005##k of El Nath.
3092.2: After receiving the request from #p2060006# to see the Snow Crystal Sphere, I headed off to El Nath to see #p2020005#.

3108.2: Found the Spirit of Snow Sculpture deep in the snowfield. Maybe this is the clue Scadur is looking for? This statue might have something to do with the Snowman. Let's go back to Scadur.

3109.1: Scadur says the Snowman is angry because the Spirit of the Sculpture is damaged, and adds that we need to restore it. However, restoring the sculpture will take some time, and somebody needs to hold the Snowman back from attacking anyone else.\n\n#o8220001# #r#a31091##k
3109.2: Blocked the Snowman and came back to Scadur. He says Alcaster has completed his preparations to restore the sculpture and tells me to go see him.

3110.2: The snowman seems to have returned to its gentle self as soon as the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture was restored. No worries about the Snowman attacking anyone else, right?

3112.2: Met #bEliza#k sitting gracefully inside Eliza's Garden. #bEliza#k showed no traces of anger, instead looking calm.

3113.1: #bEliza#k was angry when she heard that her goddess was kidnapped right after she awoke, and she couldn't control her anger. Now she realizes that it was foolish of her, and regrets being angry. #bEliza#k herself is at peace now, but her #rClone#k, which was created through her angry impulses, is still roaming about and attacking innocent people. #bEliza#k asks me to defeat the #rEliza#k up in #b Stairway to the Sky II#k. \n\n#o8220000# #r#a31131##k
3113.2: #bEliza#k is relieved of hearing that her clone is no longer able to do any harm.

3223.2: I found the lost tool for Roly-Poly 6. I'm hoping this will allow him to fix things at Eos Tower now.
3223.name: Roly-Poly 6's Tool

3224.0: I should go check out Roly-Poly 8 at Eos Tower
3224.1:
I met up with Roly-Poly 8 again at Eos Tower. He seemed worried that there's a lot of places to fix at Eos Tower, only to have the monsters stop him from doing so. He asked if I could take out #b25 #o3230103#es#k and collect #b20 Plastic Crowns#k in the process. I can do this... 

#o3230103# #r#a32241##k
#t4000100# #b#c4000100##k/20
3224.2: I took out a bunch of #o3230103#s and collected #c4000100#s just the way the Roly-Poly 8 of Eos Tower asked. How long is this maintenance job going to last anyway? This should get done soon so I don't have to do them any more favors.
3224.name: Helping Fix Eos Tower

3225.0: I should go check out Roly-Poly 10 at Eos Tower.
3225.1:
I met up with Roly-Poly 10 again at Eos Tower. He asked if I could get him #b30 Yellow Toy Blocks#k and #b15 Blue Toy Blocks#k to fix the tower. I think I can get those by taking out the Block Golems...

#t4000101# #b#c4000101##k/30
#t4000102# #b#c4000102##k/15
3225.2: I gave Roly-Poly 10 the yellow blocks and blue blocks needed to fix this place up. A toy block used to fix a castle...where else can this happen but here in Ludibrium?
3225.name: Fixing Eos Tower

3226.0: I heard something happened to Korin of Ludibrium... I better go check up on her.
3226.1: I met a girl named #bKorin#k at a small house nearby Ludibrium. Korin had been missing for 10 months, and she did not remember anything that occurred during that time. She wanted me to find these men wearing the black suit that visited her the other day, and ask him whatever happened to her the last 10 months. A man wearing black suit... I don't think he'd be at Ludibrium nor Eos Tower.
3226.2: I met Korin, who was suffering from partial loss of memory, at Ludibrium. I was able to meet Agent Marco at the Omega Sector. He's the man wearing the black suit who held the clue regarding her lost memory.
3226.name: The Girl Who Lost Her Memory

3227.1: I met #bAgent Marco#k at the Omega Sector. I asked him some questions regarding Korin, and I was able to find out that she had been kidnapped by a group of aliens that invaded the Omega Sector. He also said that in order to recover Korin's lost memories, I'll have to defeat the #bMateons#k and collect #b5 Memory Pieces#k that contain her lost memories... I'll have to head over to the Boswell Field quickly.\n\n#t4031090# #b#c4031090##k/5
3227.2: I defeated the aliens that took Korin's memories, gathered up the memory pieces, and gave them to Agent Marco. He then put the pieces together and made it into one whole piece.
3227.name: The Man in the Black Suit

3228.1: After defeating a bunch of #bMateons#k at the Boswell Field, I went through their stuff and found 5 #bMemory Pieces#k that contained Korin's lost memories. I gave them to Agent Marco, and he proceeded to put the 5 together into one whole piece of #bKorin's Memory#k. Now all I have left to do is give this piece of memory back to Korin.
3228.2: I gave Korin her lost memories through the man in Omega Sector wearing black suits, #bAgent Marco#k. She was initially disoriented after recovering her memories, but she promised to fully enjoy life the way she used to before the kidnapping. Hopefully that'll never happen again.
3228.name: The Recovered Memory

3229.0: I should go see Delv the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower.
3229.1: Delv the Toy Soldier, firmly protecting the gates of the 100th floor on Eos Tower, asked me for a favor by getting him #b20 tasty walnuts#k as a way to fight the boredom of guarding the gate and doing little else. He said a black rat monster called #bDirty Ratz#k might offer up the walnuts...\n\n#t4031093# #b#c4031093##k/20
3229.2: I got Delv the Toy Soldier, firmly protecting the gates of the 100th floor on Eos Tower, the #b20 tasty walnuts#k he requested as a way to fight the boredom of guarding the gate and doing little else. He was very thankful and asked if I could go talk to his buddy Olson next to him if I have some free time to burn.
3229.name: Toy Soldier's Walnut

3230.0: I should go see Olson the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower
3230.1: I ran into Olson the Toy Soldier at the 100th floor on Eos Tower, doing his job as the security guard next to Delv. Olson told me a story of a monster sneaking in through the cracks of time and stealing a pendulum from the clocktower, culminating with the monster disguising itself as a dollhouse somewhere inside. I need to locate the one that's different from the sea of dollhouses in here.
3230.2: Inside the secret room of Eos Tower, I located the monster disguised as a dollhouse, destroyed it, recovered the pendulum, and gave it to Mark the Toy Soldier. This should get the Ludibrium Clocktower to start working again.
3230.name: Dollhouse

3231.0: I should go see Olson the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower
3231.1: Olson the Toy Soldier from the 100th floor of Eos Tower wanted me to get the #b#t4031094##k obtained from the monster disguised as the dollhouse to #p2040029# at the Lost Time somewhere inside the Clocktower. Apparently the #p2040029# should be able to fix him.
3231.2: I found Grandpa Clock standing around somewhere in the lost time, but he looks very lethargic, as if he's about to stop.
3231.name: The Broken Clocktower
3231.parent: A Delivery to a Lost Time

3232.1: After obtaining the #b#t4031094##k by destroying the dollhouse the monster disguised as, I went down to the Lost Time to find #p2040029#. But it seemed like instead of him helping me fix the clocktower, he was about to die first, so he wanted me to take down some monsters called #bTick-Tock#k and pick up the #b#t4031098##k that they possess. I better get them before #p2040029# dies.
3232.2: I got the #t4031098# from Tick Tock. I need to get this to the #p2040029# before it's too late.
3232.name: Grandpa Clock's Crisis
3232.parent: A Delivery to a Lost Time

3233.1: At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave #p2040029# the #b#t4031098##k from Tick-Tock's. I'm glad I got to give this to him before too late. Now I should wait to hear a word from #bOlson#k.
3233.2: At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave #p2040029# the #b#t4031094##k, an essential part of the clocktower. Now all I have to do is wait for the #p2040029# to fix the clocktower. Will this work?
3233.name: Delivering the #t4031094#
3233.parent: A Delivery to a Lost Time

3234.0: I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
3234.1: Deep in the Lost Time of Ludibrium, I met up with #p2040029#. He seemed to be annoyed by the fact that the tiny Ticks have been going inside the clocktower and destroy parts of it, making his job much harder than it should have been. For the sake of #p2040029#, I'll need to take out #b80 Ticks#k. \n\n#o3210207# #r#a32341#
3234.2: I took care of the request #p2040029# made, by taking out the #bTicks#k. The Ticks were another one of the reasons the clocktower seemed to have something wrong at all times, so this should give #p2040029# a good night's sleep.
3234.name: The Clocktower Headache

3235.0: I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
3235.1: I met up with #p2040029# deep inside the abandoned time of Ludibrium. #p2040029# admitted since he's an old fella, the spring was needed to rewind himself back to life, but the younger clock workers these days are all battery-operated, only to have some of them not have adequate batteries and thus not working the way it should be. I should collect #b200 cheap batteries#k for the sake of those clocks in need of them. \n\n#t4000111# #b#c4000111##k/200
3235.2: I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. #p2040029# seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...?
3235.name: The Clock Workers' Batteries

3236.0: I should go see #p2041018# at Toy Factory.
3236.1:
I ran into #bHans#k, the toy assembler at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. He made a proposal where if I get him some parts for a toy, then he'll assemble it and make something fun out of it. This is sweet! The things I'll need are #b20 cheap batteries from the Robo, 20 metal hearts of Master Robo, and 30 cogs of Chronos#k. 

#t4000111# #b#c4000111##k/20
#t4000112# #b#c4000112##k/20
#t4000115# #b#c4000115##k/30
3236.2: At the toy factory in Ludibrium, I gave Hans the parts needed to assemble a toy. Hans put together the parts and made a very unique sack out of it. He said he put some toys inside, but... I don't know, something may pop up that'll scare the daylight out of me. I better be careful with it...
3236.name: Assembling a Toy

3237.1:
I met up with #p2041019# at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium Clocktower. Rocky seemed to be swamped with work due to a sudden increase in monsters destroying parts here and there. He was worried about running out of essential parts, so he asked me if I could gather up #b50 cogs#k and #b30 screws#k. .

#t4003000# #b#c4003000##k/30
#t4000115# #b#c4000115##k/50
3237.2: At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I gave Rocky the cogs and screws needed for him to fix anything that is broken. Hopefully that was enough to undo the damages done by those pesky monsters.
3237.name: Rocky's Parts

3238.0: I'll need to have a word with Mac the Mechanic.
3238.1: I met up with Mac the Mechanic at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. Mac was panicking because of the fact that all the blueprints and #bMaintenance Manual#k of the factory were stolen by Toy Trojan. If I destroy the boxes around the Toy Factory, I may find a hidden path that'll lead me to a clue.
3238.2: I found the documents Mac the Mechanic lost, and he seemed very much relieved by it. Something's strange, though. Why would the toy soldiers feel the need to steal this in the first place...?
3238.name: Mac the Mechanic's Maintenance Manual

3239.0: I better go see Cheng the Assistant, who should be somewhere around Toy Factory
3239.1: At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I found Cheng the Assistant riding around on a white wooden horse. Chang was concerned about the sudden disappearance of the mechanic parts all over the factory, and wanted me to find those parts for him. I should head over to Toy Factory <Main Construction1> Part 4 with help from Cheng, where the parts are hidden. I need to gather up 10 Mechanical Parts and bring them back to Cheng.
3239.2: I found the 10 missing parts in the Toy Factory and gave them back to Cheng the Assisntant. Hopefully this will help the Factory run as smoothly as it should be.
3239.name: The Missing Mechanical Parts

3240.1: Somewhere around Ludibrium, I saw a small fairy that was glowing all over her body. Her name was Wisp, and is a part of Mar the Fairy. She saw my pet in a state of doll and claimed that she can turn my doll pet back into a real-life pet with #bwater of life#k and #bmcdonald's#k. The Scroll of Life is apparently at #bCloy's House#k in Ludibrium, which should be empty at this point.
3240.2: I found the #bscroll of life#k at #bCloy's house#k in Ludibrium. I gave this, along with the #bWater of Life#k, to Wisp and he helped turn my pet back alive. I need to have some play time with my pet now!
3240.name: Scroll of Life

3241.0: Helios Tower opened recently for public, and apparently #p2041004# has been going through some trouble thanks to the growing number of #o3210208#s at the tower.
3241.1: #p2041004#, the security guard of Ludibrium, approached me and asked for a favor. He was concerned about the growing number of #b#o3210208##k at the Helios Tower, which has recently opened for travelers. According to him, the #o3210208#s have been blocking the travelers' path, as well as destroying the elevators in the tower, and he wanted me to eliminate some #o3210208#s for him.\n\n#o3210208#  #r#a32411#
3241.2: With a request from #p2041004#, the security guard of Ludibrium, I went into Helios Tower and eliminated 20 #o3210208#s, the striped rats that have been destroying the elevators at the tower.
3241.name: Cleaning Up Helios Tower

3242.name: The Messenger of the Toy Palace  1

3243.1: I received a request from #p2041004#, the security guard of #m220000000#, to head to a place called #m240000000# as the messenger of #m220000000#. #m240000000# is a town entrenched in Minar Forest somewhere in Ossyria, and I was told to deliver an item from #m2200000000# to the chief of the town, Tatamo. I better give that item from #p2041004# to #p2081000# of #m240000000#.\n\n#t4031347#  #b#c4031347##k / 1
3243.2: I managed to deliver a present from #m220000000# to the chief of Leafre, Tatamo, as their messenger. As a sign of gratitude, Tatamo gave me a magic seed that allows me to transport between Ellinia and Leafre.
3243.name: The Messenger of the Toy Palace  2
3243.parent: The Messenger of the Toy Palace

3244.0: #p2040013# apparently has been skipping lunch these days because of heavy workload... I better check it out.
3244.1:
#p2040013# complained to me that he had been missing lunch lately because of the #o3210205#s that were all over Eos Tower. The angered #p2040013# wanted me to kill #b20 #o3210205#s#k and bring him #b5 #t4000096#s#k.

#i4000096##t4000096# #b#c4000096#/5#k
#o3210205# #r#a32441##k
3244.2: I was able to help out #p2040013#, who had been missing lunch almost everyday because of the #o3210205#s invading Eos Tower, by killing off those #o3210205#s and giving him some walnuts in the process.
3244.name: Disgruntled Roly-Poly Worker

3245.0: The King's #b#p2041022##k is in need of help. What must it be? I better head over to #b#m220000400##k.
3245.1:
#p2041022# received an order to deliver the king's royal letter to #m221000000#. The problem is, he's hesitant to go, because to go to #m221000000#, he'll have to go through Eos Tower, and is afraid of descending down the Tower because of the spiders. Oh well, I'll have to kill off #r20 #o2230103#s#k #r20 #o2230104#s#k for #p2041022#.   

#o2230103# #r#a32451##k   
#o2230104# #r#a32452##k
3245.2: I was able to eliminate #o2230103# and #o2230104#. I'm sure now #p2041022# can do his job. I thought #p2041022# was unafraid of anything else in life besides the King. Spiders? That was unexpected...
3245.name: Spider's Out at Eos Tower

3246.0: #b#p2041004##k of #b#m220000000##k is concerned about a mysterious letter... what could it be?
3246.1: #p2041004# said he's been concerned about a mysterious, anonymous letter sent to the king of #m220000000#, and believes something huge is developing. He then asked me to head over to #b#m100030000##k and find out who wrote the letter...
3246.2: There's a huge wooden entryway leading into #m100030000# which I'd never seen before. It almost looks like an entryway to a fortress... I should try talking to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of me. I remember him telling me that a #bpirate #p1072008##k fort is being built here.  I wonder who the captain is...
3246.name: A Mysterious Letter

3247.0: I should go to #b#m220000000##k and listen in on #b#p2041022##k's problem.
3247.1:
#b#m220000000##k #b#p2041022##k's problem was more difficult than I imagined.  It's hard enough finding a #b#t04021005##k, but to freely donate it to the king of #b#m220000000##k!?  But if it's true that every great adventurer must learn to generously donate, maybe I need to consider donating as well. 
Plus, according to #b#p2041022##k, the king is a very generous person so it will probably be used to help those in need... This is stressful.
3247.2: I don't know if I made the right decision, but I gave away #b#t04021005##k to #b#p2041022##k.  I feel like I've somewhat wasted it but I guess it does feel good to know that I've helped someone in need.  Overall, it was a good experience.
3247.name: Rightful Donation Culture

3248.0: #b#p2041026##k in the #b#m220000000# Clocktower basement#k has proposed to begin a Clocktower Monster Wipe-Out Operation. What does he mean by that? Let's go find #p2041026#.
3248.1:

He says you can find other eggs by hunting #rTick, Tick-Tock, or Chronos type monsters#k, but #b#o5220003s# have a tendency to hatch their eggs in another bird's nest#k, so their eggs would be amongst eggs of other birds. It seems you have to crack other eggs to find it and take it over to #t4031991#.

#i2022355##t2022355# #b#c2022355#/10#k 
#i4031991##t4031991# #b#c4031991#/10#k
3248.2: You have found all the eggs and gave them to #p2041026#. Ghosthunter Bob seems satisfied and suggest you engage in the operation.
3248.name: Operation Strategy 1 : Collect All the Eggs

3249.1:
Operation strategy 2 is much simpler than strategy 1. It was to defeat the monsters! You must defeat #r#o4230113##k, #r#o3230306##k, #r#o4230114##k, #r#o4230115##k, and even #r#o5220003##k, so it's not child's play... but let's defeat the monsters.
