3249.name: Operation Strategy 2 : Defeat the Monsters

3250.1: #p2041026# seems to be preoccupied with raising birds. According to the new research conducted, #o5220003#s have undergone changes under the management of Papulatus, but can make great pets when tamed. He has given you a cute baby bird, saying you can feed the bird #b#t4031992#s#k that can be obtained from the Clocktower Monsters. He has asked you to return the bird when it's fully grown.
3250.2: The baby bird has become full-fledged since you've been diligently feeding the bird #t4031992#s. Although it's sad to let go of the bird to which you have grown attached, but you have no choice but to return the bird to Ghosthunter Bob. Be well, bird.
3250.name: Operation Strategy 3: A Cute Baby Bird

3300.0: There's a new, unknown and mysterious town called #m261000000#. It's an alchemist town, which explains the mysterious aura around it... I better go see #b#p2111007##k to gain some information on #m261000000#.
3300.1: When I asked #p2111007# about #m261000000#, he requested #b10,000 mesos#k for information, as if it's an accepted practice. Is he really a broker...? Come to think of it, #p2111007#'s reputation isn't that great either...what do I have to lose?
3300.2: After giving #p2111007# 10,000 mesos, I was able to obtain some information on #m261000000#. A long time ago, after the death of the Black Magician, the alchemists came together and set up a town called #m261000000#. Nowadays, the town is split into #b2 societies, Zenumist and Alcadno. They seem to be in constant conflict with one another.#k
3300.name: A Deal with the Broker

3301.0: Bourne of a true union of science and magic... #bZenumist, is a society of pure alchemy#k. With the conflict raging in #m261000000#, however, Zenumist doesn't seem to accept outsiders. I really want to join them, though... I better go see #b#p2111007##k.
3301.1: #p2111007# told me in order to join Zenumist, I'll have to run the rigorous test of showing my lab results to the president of the Zenumist Society. But he also said if I can get him #b2 ores of jewels, regardless of type#k, then he'd take care of the rest...
3301.2: After giving #p2111007# 2 ores, he told me to wait.  I hope I get in!
3301.name: Test from the Head of Zenumist Society

3302.1: After visiting the Broker once more, he gave me a bottle that contained some strange-looking water. He then told me to take it to #bZenumist Society#k, and place it next to the blue alchemy pillar, which will automatically create the item for me. He then told me to give it to #b#p2111000##k... is the broker really telling the truth?  Seems impossible...
3302.2: When I left #t4031705# next to the alchemy pillar, I heard a deafening explosion, followed by the creation of a useless tree branch. I had no idea what that was, but I gave it to #p2111000#. He seemed VERY satisfied with the result, and gave me #b#t1102135##k in return.  Why would he want a tree branch?
3302.name: Zenumist Cape

3303.0: A true union of alchemy and mechanical engineering, #bAlcadno, is a society that celebrates new alchemy#k. With the conflict raging in #m261000000#, however, Alcadno doesn't seem to accept others. I really want to join Alcadno, though... I better go talk to #b#p2111007##k.
3303.1: #p2111007# told me in order to join the Alcadno Society, I'll have to compile a series of lab reports and present it.  He said he could obtain a legitimate report if I pay him #b2 ores, regardless of type#k. He'd then take care of the rest...
3303.2: After giving #p2111007# 2 ores of jewels, he told me to wait.
3303.name: Test from the Head of Alcadno Society

3304.1: I received #t4031704# from the broker. I was told to give it to #p2111001# and answer the questions in the order that the broker told me in order to become a member of Alcadno... I better remember the sequences that #p2111007# gave me when I go see #p2111001#.
3304.2: After a number of tough, tough questions, #p2111001# finally accepted me as a member of Alcadno. Flashing his trademark glass eye as he gave me #t1102136#, the head of the Alcadno Society may look intimidating, but he's a really nice person.
3304.name: Alcadno Cape

3305.0: I lost #t1102135#. Without it, I can't prove that I'm Zenumist. What should I do? I better go talk to the president of the Zenumist Society, #b#p2111000##k.
3305.1:
#p2111000# gave me that look of disappointment as he asked me to bring the items required to make another #t1102135#. Those items are #b#t4000021##k and #b#t4021003##k, with #b10,000 mesos#k. Thank goodness I can make another one. 

#i4000021##t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/10 
#i4021003##t4021003# #b#c4021003##k/5
3305.2: I got #t1102135# again. Without it, I can't be accepted as a Zenumist. I better not lose it again.
3305.name: Re-acquiring Zenumist Cape

3306.0: Oh no...! I lost #t1102136#, the one item that proves that I'm a member of Alcadno. What should I do? I better go talk to the president of the Alcadno Society, #p2111001#.
3306.1:
#p2111001# told me he could give me another cape, but this time, I'll have to come up with all the items required to make the cape. As long as I can get another one, gathering the items is not a problem! Those items are #b#t4000021##k and #b#t4021006##k, with #b10,000 mesos#k.

#i4000021##t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/10 
#i4021006##t4021006# #b#c4021006##k/5
3306.2: I got Alcadno Cape again. Without it, I can't be accepted as an Alcadno. I better not lose it again.
3306.name: Re-acquiring Alcadno Cape

3307.0: #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to be looking for help with his experiment...
3307.1:
#p2111008# told me he was short on some items for his experiment and asked me to get #b5 refined #t4010004#s#k and #b50 #t4000352#s#k for him.

#i4010004##t4010004# #b#c4010004##k/5 
#i4000352##t4000352# #b#c4000352##k/50
3307.2: I gave #p2111008# #t4011004# and #t4000352#. This #t4011004# seems to have a peculiar power of registering spells into it. I learned something new today.
3307.name: Helping Out Bedin

3308.0: #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to have a plan in store. Now that I'm Zenumist, I should help him out, right? I better go see #p2111008# immediately.
3308.1: Zenumist is in conflict with Alcadno... I knew that fact, but I never thought he'd ask me for a favor like this! Anyway, since #p2111008# made the request, I better follow through with it, or I may be in trouble. I'll have to destroy #r200 #o5110300#k that Alcadnos have been working on. \n\n#o5110300#  #r#a33081#
3308.2: I destroyed the #o5110300#s that Alcadnos have been working on, at the request of #p2111008#. Hmmm... was I allowed to do this? Why do Zenumist and Alcadno have such a huge conflict between them?
3308.name: Getting in the Way of Alcadno

3349.name: For Phyllia

3350.0: Oh no... I was going to give #t4161033# to Zenumist, but I misplaced it. What should I do? If that book ends up in the wrong hands, then that spells disaster. I better talk to #b#p2020005##k.
3350.1: Clearly flustered, #p2020005# yelled at me never to misplace it again. Fortunately, with his magic powers, it is easy to spot #t4161033#, so I'll just have to wait until he finds it.
3350.2: Now that I've received #t4161033# from #p2020005#, I better head back to #p2111000# of Zenumist Society. I still have a chance to change my mind and take a different route.
3350.name: Re-acquiring Dr. De Lang's Notes

3351.0: Oh no... I was going to give #t4161033# to Alcadno, but I misplaced it. What should I do? If that book ends up in the wrong hands, then that spells disaster. I better talk to #b#p2020005##k.
3351.1: Clearly flustered, #p2020005# yelled at me never to misplace it again. Fortunately, with his magic powers, it is easy to spot #t4161033#, so I'll just have to wait until he finds it.
3351.2: Now that I've received #t4161033# from #p2020005#, I better head back to #p2111001# of Albino Society. I still have a chance to change my mind and take a different route.
3351.name: Re-acquiring Dr. De Lang's Notes

3352.0: Oh no... I was going to give #t4161033# to Phyllia, but I misplaced it. What should I do? If that book ends up in the wrong hands, then that spells disaster. I better talk to #b#p2020005##k.
3352.1: Clearly flustered, #p2020005# yelled at me never to misplace it again. Fortunately, with his magic powers, it is easy to spot #t4161033#, so I'll just have to wait until he finds it.
3352.2: Now that I've received #t4161033# from #p2020005#, I better head back to #p2111004#. I still have a chance to change my mind and take a different route.
3352.name: Re-acquiring Dr. De Lang's Notes

3353.0: I entered #m261020401# without really thinking too much about it... As usual, #b#p2111006##k the talkative ghost starts up a conversation. I don't really want to listen to him go on and on about his life. What should I do?
3353.1: When I asked about #p2111002#'s past that I saw through him in the past, Parwen's face lit up and showed me #p2111002# again. Hmmm... he looks like a bit of time has passed since I last saw him...
3353.2: I tried to start up a conversation with an obviously tired #p2111002#. His face may have the look of exhaustion, but he managed to smile just a bit. He may have failed the experiment, but he said he has succeeded in creating a new medicine for #p2111005#...
3353.name: What De Lang Wants

3354.1: #p2111002# confessed his research hasn't taken steps forward these days, but then he lightened up and told me he found a cure for #p2111005#... What? #bA medicine for #p2111005##k? But everything in #p2111002#'s house seemed to have been cleaned out. \n\nIf he didn't try so darndest to hide this, then someone from Alcadno that might have gotten through #p2111002#'s Lab Report. I better go see  #b#p2111001##k of Alcadno, since he searched #p2111002#'s whole house.
3354.2: When I told #p2111001# of #p2111002#, he seemed genuinely shocked.
3354.name: De Lang's Potion

3355.1: #p2111001# seemed to think long and hard about #p2111002#'s research, then said maybe #b#p2111003##k might know something about the medicine. #p2111003#? The one who can't even remember his past? How??
3355.2: When I asked #p2111003# about #p2111002#, he had no clue who he was. However, he did mention something about this medicine that he held on from the moment he opened his eyes.
3355.name: The Memories of Humanoid A

3356.1: I explained to #p2111003# that the medicine might cure #p2111005#, and received the medicine from him. I did bring this half suspecting this might be a scam, but really... is it enough to cure #p2111005#? The president of Alcadno Society, #b#p2111001##k, might correctively find out the list of ingredients for this.
3356.2: #p2111001# said this medicine indeed cures #p2111005#'s sickness... Why in the world was #p2111003# holding on to the medicine #p2111002# made all this time??
3356.name: Who is De Lang?

3357.1: #p2111001#'s eyes normally scare me off, but his eyes seem sad today. According to him, #p2111003# was found at #p2111002#'s lab when the lab exploded because of the failed experiment. No one knows when or how it was made... and Humanoid himself doesn't remember his origins. \n\nMaybe #p2111002#'s experiment didn't fail as everyone believes... the one item that #p2111003# is holding on to, despite not remembering anything from the past, says it all. I better go to #b#p2111005##k and give her #p2111002#'s piece of mind.
3357.2: #p2111005# seemed stunned when receiving the medicine, but then turned into pure joy and happiness. #p2111005# seemed determined to get better with the medicine, so she can really improve her alchemy skills to one day turn #p2111003# into a human being. Hopefully her experiment will end up being successful.
3357.name: De Lang and Humanoid A

3358.0: #p2111006# is the chatty ghost at the basement lab of #m261000000#. Apparently, he knows a secret passage in #m261000000# that no one is aware of... I better go talk to #b#p2111006##k.
3358.1: #p2111006# said that a long time ago, when he was an alchemist at #m261000000#, he had a #bpass#k that gave him access to the secret passage that connects Zenumist to  Alcadno. ...a Secret Passage? That sounds very interesting! #t4031745# believed that #rCytis#k might have taken it, so I'll have to find the pass myself and use it at the entrance of the Secret Passage.\n\n#i4031745##t4031745# #b#c4031745##k/1
3358.2: I brought #t4031745# to the entrance of the Secret Passage, but the door didn't open. What the...
3358.name: Parwen's Pass

3359.1: I told #p2111006# that his pass was useless, and he told me that since it's such an old pass, that its verification code might have expired. Why did I put so much hope into this? But, says #p2111006#, he will do everything in his power to give me an entry to the Secret Passage, and asked me to find #b100 #t4000363#s#k from #r#o6110301##k.\n\n#i4000363##t4000363# #b#c4000363##k/100
3359.2: I fell for #p2111006#'s promise, and got 100 #t4000363#s from #o6110301#. That's when #p2111006# started making new combination of verification codes out of the #t4000363#s.
3359.name: Searching for the Master Key

3360.1: #p2111006# said he came up with the master code that'll allow me to gain free access to the Secret Passage, and gave me a long list of numbers. Sigh... this is so complicated, I'll have to write it down somewhere.
3360.2: When I entered the master key #p2111006# gave me, the Secret Passage opened up, and now I have unlimited access to the passage. Hmm... he's much more helpful than I thought.
3360.name: Verifying the Password

3361.0: Apparently, #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, wants something...
3361.1: #p2111008# mentioned that there was an alchemist that has been ostracized by everyone for trying to combine the works of Zenumist and Alcadno, #b#p2112014##k, and he was interested in obtaining the Lab Report. He wanted me to acquire #b#t4031774##k for him, and in order to do so, I'll have to find someone that is aware of #p2112014#'s current whereabouts... \n\n#i4031774##t4031774# #b#c4031774##k/1
3361.2: I acquired #t4031774# and gave it to #p2111008#. Peering through the results, Bedin's eyes were flashing with interest.
3361.name: Zenumist and the Ostracized Research

3362.0: Apparently, #bRussellon#k, an alchemist from Alcadno, wants something...
3362.1: Russellon mentioned that there was an alchemist that has been ostracized by everyone for trying to combine the works of Zenumist and Alcadno, #bYulete#k, and he was interested in obtaining the Lab Report. He wanted me to acquire #b#t4031774##k for him, and in order to do so, I'll have to find someone that is aware of #p2112014#'s current whereabouts... \n\n#i4031796##t4031796# #b#c4031796##k/1
3362.2: I was able to find Yulete's Lab Report, and gave it to Russellon. According to him, Yulete's studies were released at the height oc the conflict between Zenumist and Alcadno, and mentioned that if he released it at an opportune time, then he could have received a much more favorable response.
3362.name: Alcadno and the Ostracized Research

3363.0: Magatia's diminutive Fairy alchemist, #bKeeny#k, is lately studying hard on mechanical dolls, Roids.
3363.1: Keeny said she heard a rumor that the mysterious alchemist #bYulete#k invented a new type of Roid, and wanted to study more on his Frankenroid. Good thinking, except finding Yulete, who has been virtually banished from Magatia, and actually #btalking#k to him might be difficult...
3363.2: While helping Romeo and Juliet out, I was able to learn of Yulete's true intentions and was able to meet with him.
3363.name: Studying Frankenroid 1

3364.1: Yulete seemed ecstatic to help Keeny out. Then he proceeded to bring out the well-organized blueprint of Frankenroid and told me to tell her if she had any questions, she's more than welcome to ask him herself. I better give this blueprint to #bKeeny#k.
3364.2: After receiving the blueprint of Frankenroid, Keeny seemed beyond words. She felt like this would really help her make Humanoid A's wish come true.
3364.name: Studying Frankenroid 2

3365.0: For a while, he was so jaded that he wanted to take on Magatia all by himself, but now that someone recognized and appreciated his greatness, Yulete seems to finally find some peace in himself... I better find #bYulete#k, who might be hiding somewhere in #bMagatia#k.
3365.1:
Yulete made a promise that from here on out, instead of conducting experiments to be accepted by others, he's going to do it for his own satisfaction. Conducting these studies and experiments by himself seem a little difficult, though. I better help Yulete out.  #k

#y3366# #b                (#u3366#)#k
#y3367#        #b(#u3367#)#k
#y3368#    #b(#u3368#)#k
3365.2: I was able to really help Yulete complete his experiments. He may not have been universally accepted by his peers, but he's indeed a genius alchemist. An alchemist like him is more than capable of raising the bar of alchemy in Magatia much higher.
3365.name: Yulete's Request

3366.0: To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.
3366.1: Yulete asked me to help him #bmake the Reagent#k. I'll need to pour the prepared liquid in the beaker and make the reagent, but I heard that the liquids have to be poured in sequencce. .. and the sequence is #bred, green, yellow, blue, and purple#k! Let's make this. \n\n#i4031798##t4031798# #b#c4031798##k/1
3366.2: After successfully making the reagent, I reported the results to Yulete. He thanked me for helping him with something that he considered was a difficult task.
3366.name: Making the Reagent

3367.0: To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.
3367.1: Yulete asked me to organize his Lab Report. At his #bLab 2#k, there are so many reports that he had written that have been spread out all over the place, that it needs to be organized in the worst way. I better start gathering up some #breports#k. \n\n#i4031797##t4031797# #b#c4031797##k/20
3367.2: I gathered up the reports and gave to Yulete. Organizing all these reports will keep Yulete busy for a while.
3367.name: Organizing the Lab Report

3368.0: To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.
3368.1: Yulete asked me to eliminate the monsters that stand in his way of conducting experiments. It seems like the monsters he created from the past have come back to haunt him. \n\n#o9300153# #r#a33681##k
3368.2: I was able to eliminate all the monsters that were of hindrance to Yulete in the lab. Yulete breathed a sigh of relief that he can now use that lab.
3368.name: Eliminating Obstacles

3369.0: Romeo had finally received the okay to date Juliet, but he had been hard at work researching. Has he been dating well? Let's check up on #bRomeo#k.
3369.1: Romeo was still worried about what to get her, so I advised him to get Juliet a flower. Like a true alchemist, Romeo thought of the Snowfield Rose and asked me to help him get one. Thankfully, he knew how to make the seeds, so all I need to do is get the #bMay Mist#k. \n\n#i4000361##t4000361# #b#c4000361##k/20
3369.2: I found the Snowfield Rose and gave it to Romeo. Romeo told me to wait as he wants to finalize the process himself, with all his heart.
3369.name: Romeo's Present

3370.1: Romeo was able to complete the making of Snowfield Rose, but he's terribly shy. So shy that he was too terrified to give the flower to #bJuliet#k himself, and asked me to deliver the flower to her for him. I didn't know he was like this...
3370.2: I gave Juliet Romeo's flower. Thankfully, she seemed very satisfied with the choice of the present. Good thing he didn't give her something like a Scorpion Needle.
3370.name: Romeo's Flowers

3371.0: Juliet received a Snowfield Rose with Romeo's true feelings laden in it. I better go see her and see how she feels about the present.
3371.1: Juliet was so happy about Romeo's Present that she wanted to give Romeo something in return. After taking some time wondering what would be the perfect present for him, she decided to... make him some clothes. She's an alchemist... how will she make clothes for him? Anyway, since Juliet asked for help, I'll need to see #bSirin#k of #bAriant#k.
3371.2: When I told Sirin of Juliet's story, she told me to wait for a second. She didn't seem to be sweating it one bit.
3371.name: Juliet's Feelings

3372.1: Sirin was more than happy to accommodate, by giving me the pattern to the nicest clothes she has in store. So all I need to do is give this to Juliet?...hmmm... something tells me this might not end up the way I had in plan. Anyway, I better give #bJuliet#k the patterns first.
3372.2: After giving Juliet the pattern, she jumped for joy. That's the good part. Can she really make the clothes based on the pattern, though?
3372.name: Sirin's Tailoring Methods

3373.1: Juliet was able to make the clothes. It was very well-made, actually. She must be good with her hands. There's one slight problem, though... I wonder if she'll really give it to Romeo, because it is DEFINITELY FOR WOMEN!! I knew something wasn't right. Despite the concerns, Juliet asked me to give this "dress" to #bRomeo#k.
3373.2: Romeo seemed very happy to receive the clothes that Juliet made for him. Seriously, is he going to wear that dress with the pink ribbon on? Alchemists are really strange.. that's for sure.
3373.name: Juliet's Response

3374.0: Romeo is an alchemist from Magatia. I don't know about his alchemy skills, but his dating skills leave a lot to be desired, and he seems to be really concerned about that as well. I'll need to talk to #bRomeo#k.
3374.1: Romeo wanted to write a love letter to Juliet that conveyed his true feelings towards her, but he seemed to be struggling with words. I'll have to come up with something very creative for Romeo...
3374.2: Struggling, but slowly making progress with the letter, Romeo sure is trying to impress Juliet. I wonder how the letter will end up.
3374.name: Writing Romeo's Letter

3375.1: After finally completing the letter, Romeo asked me if I could deliver the letter to #bJuliet#k for him. What am I, their loyal servant???
3375.2: After receiving Romeo's heartfelt letter, Juliet shed a tear of joy. I don't understand how that letter brought her to tears, but...
3375.name: Romeo's Love Letter

3376.0: Juliet seemed very much in love with Romeo after receiving the letter, which meant one thing. Juliet wants to repay the love with a present of her own. I better go see #bJuliet#k.
3376.1: Juliet decided the best way to respond to the letter was to cook for him by making a lunchbox. ...A lunchbox by an alchemist from Alcadno... I better help her make one before Juliet poisons Romeo to death with her toxic cooking skills. I better buy the #blunchbox recipe#k from #bHan the Broker#k. \n\n#i4031785##t4031785# #b#c4031785##k/1
3376.2: I handed Juliet Han the Broker's recipe for lunchbox.
3376.name: Juliet is Impressed

3377.0: I better stop Juliet before she accidentally poisons Romeo with her toxic cooking skills. I'll need to hurry up and see #bHan the Broker#k so I can buy a recipe for a nice food from him.
3377.1: Han the Broker was noticeably complaining, and told me if I wanted his #blunchbox recipe#k, then I'll have to fork over #b20,000 mesos#k. That's really pricey, but he's the only way I can acquire the recipe here in Magatia...
3377.2: I got the recipe from Han the Broker. This recipe also gives me this uneasy feeling. This time, it's not the contents, but the broker himself that worries me...
3377.name: Han the Broker's Recipe

3378.1: Juliet's Lunchbox is now complete. It doesn't look all that great, but... seriously, she made this for Romeo, a person she dearly loves, so come on, it can't be toxic, right? Whatever happens to him, I'm sure the great alchemists in Magatia can save him. I'm worried about the lunchbox, but I better still give this to #bRomeo#k.
3378.2: Romeo seemed very ecstatic to receive the lunchbox. Hopefully he won't die on me.
3378.name: Juliet's Lunchbox

3379.0: Romeo is an alchemist in Magatia that's currently dating Juliet like there's no tomorrow. He has finally decided to pop the question to Juliet. I better go visit #bRomeo#k.
3379.1: Romeo told me although he may not be perfect, he's sure that Juliet will understand and take him regardless, and that's how he came to conclusion to propose to her. He then asked me to find a perfect engagement ring for her. The ring can be purchased at #bWedding Village#k through #bAllegro#k.\n\n#i4031806##t4031806# #b#c4031806##k/1
3379.2: I got the engagement ring and gave it to Romeo. Now, all he has to do is come up to her and propose successfully. They may be an odd couple, but they do fit like a glove. Hopefully their love will come to fruition.
3379.name: Romeo Proposes

3380.0: Romeo had decided to propose to Juliet. To help fascilitate that, I better get him a nice ring. The ring can be acquired through Allegro, the master of rings at Wedding Village.
3380.1:
Allegro said the perfect ring for Romeo and Juliet might be the Silver Wing Ring that represents purity, and asked me to gather up the materials for him. 

#i4021007##t4021007# #b#c4021007##k/2 
#i4011004##t4011004# #b#c4011004##k/2
3380.2: I received the ring from Allegro. I better give this to #bRomeo#k now.
3380.name: Allegro, the Master of the Rings

3381.0: #b#m261000000##k's #b#p2111007##k seems to be concerned about something. What must that be? I better go ses #p2111007#.
3381.1: #p2111007# said recently, someone purchased an inordinate amount of jewels and machinery, so much so that he wanted to make sure who that person might be that made the massive order. These items seemed to have been shipped to #b#m100030000##k...
3381.2: At #m100030000#, I saw a tree entrance that had not been seen before. It looked like an entrance to a fort... So when I tried to speak to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of the entrance, he said a new fort for #bPirate #p1072008##k is currently being built.
3381.name: The Unidentified Group

3382.0: #b#p2112014##k, a genius alchemist who isn't universally accepted but deserved to be, may know what #t4001159# and #t4001160# are for. I better go talk to #p2112014#.
3382.1: After carefully examining #t4001159# and #t4001160#, #p2112014# stated that #bby combining the marbles that contain the essence of the two studies, he can actually form a whole new power that encompasses them all#k. I have a feeling that the materials required for this might be extensive... I better get #t4001159# and #t4001160# first.
3382.2: Only #p2112014# might be capable of combining the two distinctive styles of work like Zenumist and Alcadno and make something out of it.
3382.name: Yulete's Reward

3383.0: Keol and Ramain have been concerned lately because Moren seemed to be letting out a heavy sigh every other minute. They may not try to show it, but the two are struggling right now, so for the sake of these three, I better ask Moren what's up.
3383.1: Gordon's Secret Technique! This is something I didn't even see coming. A secret technique that even the creator of the Maker skill cannot pray away. Moren had high expectations that this technique would further advance the Maker skill. I decided to visit Gordon in El Nath without notifying Moren. Who knows, I might be the one learning that skill instead.
3383.2: After calmly answering Gordon's questions, I was able to have this rolling in no time. Gordon at first seemed taken aback that the very existence of the technique had been exposed, but seemed to have gotten over it quickly. He then made a proposition where if I pass his test, then he'll share his technique with me. I wonder what that test is...
3383.name: Moren's Upset

3384.1: Just as Gordon says, being a great craftsman requires patience and stamina. Gordon then gave me a test where he assigned me to gather up some Jr. Yeti Skin, which are also used as primary materials for shoemaking. I wonder what that secret technique is... I better come back ASAP.\n\n#i04000048# #t04000048# #b#c04000048##k / 50
3384.2: I finally found the secrets to Gordon's technique! Well, the important aspects here are the two types of Magic Pentagrams that's used to create a new scroll, and the Magic Magic Iron that helped press them. The Magic Magic Iron that Gordon gave me... it seemed like it had some sort of a story behind it, but I was not able to listen to it in detail. I should ask him about that the next time I see him.\nAccording to Gordon, when summoning the Maker skill, when I have the Magic Magic Iron equipped in my hand, then I'll be able to create new scrolls.
3384.name: Gordon's Magic Iron

3385.0: Oh my gosh... I wound up losing #b#t1122013##k! I swear I kept it with me, but while I looked away, I wound up... misplacing it. Sigh, there's nothing I can do, I better just visit #b#p2020002##k and tell him what happened. Do I really have to go to #b#m211000100##k and face the music?
3385.1: He knew I had misplaced it? He picked it up from the streets? I was shocked to hear what #b#p2020002##k told me. Honestly, losing it really made me feel guilty about it, but at least it's back in my hands now! Phew... I'll need to start another conversation with him.
3385.2: I really didn't see it coming. I was totally unaware that he had left #b#m211000100##k and was watching me from the back... thankfully, #p2020002# had the item with him, and he just gave me back the item without much of a lecture. I felt so bad and embarassed that I vowed never to misplace the item ever again.
3385.name: Gordon's Warm Heart

3400.0: Chief Stan wants to ask me for something... I wonder what it is...
3400.1: I met with #bChief Stan#k, who was at Henesys in Victoria Island. He handed me what appeared to be an old, sealed letter, and wanted me to deliver it to Dr. Kim of Omega Sector. He said to get to Omega Sector, I'll need to first get on board on a ship ride from Ellinia to Orbis, followed by the ride to Ludibrium from there.
3400.2: I met Dr. Kim at Omega Sector, and handed him the #bsealed letter#k that Chief Stan gave me. This place seems to be full of facilities designed in anticipation of the alien invasion... I should talk to Dr. Kim whenever I have a chance...
3400.name: Chief Stan's Letter

3401.0: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector has apparently come up with something incredible...
3401.1: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector gave me the Blueprint Machine for the new robot that's currently in development, and he requested that I show this to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny. I should meet up with #bChury#k first; he's at the #bOmega Sector Silo#k.
3401.2: Dr. Kim gave me a mission to show Chury the blueprint of the new robot that he's currently making, and I did just that. Chury seemed impressed by it.
3401.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : Blueprint for New Robot

3402.1: I met Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k, which contains the blueprint of the new robot, that I got from Dr. Kim. Chury wanted to show this to Hoony, so he asked me if I could show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as provide him with #b20 Space Foods#k, for he had been away at the Field for a while. Space Food, huh... I think I can find them through Barnard Gray the alien. I'll run into on the way to the Field. \n\n#t4000117# #b#c4000117##k/20
3402.2: I met up with Chury somewhere around the Omega Sector Silo. Chury wanted me to show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as give him some food. In turn, I gave Hoony some Space Food to last him a while, and showed him the Blueprint Machine.
3402.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Chury

3403.1: I met Hoony at a Field around Omega Sector, and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k, as well as provide him with #b20 Space Foods#k. Hoony said that he fixed #bGunny's Laser Gun#k that he was asked to fix and requested me if I could give him his #bLaser Gun#k as well as show him the Blueprint Machine. He should be somewhere around the Field. Where could he be...
3403.2: Hoony wanted to show the Blueprint to Gunny. He was already on his way to give Gunny a new weapon, so he asked me if I could give him the new gun, as well as show him the Blueprint. After much searching around, I was able to finally find him and gave him the gun.
3403.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Hoony

3404.1: I met up with Gunny at a field around Omega Sector, handed him his #bLaser gun#k, and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k. Gunny appreciated my effort and requested that I report this all to Dr. Kim. This Command Center warp capsule seems like a useful item.
3404.2: As Dr. Kim requested from the Command Center in the Omega Sector, I showed the blueprint of the new robot to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny, while simultaneously solving their problems. Dr. Kim was very pleased with the results, and wanted me to drop by again sometime, for he could use my help.
3404.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Gunny

3405.0: I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
3405.1: From the Command Center in the Omega Sector, Dr. Kim requested that I receive 3 important mechanical parts from Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory of Ludibrium. Man ... when am I going to find time to go all the way up to Ludibrium?
3405.2: Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector gave me a mission to receive some stuff from Cheng the Assistant of the Toy Factory. The parts I received seem to be very important for something.
3405.name: An Important Robotic Part

3406.1: I met with Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, and he handed me 3 boxes full of robotic parts, which will be used to make the robot. Now I should just hand them over to Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
3406.2: At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, Cheng the Assistant gave me 3 boxes of robotic parts so I could deliver them to Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector. After delivering the goods to Dr. Kim, he gave me a Warp Capsule, which will enable me to transport to Ludibrium in an instant. Hmmm... this looks like something I can use!
3406.name: Delivering the Robotic Parts

3407.0: I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
3407.1:
I met with Dr. Kim again at the Command Center. Dr. Kim was furious over the fact that someone stole 3 boxes full of robotic parts. He requested that I check into the hidden place at the Boswell Field, break all the Alien boxes, and recover the 3 missing boxes.

#t4031141# #b#c4031141##k/1

3408.2: I managed to eliminate all 5 MT-09's that Dr. Kim of the Command Center requested. I really hope that the new robot is made soon, so I don't have to ever do this again.

3409.2: I gave Chury, who was waiting for me at the Silo of the Omega Sector, the #bDogon's Report#k that I found from Dogon's secret base. I can't believe someone is actually helping aliens... now THAT's quite shocking.

Now, he needed Pain Reliever to relieve the excruciating pain on his teeth. My job now is to get the #bPain Releiver#k from the Omega Sector, and give it to Hoony.
3410.2: I purchased the #bPain Reliever#k from Dr. Pepper at the Omega Sector Silo, and gave it to Hoony, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Seriously, enough with the sweets!

I'll need to defeat Chief Gray's for  Gunny and collect 5 signs that they wear with them, so I can give them to Gunny.\n\n#t4000125# #b#c4000125##k/5

3412.2: I successfully completed the mission from Black Mesoranger by defeating the #bBarnard Grays#k. It seems, however, that there will be much more dangerous aliens monsters around Kulan Field

Chief Grays are very rare among all Grays and they are few and far between. How am I going to find them? \n\n#t4031102# #b#c4031102##k/3
3413.2: I took 3 #bnotes#k from the Chief Grays and gave them to Black Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Apparently, these notes contain the history of the Grays... hopefully these notes can be deciphered soon!
3413.name: Eliminating Chief Gray

3414.1:
I met Black Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. She said the notes have been deciphered, and they revealed that the original planet in which the Grays lived in has been affected with lethal contaminants. Ever since then, they've been looking for a new place to live in, and the Earth turned out to be an ideal place for them. She said that she needed to see which lethal containments aliens couldn't stand that currently infest their original planet, and requested that I extract the #bskin cells of Barnard Gray, Zeta Gray, Ultra Gray, and Chief Gray#k.

3415.0: I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who's somewhere around the Boswell Field...
3415.1: I met up with #bPink Mesoranger#k at the Boswell Field near Omega Sector, and she looked very concerned over her never-ending habit of oversleeping. 3415.2: I gathered up #bTable Clocks#k for Pink Mesoranger, who was stationed somewhere around Omega Sector, so she can overcome her chronic oversleeping. But then again, she always had trouble waking up, so I may have to find something more powerful for her...

3416.0: I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who should be around Boswell Field.
3416.1:

She said she needed a special alarm clock, and to make it will require #b2 Special Batteries, 10 Cogs, and 10 Table Clocks#k. #t4000115# #b#c4000115##k/10

3417.0: I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who's somewhere around Boswell Field.
3417.1: I ran into Pink Mesoranger again at Boswell Field, near the Omega Sector. She said that the items I gathered up for her last time has been sent to #bKevin the Soldier#k of Omega Sector, and that he should be ready with the #bSuper Alarm Clock#k. My task is to get it from him for her. I hope she'll be able to wake up on time with this baby.
3417.2: I received a request from Pink Mesoranger to receive the Alarm Clock from Kevin the Soldier for her. The clock looks very well-made.
3417.name: A Sleeping Monster

3418.1: I received the #bSuper Alarm Clock#k from #bKevin the Soldier#k, who was at the Omega Sector, for Pink Mesoranger. Now all I have to do is deliver this to her.
3418.2: #bKevin the Soldier#k made the #bsuper alarm clock#k for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, and I delivered it to her. Hopefully this will enable her to wake up on time.
3418.name: The Completion of the Alarm Clock

3419.1: I ran into #bAlien Gray#k at Kulan Field around Omega Sector. He claimed that it's the Omega Sector, not them, that's been the bad one, and it asked me to help it invade the Sector by getting a number of materials from the Omega Sector Silo. I really don't feel good about helping it, but... oh well... I'll need to enter the Omega Sector Silo and bring out #b3 Secret Documents#k. \n\n#t4031116# #b#c4031116##k/3
3419.2: I got the 3 secret documents out of the Silo and handed them to #bAlien Gray#k, which was at Kulan Field of Omega Sector. 3419.name: Trading with Alien Gray

3420.1: I met with Yellow Mesoranger at a field around Omega Sector. In order to regain their trust, I'll have to eliminate the aliens. \n\n#o4230118# #r#a34201#
3420.2: I may have helped out Alien Gray in a moment of chaos, but after successfully completing the mission Yellow Mesoranger gave me, I think I regained some of her trust. It just seems like the aliens do not want to peacefully coexist with us.

3421.2: I gathered up the meteorite samples from the Kulan Field and gave them to Yellow Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Hopefully this will jumpstart the studies.

Then, I'll have to pay a visit to #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and have him decipher the memory cards, and then hand her the #b3 Deciphered Memory Cards#k to her.

3424.1: I need 3 of Rombot's Memory Cards so #bPorter#k of Omega Sector can decipher them.

3424.name: Porter the Undependable

3425.1: I met #bPorter#k at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and gave him Rombot's 3 memory cards, but oh my... he was unable to decipher one of the three, and destroyed it. I'll need to find another one of Rombot's Memory Card for Porter.
3425.2: I watched over Porter's deciphering with an uneasy feeling, but thankfully he didn't make any mistake this time around.

3426.2: I gave Kay, who's at the Silo of Omega Sector, the #bDeciphered Memory Cards#k that she requested. I'm anxious to see what she makes out of them.
3426.name: The Brilliant Assistant

3427.0: I should go see Porter of the Omega Sector.
3427.1: #bPorter#k, who's at the Command Center in the Omega Sector, requested that I deliver a letter to #bKay the Engineer#k at the Omega Sector Silo. 3427.2: I gave Kay the Engineer, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, the letter from Porter. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like a love letter. It's about a disappeared Dropship

3428.1: I was able to hand #bPorter#k's letter from the Command Center in the Omega Sector to #bKay the Engineer#k, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, on time. I was expecting it to be a love letter, to no avail. Instead, it was about the missing dropship, and its current location. That's boring... anyway, Kay requested that I find the Dropship, which should be somewhere around Boswell Field, and check out the pilot's livelihood.
3428.2: I found an empty dropship at the Boswell Field, and it appeared to have mislanded here. The pilot is nowhere to be found; a letter was found instead.
3428.name: Where is the Dropship?

3429.1: I found what appeared to be a broken Dropship around Boswell Field, but the pilot is nowhere to be found, and instead, I was able to find a letter inside. I better give that letter to Kay.
3429.2: I found a letter inside the broken Dropship, and gave it to #bKay the Engineer#k at the Omega Sector Silo. With a sad look on her eyes, Kay said she was glad to find out the pilot was at least alive. Now, where would that pilot be...?

He wanted all the crystals gone before it gets too late.

#t4031140# #b#c4031140##k/30
#t4004004# #b#c4004004##k/10

I made a deal with him to gather up #b20 #t4000166#s#k for him and deliver them to his wife #bGrandma Yeon#k at the Korean Folk Town.\n\n#t4000166# #b#c4000166##k/20

3601.2: I received a sack of rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

3602.2: I received a #t4031229# from Chil Nam, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Sung's house.
3602.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 2

The brothers seemed genuinely thankful for helping them strengthening the love and bond between the brothers even more. The seed was eventually found, and I gave them back to Swallow.

Chumji, who resides in Korean Folk Town, requested that I take out the Goblins who have been appearing at the mountain. The Goblins that have appeared at the Black Mountain are the goblins that have run away from the storybook on the Goblin Story, and they have been hiding out at an abandoned home. In order to draw them out of the seclusion, he told me I needed three different types of baits: #b#t2022050#, #t2022051#, #t2022052##k. In the end, I was able to do so with help from Kong Ji, Hongbu, and Chil Nam.

3619.0: I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
3619.1: Kong Ji, who lives at a tavern in Folk Town with her stepmom, is a nice girl who does everything her stepmom asks her to do, however ludicrous the task may be. This time, the stepmom ordered her to fill up a pot with water, but the pot had a hole at the bottom, which made it impossible to fill up the pot. She asked me if I could get her a new #t4031230#. I heard that Grandma Yeon, who lives at the place where the water mill is, sells pots, and if I keep her up to date on his husband's whereabouts, then she may give me the pot. \n\n#t4031230# #b#c4031230##k/1
3619.2: I gave Kong Ji, who was panicking because her pot had a hole at the bottom, the #t4031230# that Grandma Yeon made at the water mill. Apparently, Grandma Yeon only sells these pots to the closest few. I should go check on Kong Ji again down the road.
3619.name: Pot with a Hole

3620.0: I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
3620.1: I went to see Kong Ji again. Kong Ji seemed swamped with work at home. Her stepmom wants some Artemesia Rice Cake, which means she had to extract #t4031231#, but she is stuck at home trying to finish the laundry before the day is over. Obviously, she has no time to extract Artemesia, and that is why she's asking for my help. I've decided to extract some #t4031231# for poor Kong Ji. \n\n#t4031231# #b#c4031231##k/12
3620.2: I went through the town and mountains and extracted some Artemesia for Kong Ji, who was stuck at home doing house chores. Kong Ji seemed to be stuck at home working way too hard. I better go see her again down the road.
3620.name: Extracting Artemesia

3621.0: I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
3621.1: I went to visit Kong Ji again. She was sitting down, looking dejected. Her stepmom ordered her to plow the field by lunch, but her wooden hoe, which had been used for years and years, finally coudln't handle the pressure and snapped. Kong Ji felt that only a durable steel hoe can help her plow the field, so I have decided to get #t4031222# for her. I heard that I can obtain the #t4031222# by eliminating the Blins, who reside at the Black Mountain... \n\n#t4031222# #b#c4031222##k/1
3621.2: I found a way to acquire #t4031222# through Blins at the Black Mountain, and gave them to Kong Ji, who still seemed devastated by the 'snapping' of the wooden hoe. Needless to say, she was ecstatic when given the steel hoe. She was thankful for my work, and went out to start weeding the garden.. Kong Ji's been through a lot; hopefully something good happens to her down the road.
3621.name: The Wooden Hoe That Snapped

#t4000171# #b#c4000171##k/8
#o5100005# #r#a36221#
3622.2: Through Chumji's request, I went up to the Black Mountain and defeated 10 Hoguls, the same Hoguls that have put many residents of the Folk Town in fear. Also, as evidence, I collected 10 Tiger Skins, and gave them to Chumji. He commended my courage and for the job well done.
3622.name: Tiger-Hunting

3623.2: I was able to purchase Grandma Yeon's pot for 5,000 mesos.

3724.2: You have passed the second test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to Midnight Harbor in the year 2099. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
3724.name: Nex the Time Guard
3724.rewardSummary: EXP 90,000\r\nCan participate in "The Hidden Truth about the Past" quest.\r\n

3725.1: Andy the Time Traveler has requested that you travel to Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 to investigate and if possible, destroy the giant robot, if it exists.
3725.2: You traveled to Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 as Andy the Time Traveler has requested, during which time you spotted a giant robot and destroyed it as instructed.
3725.name: The Hidden Truth about the Past
3725.rewardSummary: EXP 120,000\r\nCan participate in the "Nex the Time Guard" quest.\r\n

3726.1: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 wants you to help him eliminate some monsters that have been taking over the harbor. Specifically, 50 Overlord A and 40 Overlord B monsters.
3726.2: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 asked you to help him eliminate some monsters, so you eliminated Overlord A and Overlord B monsters.
3726.name: Policeman in Danger
3726.rewardSummary: EXP 72,000\r\nCan participate in the "Shelter Key" quest.\r\n

3727.1: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 wants you to find the Shelter Key and deliver it to Captain Edmond, who is somewhere at the harbor.
3727.2: The Policeman you met at Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 asked you to find the Shelter Key and deliver it to Captain Edmond. You retrieved the key from the monsters and gave it to Captain Edmond at the quayside.
3727.name: The Shelter Key
3727.rewardSummary: EXP 60,000\r\nCan participate in the "Temporary Measure" quest.\r\n

3728.1: When you meet Captain Edmond in 2099, he asks you bring him 20 Overlord A Radar Devices and 40 Overlord B Radar Devices to temporarily stop the monsters at the harbor.
3728.2: When you met Captain Edmond in 2099, he complained that he didn't approve of the monsters that overtook the harbor. He then asked that you bring him their radar devices, which you did.
3728.name: Temporary Relief

3730.0: Andy the Time Traveler says he has something to tell you before your third time travel.
3730.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Nex the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your third time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
3730.2: You have passed the third test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the Bombed City Center in the year 2099. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
3730.name: Nex the Time Guard
3730.rewardSummary: EXP 110,000\r\nCan participate in the "Identity of the Missile" quest.\r\n

3731.1: Andy the Time Traveler has asked you to travel to the year 2215 to investigate the Bombed City Center and destroy the A.I. missile known as Dunas.
3731.2: Andy the Time Traveler asked you to travel to the year 2215 to investigate the Bombed City Center and destroy the A.I. missile known as Dunas. To your surprised, you discovered that Dunas was an android missile that closely resembled a human. You may have succeeded in destroying Dunas, but the Bombed City Center doesn't appear to be restorable.
3731.name: Identity of the Missile
3731.rewardSummary: EXP 140,000\r\nCan participate in the '"Nex the Time Guard" quest.\r\n

3732.1: You meet May in the middle of the Bombed City Center in the year 2215. What's she doing in the destroyed City Center? In any case, she asks you to defeat the Robbies that appeared after the bombing. She says they're so loud and rambunctious that she's about to have a nervous breakdown.
3732.2: You met May in the middle of the Bombed City Center in the year 2215. She asked you to defeat the Robbies that appeared after the bombing. She said they were so loud and rambunctious that she was about to have a nervous breakdown. Well, that worked out since you were thinking about getting rid of those noisy robots anyway.
3732.name: Rambunctious Robots
3732.rewardSummary: EXP 90,000\r\nCan participate in the "Survivor Search" quest.\r\n

3733.1: May was happy that you were able to reduce the population of the noisy Robbies, but was also concerned that she may be the only survivor left. She asks you to investigate the area where the missile landed and search for survivors.
3733.2: You have searched the area all the way to the location where the missile landed, as May requested. Fortunately, you were able to find a male survivor named Bao. How is it that he doesn't even have a tiny scratch on him?
3733.name: Survivor Search
3733.rewardSummary: EXP 30,000\r\nCan participate in "The Dangerous Android" quest.\r\n

3734.1: May was right. When you went into the City Center, you found another survivor, Bao. Bao could not move an inch because he was so afraid of Iruvatas and asked that you help him. He appears to be a big guy, but really, he's just a softie inside.
3734.2: You defeated Iruvatas that were scaring Bao. Bao thanked you for your help. What a softie.
3734.name: The Dangerous Android
3734.rewardSummary: EXP 90,000\r\nCan participate in the "The Wreckage of the Missile" quest.\r\n

3735.1: Bao says that the Iruvatas and Robbies seem to come from the place the missile landed and suggests you search around there. How did he know you were looking for something? He seemed a little dull and slow, but perhaps he actually has a perceptive side. Anyway, investigate and report your findings to Andy.
3735.2: Bao said that the Iruvatas and Robbies seemed to come from the area the missile landed and suggested you search there. You then defeated Dunas the missile android in the bombed City Center and delivered the Time Sand you acquired to Andy.
3735.name: The Wreckage of the Missile

3736.0: Andy the Time Traveler says he has something to tell you before your fourth time travel.
3736.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Next the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your fourth time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
3736.2: You have passed the fourth test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the ruins of the city in year 2216. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
3736.name: Nex the Time Guard
3736.rewardSummary: EXP 130,000\r\nCan participate in the "Central Robot Aufheben" quest.\r\n

3737.1: Andy has requested that you travel to the ruins of the city in the year 2216 and defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controls all electronic devices in the city. Andy says if Dunas was an android, it is very likely that Aufheben is also an android.
3737.2: Andy requested that you travel to the ruins of the city in the year 2216 and defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controlled all electronic devices in the city. As suspected, Aufheben was an android. The battle between humans and robots seems interminable.
3737.name: Central Robot Aufheben
3737.rewardSummary: EXP 170,000\r\nCan participate in the "Nex the Time Guard" quest.\r\n

3738.1: You have traveled to the year 2216 on your fourth time travel. Thanks to Ken, who assumes you are from the support unit, you must eliminate monsters. Things keep coming up and hindering you from doing what you're here to do. Keep in mind that you are here for a reason.
3738.2: You traveled to the year 2216 on your fourth time travel. Thanks to Ken, who just assumed that you were from the support unit, you had to eliminate monsters. Conditions in the city appear to be deteriorating.
3738.name: Disturbing the Army of Robots

3739.1: Ken, who you met in the ruins of the city in the year 2216, requests that you investigate the eastern regions where he received a rescue signal. You must hurry and find the person who he suspects to be a teenage female. Begin your search right away.
3739.2: Ken, whom you met in the ruins of the city in year 2216, requested that you investigate the eastern regions where he received a rescue signal. You found a teenage female who appeared to be passed out from exhaustion. Fortunately, she was conscious when you talked to her.
3739.name: Isabella's Search
3739.rewardSummary: EXP 50,000\r\nCan participate in the "What Was That I Saw?" quest.\r\n

3740.1: When she regained consciousness, Isabella kept rambling nonsense about how she saw an angel to the east, where the high rise collapsed. An angel? Is she insane? The only way to confirm that is to go over and see for yourself. You may even find a Time Sand.
3740.2: When she regained consciousness, Isabella kept rambling nonsense about how she saw an angel. The only way to confirm that was to go over and see for yourself. You did, and even found a Time Sand.
3740.name: What Was That I Saw?

3742.0: Andy the Time Traveler says he has something to tell you before your fifth time travel.
3742.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Nex the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your fifth time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
3742.2: You have passed the fifth test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the dangerous towers of the year 2230. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
3742.name: Nex the Time Guard
3742.rewardSummary: EXP 140,000\r\nCan participate in "The New and Improved, Oberon" quest.\r\n

3743.1: Andy says, based on the findings from the previous time travels, it is likely that the Fifth Time Sand is in the year 2230. He wants you to defeat Oberon, an android even more advanced than Aufheben, and bring back the Time Sand.
3743.2: As Andy suspected, Oberon had the Fifth Time Sand. You have successfully defeated Oberon and found the Fifth Time Sand in the dangerous tower in the year 2230.
3743.name: The New and Improved, Oberon
3743.rewardSummary: EXP 200,000\r\nCan participate in the "Nex the Time Guard" quest.\r\n

3744.1: Hoya, the boy you met at the lobby of the dangerous tower in the year 2230, has asked you to eliminate the pesky Mavericks and report it to Nalo.
3744.2: Hoya, the boy you met at the lobby of the dangerous tower in the year 2230, asked you to eliminate some pesky Mavericks. You did so and reported it to Nalo at the top of the tower. Nalo seemed concerned about Hoya's immature and irresponsible actions.
3744.name: Defeat the Mavericks

3748.0: Andy the Time Traveler says he has something to tell you before your sixth time travel.
3748.1: Andy the Time Traveler has informed you that you must pass the test Nex the Gatekeeper of Time, who lives in the Old Tree of Tera, gives you before embarking on your sixth time travel. Enter the Old Tree of Tera and pass Nex's test.
3748.2: You have passed the sixth test given by Nex the Gatekeeper of Time and earned the right to travel to another time. You can now teleport to the Air Battleship of the year 2503. Go to the Time Gate with the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch.
3748.name: Nex the Time Guard
3748.rewardSummary: EXP 150,000\r\nCan participate in the "Nibelung's Song" quest.\r\n

3749.1: In the end, Andy says the answer is in the year 2503, where he's from. He wants you to travel to the year 2503 to destroy Nibelung and report it to Ashura. Will this solve the problem?
3749.2: You destroyed Nibelung and reported that to Ashura. She showed her gratitude and wished for peaceful days in the future.
3749.name: Nibelung's Song

3800.0: At #b#m250000000##k, there is an instrcutor that trains the Masters, an instructor by the name of #b#p2091000##k. Maybe I can become a Master myself if I train with him.

3800.2: Even though I was successful in taking on all the #o5120503#s, #p2091000# didn't compliment my work one bit. What is he? Is he really going to help me become the Master?
3800.name: No Gong's Teaching 1

3801.0: Despite defeating 10 #o5120503# just as #b#p2091000##k ordered, he had that look of "that's really nothing". What? Okay, that's really not cool. I better go see #p2091000# again.
3801.1: Without any explanation, #p2091000# ordered to me to take on #r20 #o5120503#s#k.  \n\n#o5120503# #r#a38011##k
3801.2: Even though I was successful in taking on all the #o5120503#s, #p2091000# compliment my work one bit. He's really getting on my nerves now...
3801.name: No Gong's Teaching2

3802.0: Despite defeating 20 #o5120503# like #b#p2091000##k asked, #p2091000# still seemed uninterested in making me the Master. Seriously, is he really an instructor? This is really getting on me, and I got to see him now, just to see what he'll ask me to do.
3802.1: I asked him about being the Master, but #p2091000# gave me this uninterested look and told me to defeat #r40 #o5120503#s#k. First, 10... then 20... now 40? What am I, a training dog? Despite my anger ready to spill over, I realized I couldn't stop now. Fine, I'll do what #p2091000# says.\n\n#o5120503#  #r#a38021##k
3802.2: Despite defeating 40 #o5120503#s, #p2091000# still gave me that uninterested look and just nodded nonchalantly. I mean, he should be giving me some kind of a compliment for doing all that, but instead, #p2091000# iterated that I am still nowhere close to being a Master. Is he really gonna make me the Master?
3802.name: No Gong's Teaching3

3803.0: Apparently at #b#m250000000##k, there's someone by the name of #b#p2091001##k who is the meditation instructor on the Masters, and he knows a way to become the Legendary Being.
3803.1: #p2091001# stated that there's a scroll out there that should help one to become the Master. Unfortunately, the scroll that contains all the skills have been lost by #p2091001# once at #m250010501# around the Peach Farm, only to find it back later. Alas, the scroll is old and ragged, with ripped pages here and there. So, does that mean if I find the ripped #b#t4000299##k, then I can become a Master myself?\n\n#t4000299# #i4000299#  #b#c4000299##k/10
3803.2: I managed to find #t4000299#, and brought it back to #p2091001#. Unfortunately, #p2091001# had the look of great concern as he rummaged through #o5120506#...
3803.name: The Lost Document

3804.0: The document that contains all the mysterious skills necessary to become the Master. I found all the loose pages, but #b#p2091001##k looked concerned as he ran through #t4000299#. What's the problem now? When will he make me a Master? I better talk to #p2091001#.
3804.1:
After looking through #t4000299#, #p2091001# stated that there were cat footprints everywhere, and concluded that some street cats may have read the document and secretly obtained those skills. #p2091001# stressed that there should not be cats like those roaming around the forest, for they'll present danger to all of us. He asked that I eliminate #r20 #o6130209#s#k for him, and bring back #b5 #t4031433#s#k...

#t4031433# #b#c4031433##k/5  
#o6130209#  #r#a38041##k
3804.2: After eliminating #o6130209#s and bringing back #t4031433#s, #p2091001# commended me for the job well done, but refused to hand me #o5120506#. He mentioned that the document will allow me to obtain those skills, but learning the skills that way would make me no different than those street-cats-turned-monsters, and recommended that I train slowly but surely. That, and only that, he said, would allow me to become the true Master. Sigh... that all went for a naught, but he did say the right thing. When will I become the true Master?
3804.name: Eliminating the Spirited Cats

3805.0: #b#p2091002##k, who owns a Peach Farm at #b#m250000000##k, seems to be concerned about something.
3805.1: #p2091002# seemed wary of fighting off the #o6130207#s that have stolen his peaches, and wanted me to eliminate #r50 #o6130207#s#k for him.\n\n#o6130207#  #r#a38051##k
3805.2: I managed to eliminate the #o6130207#s that were stealing peaches. Hopefully the Peach Farm will be alright now...
3805.name: Eliminating the Spirited Monkeys

3806.0: #b#p2091002##k, the owner of the Peach Farm and the resident pharmacist at #b#m250000000##k. He seemed concerned about something...
3806.1: #p2091002# seemed relieved that the #o6130207#s have been eliminated, but was very much concerned over the fact that they have already eaten most of the peaches at the farm. He was worried that the crop will be very low. He asked me to collect #b100 more #t4000282#s#k. \n\n#i4000282##t4000282#  #b#c4000282##k/100
3806.2: I gathered up #t4000282#s for him. NOW #p2091002# seemed to breathe the sigh of relief.

3807.0: #b#p2092000##k, the owner of the herb farm at #b#m251000000##k, seemed to be in trouble...

He wanted me to eliminate #r80 #o5120501#s#k so his Ginsengs can grow in his farm.\n\n#o5120501#  #r#a38071##k
3807.2: I managed to eliminate the #o5120501#s that have made life miserable for the Ginsengs at the herb farm in #p2092000#.

3808.0: Apparently, there was a thief at #p2092000#'s herb farm at #m251000000#...

#p2092000# claimed that someone had entered his herb farm and stole some of his herbs. #p2092000# seemed confident that it was the work of the red-nosed pirates, and asked me to defeat #r#o7130104##k and #r#o6130208##k.

#o7130104#  #r#a38080##k 
#o6130208#  #r#a38081##k
3808.2: I was able to defeat #o6130208# and #o7130104#. Now that I have apprehended the suspects, #p2092000# should enjoy a nice, long sleep tonight.
3808.name: Intruder - The Herb Farm 2

3809.2: As requested by #p2071010#, I returned #t4031430# to #p2091001#.

3811.name: The Legendary Being's Scroll 3

3812.0: I heard #b#p2094000##k the bellflower is planning something. What would that be?
3812.1:
#p2094000# had a plan to release the Bellflower that were being treated as slaves to the pirates. Unfortunately, he couldn't do it by himself, and asked me if I could go up to the pirate ship and defeat #r200 #o9300117#s#k and #r200 #o9300118#s#k. There are many different types of pirates under Lord Pirate, and the ones in command act differently from others. Apparently, they only make a quick appearance, then disappear. I better remember how they look, and eliminate the right ones. 

#o9300117#  #r#a38121##k
#o9300118#  #r#a38122##k
3812.2: I was able to defeat the #o9300117#s and #o9300118#s at the pirate ship. Unfortunately, there are still plenty of pirates, and Lord Pirate is still alive and well. Wiill this be enough to save those Bellflowers?

3813.0: #b#p2094000##k the bellflower is apparently searching for someone brave enough to rescue his King.
3813.1:
#p2094000# used to be the chamberlain of the King of Bellflowers. According to him, the Bellflowers never attacked humans and lived peacefully. That was, before Lord Pirate kidnapped #bThe King of Bellflowers, #p2094001##k. The Bellflowers, worried that #p2094001# might be in danger, reluctantly followed the Lord Pirate's orders and started attacking humans.instead. How cowardly of the Lord Pirate to disturb the peace of the Bellflowers by kidnapping their King!! That's despicable! I better defeat #r#o9300119##k and save the King of Bellflowers, #p2094001#! 

#o9300119#  #r#a38131##k
#o9300105#  #r#a38132##k
#o9300106#  #r#a38133##k
3813.2: I was able to defeat #o9300105# and save #p2094001#, the King of Bellflowers. Hopefully, with the king now saved, the Bellflowers will resume their peaceful lives.

3814.0: #b#p9000009##k of #b#m104000000##k apparently has been waiting for the right time to do something big..

4912.0: There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?
4912.1: I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
4912.2: +Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?
4912.name: Urban Jungle

4913.0: I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold? I should find out!
4913.1: I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat #b50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks#k so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...
4913.2: I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
4913.name: Subani's Legacy - Discovery

4914.0: John Barricade is awaiting me at the Temple Hive! He's found something!
4914.1: I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as #bHyper Glyphs#k. I've agreed to snag #b50#k of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
4914.2: I got the #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!
4914.name: Subani's Legacy - Transgression

4915.0: John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now!
4915.1: John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I'll have to track down #b50 MesoGears Map Pieces#k so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he "borrowed" for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying "#bI.AM.ROBOT#k" as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle...
4915.2: Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...
4915.name: Subani's Legacy - Deliverance

4916.0: There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...
4916.1: I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting #b30 Elpam Magnets#k. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the Barnard Grays. I'll have to head to Omega Sector and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
4916.2: I got the #b30 Elpam Magnets#k and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me an Elpam Elixir, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...
4916.name: Lost!

4917.0: Elpam has adjusted his compass, but he still needs my help. I should travel back and see what he needs!
4917.1: I went back to Elpam for more information, and he's explained that while he was able to adjust the compass, he needs to head back to the moment of his travel glitch to get back to his home safely. I have to hunt down #b60 Temporal Fragments#k and hand them over. That's a full minute and the perfect amount of time for him to travel back. The Tick-Tock monsters should have them, since they tend to keep time. HA!
4917.2: I got all #b60 Temporal Fragments#k and returned them to Elpam. In return, he's given me a very nice prize he found floating in the rift...!
4917.name: ReVersal

4918.0: Icebyrd looks like he needs my help. I'd better get over to New Leaf City and see him!
4918.1: I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the Gryphons have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. If that wasn't enough, those pesky Boomers are also attacking the machines. I've agreed to help by taking out #b100 Gryphons#k (located in the Highlands) and #bBoomers#k for #b150 #t4000391##k (located in the Badlands) to show them that this city is off-limits!
4918.2: Man, what a day. I de-clawed the Gryphons and defused the Boomers. Now the city can continue building in peace. Icebyrd said that they may act up again, so I should come back to see if they've been rowdy...
4918.name: Featherweights

4919.1: I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons#k in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
4919.2: I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

4924.1: I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments.  Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer.\r\nThe Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called #b#t4031760##k, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with.  To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down #b7 #t4021008#s#k and return these to him as well.  Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form.  A weapon made from an otherwordly material! I wonder what it does...
4924.2: I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the #b#t4031760##k and the #b7 #t4021008#s#k I gave him to form a Materia Orb.
