Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!
4925.name: Brand Materia Continued

4926.1: Professor Foxwit spoke with me about the space-based Artifacts suddenly being discovered. He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...
4926.2: Professor Foxwit spoke with me about the space-based Artifacts suddenly being discovered. He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...
4926.name: Interstellar Relics

4927.0: John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game).  He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items.  If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.
4927.1: John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game).  He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items.  If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.
4927.2: John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game).  He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items.  If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.
4927.name: Ancient Artifacts

4928.0: It's weird... When I walked passed #bJay from Henesys#k the other day, he didn't answer my greetings and didn't even notice me there. It looked like he was working on some kind of riddle by himself. Let's find out what Jay is up to these days.
4928.1: I don't believe I actually offered to help him on finding a historical figure just out of curiosity! I guess it won't hurt to check out the dungeon as #p1012109# requested... But I really doubt I would find anything there. It's a legend, myth, a fairy tale.
4928.2: I found Bob from #m105090300# and talked with bunch of people about him. He is famous around this world.
4928.name: Jay's Curiosity

4929.0: When I passed by, #b#p1061013##k, someone I really never got to spoke with, looked like he had something to talk to me. Let's go and find out what he has to say to me.
4929.1: #p1061013# was looking at #t4031447# very closely to see if I did anything to hurt him. I don't know what the deal is but he was scaring me.  It makes me wonder why he is obsessed with this particular snail. I should find out by talking to #b#p1061013##k again.
4929.2: #p1061013# told me what happened between him and Bob. It's amazing that a simple snail actually tried to save human being... Those little monsters we hunt aren't really little at all...
4929.name: Gwin's Thanks

4930.0: The Rememberer sure would know who Bob is. He's the Rememberer! I should talk with The Rememberer to find out what he knows.
4930.1: The Rememberer isn't relly being helpful today. Very slow talking, not really informative. I wonder why he is so... depres
4930.2: He is MEAN! MEAN, MEAN, MEAN! He took away Bob's Snail Shell from me wtihout me letting him! Now, what do I have to do?
4930.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 1

4931.0: I found it! I found Bob again! He must have escaped from The Rememberer by himself! I feel really terrible that I let this kind of things happen. I am going back to The Rememberer to tell him to lighten up.
4931.1: I don't think The Rememberer gets the whole idea of me doing this. Bob may be just another monster but I know what is right or wrong. And I am going to pay back just the way he did to me. I need to get 1 #b#t4000019##k other than Bob's to pull this off.
4931.2: I got him! The Remeberer will always remember this day. The day he got tricked by me! Ok. I should stop doing things like this though.
4931.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 2

4932.0: Grendel The Really Old... He lives deep in the forest of Ellinia. Since he's really old, he has to know SOMETHING about Bob. I shall see him now.
4932.1: Grendel The Really Old was talking out of himself but I got to make him hear what I had to say. He is getting glasses. I hope his eyesight isn't too bad to recognize Bob... After all, Grendel is probably the oldest guy in this world.
4932.2: Grendel The Really Old got very mad at me for hitting Bob to make him go into his shell. I knew he would know something but never would have guessed they were old friends. I guess I owe Bob a big apology. But how am I going to be able to do that to a snail, especially if he's not coming out from his shell?
4932.name: Grendel The Really Old's Glorious Days

4936.0: Bruce, the monster researcher, might know something. Maybe he can tell me how old Bob actually is. If I get to know how old he is, wouldn't that be a discovery of something remarkable?
4936.1: He does seem to know something about his age but he looks spooked. I shouldn't hesitate to ask him what is wrong!
4936.2: Wow... Bruce told me that Bob's age is incalculable. This is getting serious, isn't it. A snail that even professional monster researcher can't tell the age. Maybe he was right about asking me to go see Winston. Maybe an archeologist knows more about the history and the age issue than Bruce.
4936.name: Bruce's Research

4937.0: This is a wild guess but... Wouldn't Dances with Balrog know a little bit about Bob? Who knows, I heard that he likes snails. Maybe I will go check with him.
4937.1: I didn't know Dances with Balrog likes to EAT the snails... Now, what am I suppose to do?! It doesn't look like he is going to give me back Bob's Snail Shell anytime soon...
4937.2: I had to take off from Dances with Balrog. Who can STAND all that endless talking? I should figure out a way to get Bob back other than talking him through...
4937.name: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism Part 1

4941.0: I hear that Old Man Tom has been hearing noises from the old Prendergast Mansion on the outskirts of New Leaf City.  A haunted house?  Sounds like the perfect Halloween adventure!
4941.1: Old Man Tom told me about the haunted Prendergast Mansion.  Apparently, the doors won't open for just anyone... I've got to figure out how to get in.  Tom mentioned that the toymaker Prendergast used to hold parties for kids for holidays, including Halloween costume parties around this time of year.  Maybe if I wear a costume I can get in!  Hmmm... Now where can I buy one?
4941.2: I made it into the old Prendergast Mansion, against the advice of Old Man Tom.  I wonder why he's so dead set on keeping people out of the house?  Maybe if I explore the house, I can find out more about what happened here...
4941.name: A Word to the Wise

4942.1: Jonas gave me his Toy Workshop Key.  He wants me to find someone who will keep it safe and ensure that his twisted toys can't escape his house.
4942.2: Turns out Old Man Tom is Thomlin Prendergast, Jonas' younger brother.  I gave him Jonas' Toy Workshop key to keep.  He gave me Sophilia's Necklace, for helping put the spirits in Prendergast Mansion to rest.
4942.name: The Past in the Present

4943.0: I heard there's an old butler in the Haunted House. Maybe he needs help cleaning it...
4943.1: I spoke with Edmunds, Butler of the Prendergast Estate.  It seems that he' run out of #t4000018# to heat the house, which would explain the chill.  I've agreed to help him out and bring back #b60 #t4000018##k so he can refill the fireplaces throughout the house and re-heat the mansion.
4943.2: I brought back #b60 #t4000018##k to Edmunds; he can get the fireplaces going again now.  Hmmm... It seems like there are quite a few fireplaces around this labyrinthine house.
4943.name: A Cold Hearth

4944.0: I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows?  He mentioned something about a key.  I should press him a bit more.
4944.1: My hunch was right.  The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house.  However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key.  He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect #b20 of each type of Gummy Slimes#k. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them.  It'll be tempting to eat them first.
4944.2: Edmunds reluctantly gave me the Omni Key after I collected the Gummy Slimes for him.  With it, I can enter the fireplaces throughout the house and the Chimney to which they all connect. Hmmm... who knows where all these fireplaces lead?
4944.name: Eat This!

4945.0: There's a beautiful woman in the Prendergast house that looks mildly annoyed... perhaps I should speak with her.
4945.1: Man! I spoke-no, tried to speak with Ludmilla, and she wouldn't give me the time of day until I agreed to get her #b5 slices of #t2022190##k for Jonas from Olde Sapp Village. A bit strange that she referred to New Leaf City as that, but Miki should have them at the potion shop. What a cranky woman...
4945.2: Well, I got Ludmilla her #b#t2022190##k, and learned a bit about Jonas and her love...for his money. No wonder Edmunds hates her. I should press that woman for more info about what's going on around here.
4945.name: Special Delivery

4946.0: Oh...looks like Ludmilla is not quite done with me yet. I'd better head back and see what that nag wants now...
4946.1: I spoke with Ludmilla, and big surprise---her Cherry Pie Ghoulash didn't lure Jonas out. I think he probably pushed a bookcase in front of the door to ensure he never sees her again, but that's just a theory. At any rate, it looks like now her prized jewelry has mysteriously disappeared. She thinks Sophilia's taken it, but I'm not sure if I buy that, seeing as how she's...not around to do that. I have to gather #b20 #t4031769#s#k and #b10 #t4031770#s#k and bring them back to her.  The woman complains way too much... sheesh.
4946.2: I found Ludmilla's beloved jewelry for her.  In return she gave me a worn, but well-loved doll. It's seen better days, but it has charm. Someone is probably looking for this...
4946.name: Family Jewels

4947.0: There's a girl wandering around the Prendergast Mansion.  I wonder what she's looking for?
4947.1: Sophilia is looking for her favorite toy - the very first doll her father made for her when she was a child.  She seems to have been looking for it for quite awhile.  She mentioned something about Ludmilla having a history of hiding her toys.  If I can find Sophilia's doll for her, maybe I can put her spirit at ease.
4947.2: I gave Sophilia back her favorite doll.  She was so happy to get it back that she gave me some of her favorite candy.
4947.name: A Lost Girl

4948.0: Jonas gave me a new doll he made to give to his daughter.  I don't think Sophilia'll like it as much her favorite one, but I guess I should give it to her anyway, per her father's wishes.
4948.1: I gave Sophilia the new doll her father made.  It made her sad.  She asked me give Annabelia, the first doll Jonas made for her, back to her father.
4948.2: Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.
4948.name: A Father's Love

4949.0: I heard there's a MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) agent in the Phantom Forest! I should investigate what he's investigating!
4949.1: I spoke with MBI Agent Falcon. He's on the trail of a dangerous specter, but it looks like that crafty ghost gave him the slip by scattering his #b#t4031764#s#k all over the place. I've agreed to collect #b50#k of them so he can continue the hunt!
4949.2: I tracked down all 50 of Agent #b#t4031764#s#k that he asked for!  In return, he's given me Smores! Mmm...if only he had a napkin...
4949.name: The M-Files

4950.0: MBI Agent Falcon is still snooping around the old Haunted House, even after I helped him find some of the Paranormal Activity Report Pages!  I wonder why... maybe he still needs help.
4950.1: Looks like MBI Agent Falcon spoke too soon... 50 pages led him to the wrong, uh, dead guy... but he thinks that if I collect #b100#k more of them, he'll be able to catch Mr. Bones for sure!  Whew... 100 pages.  I wonder how many pages in total were in his original report?
4950.2: I tracked down all of the 100 more #t4031764#s#k Agent Falcon requested!  Now he can finally go track Mr. Bones... I hope.
4950.name: File Under Incomplete

4951.0: Agent Falcon is still hanging out in front of the Haunted House?!  Doesn't he have other ghosts to catch, myths to debunk?  Maybe I should go see if something's wrong...
4951.1: I'm starting to think that Agent Falcon spends too much time writing reports, and not enough time doing actual investigative work!  The elusive Mr. Bones turns out to be Prendergast, the former owner of this house!  Falcon wants me to find Jonas in the Haunted House, give him this Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to fill out, and return the completed form to him.
4951.2: I got my questionnarie from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this?
4951.name: The File Thickens Part 1

4952.0: I keep hearing the groans and bellows of machinery echoing through the house.  What is making this racket?  Is it where these infernal toys are coming from?
4952.1: I found Jonas Prendergast in his Toy Workshop at the top of the house, in front of a huge toy machine which seems to be the source of all these infernal toys!  It seems that his machine is not functioning properly.  If I collect #b50 Firewood#k, #b25 Screws#k, and #b25 Loaded Springs#k, Jonas can build the replacement part to get his machine working properly again.  I know that the Rocking Horses will have the #bFirewood#k and the Psycho Jacks will have the #bScrews and Loaded Springs#k.  I've got to get what Jonas needs-perhaps this will stop it from churning out all these crazy toys!
4952.2: I collected the parts Jonas needed to fix his machine.  I hope I haven't simply helped a madman create more of his messed up toys.
4952.name: The Infernal Toy Machine

4953.0: Looks like Jonas fixed the machine... yet it's still cranking out these crazy toys.  Maybe he is bonkers.  Or maybe he needs some more help.
4953.1: Looks like Jonas needs help building a new doll, a more perfect likeness of Sophilia.  I don't think he realizes she's dead.  In any case, I have to collect #b30 Locks of Doll's Hair, 10 Heartstoppers, 10 Maple Candies, and 10 Pumpkin Taffies#k.  Why the candies?  I may never know...
4953.2: I collected everything Jonas needed to build his new doll in the likeness of his daughter.  I have to say though... it looks nothing like her.
4953.name: In Her Likeness

4954.0: Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.
4954.1: When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness.  He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations.  Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible.  For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
4954.2: Jonas gave me all of his Toymaker Gear in return for helping him destroy his twisted creations.  He also gave me the key to his Toy Workshop, asking me to give it to someone who will help keep it safe and find a way to restore the Prendergast name.
4954.name: Reparations

4955.0: When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness.  He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations.  Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible.  For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
4955.1: Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Psycho Jacks#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think.
4955.2: I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear!  It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...
4955.name: Psycho Jack

4956.0: When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness.  He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations.  Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible.  For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
4956.1: Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Sophilia Dolls#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think. But they are scary looking for sure...
4956.2: cI destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear!  It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...
4956.name: Sophilia Doll

4957.0: When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awaken him from his madness. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible.  For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
4957.1: Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Nightmare#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think. Or is it?
4957.2: I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear!  It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...
4957.name: Nightmare

4958.0: I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what  Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
4958.1: I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what  Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
4958.2: I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what  Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
4958.name: Halloween : Entering the house

4959.1: I got my questionnarie from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this?
4959.2: I gave Agent Falcon's Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to Jonas and had him fill it out.  Finding him in the labyrinthine mansion was the hard part... Jonas was actually quite cooperative, especially for a spirit.  In any case, I returned the completed form to Falcon, who was ecstatic that he didn't have to set foot inside the creepy old mansion again.
4959.name: The File Thickens Part 2

4960.0: I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows?  He mentioned something about a key.  I should press him a bit more.
4960.1: My hunch was right.  The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house.  However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key.  He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect #b20 of each type of Gummy Slimes#k. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them.  It'll be tempting to eat them first.
4960.2: Edmunds reluctantly gave me the #dOmni Key#k after I collected the Gummy Slimes for him.  With it, I can enter the fireplaces throughout the house and the Chimney to which they all connect. Hmmm... who knows where all these fireplaces lead?
4960.name: Eat This!

4962.0: MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) Agent Falcon has been standing in front of the Prendergast Mansion for quite some time.  Maybe I should go see why he's still loitering around.
4962.1: Looks like the bumbling MBI Agent Falcon just can't get a break.  Just when he was ready to pack up and leave to report the findings for his Halloween mission, a mysterious little boy appeared and stole all the Smores Falcon had cooked up for his colleagues!  Falcon has agreed to pay you 100,000 mesos (from his Agency discretionary account) if you recover #b25#k of his #bSmores#k for him.  Easy money - or is it?  The Smores look pretty tasty... I guess I'll have to try not to eat them myself as I collect them!
4962.2: I collected Agent Falcon's #bSmores#k for him... they were a bit dirty but still good, so his colleagues back at the MBI Agency should be happy!  In return, Falcon paid me the 100,000 mesos he promised.  He also gave me some old medicine bottles that he'd found lying outside the house.  They look pretty potent...
4962.name: Smores No More

4963.0: It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!
4963.1: I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of #b#t2020029##k, a can of #b#t2022262##k, a #b#t2022263##k, bowl of #b#t2022264##k and best of all, #b#t2022261##k. They promised me an #b#t4031529##k if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins'... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner!  No dinner?  No way!  Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!
4963.2: My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my #b#t4031529##k! I guess doing chores does pay off! I can take this to any of the Store Vendors in New Leaf City, and receive a #bNexon Game Card#k for it! ...I'd better get out of here before Aunt Petunia shows up! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!
4963.name: Dinner Fixins'

4964.0: I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my #bAllowance#k! Now I can head to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k and obtain a #bNexon Game Card#k from one of the Vendors!
4964.1: I have my #bAllowance#k, and I'm on my way to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a #bNexon Game Card#k! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...
4964.2: I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my #bAllowance#k, I received a #bNexon Game Card#k! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in #bHenesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City#k if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad everyday until the end of the event, receive #bAllowance#k and get another #bNexon Game Card#k. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!
4964.name: Game On! <CVS>

4994.0: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!
4994.1: Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...
4994.2: I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?
4994.name: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

4995.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws.  I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.

4995.2: Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year.  I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.
4995.name: The Spirit of Maplemas

4996.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
4996.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
4996.2: Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...
4996.name: A Versal Tradition

4997.0: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.
4997.1: I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!
4997.2: I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k!  If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!a
4997.name: A Very Merry Maplemas

6026.2: I made a pair of fur boots for Nanuke on behalf of Muse. Whale Island is a cold, cold place to live in, so I made sure to pack in enough fur to make it as warm as possible.
6026.name: Keol's Order #12

6027.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Meren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, has a special order for me to process. Better go see what it is.
6027.1: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Meren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Meren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seems very upset over this, I'll have to go make the delivery myself.\n\n#i4001186# #t4001186# #b#c4001186# / 1
6027.2: The moment Keol saw me walk in, he let me have it. That's because a very important order came from Abdullah VIII, and Meren decided to let me take care of it! Wow... I didn't know Meren had that much faith in me. Anyway, since Keol seemed way too upset to go, I had to go make the delivery myself.
6027.name: Keol's Special Order

6028.1: Abdullah VIII seemed very pleased with the turban and told me to send Meren a royal compliment on his behalf. He also said he already gave Meren the reward. That was quick!
6028.2: I gave Meren the royal compliment that Abdullah VIII made for him. Meren in turn told me how proud he was of the progress I made as an item-producer. As gratifying as it was to receive compliments from someone like Meren, it also put a lot of pressure on me.
6028.name: Abdullah VIII's Statement

6029.0: #b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadnos and Zenumists form an uneasy truce in... one day, a news exploded in the Maple World where an alchemist from Zenumist, #b#p2110004##k, discovered a new method that will change the way alchemy works. #p2110004# was also looking for a capable apprentice that will spread his work to mainstream, and this caused a huge number of people to head over to #m261000000#...\r\nHe's apparently staying at #m261000002# of #m261000000#, which is a town of alchemists at Nihal Desert.
6029.1: After spending a number of years conducting experiments, #b#b#p2110004##k, an alchemist under Zenumist Society, finally discovered a #bnew method#k of producing items, where the item can be created solely out of alchemy. To learn his new method, I visited #p2110004#. He said in order to acquire this new method, I'll have to take three classes... #bthe fundamentals of alchemy, the basic theory of science, and the actual application of alchemy#k...Sheesh, when can I attend all those classes?
6029.2: #b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadno and Zenumist form an uneasy truce in... one day #p2110004#, the alchemist from Zenumist, #b#p2110004##k, discovered a new method of item creation that relies solely on alchemy. Apparently, #p2110004# has been looking for an apprentice for his new method, so I went ahead to #m261000000# to visit him.
6029.name: Meren's New Discovery

6030.0: When I visited Meren to learnhis new method, he instructed me to attend a class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy taught by Carson of Zenumist Society. Ahh... this sounds boring...
6030.1: Meren said in order to attend the class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy, I must visit the head of Zenumist Society, #bCarson#k.
6030.2: I managed to stay awake for Carson's class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy. Yay!
6030.name: Carson's Fundamentals of Alchemy

6031.0: When I visited Meren to learn his new method, he instructed me to attend a class on the Basic Theory of Science taught by that eccentric scientist Hughes the Fuse. This worries me quite a bit...
6031.1: Meren said in order to attend the class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy, I must visit #bHughes the Fuse#k, who is holed up somehwere inside Orbis Tower, doing his own thing.
6031.2: I was able to keep track of Hughes the Fuse's disorienting science class. Yay!!
6031.name: Hughes the Fuse's Basic Theory of Science

6032.0: When I visited Meren to learn his new method, he instructed me to attend his class that deals with the actual application of the new method. Oh, so I am actually doing this now...
6032.1: Meren told me he needs some time to prepare the materials for the class, and told me to talk to him when I'm ready.
6032.2: I went through Meren's class on the actual application of the new method. This was fun!
6032.name: Meren's Class on the Actual Practice

6033.0: I think I have gotten quite familiar with producing items, and I am sure Meren would be shocked to see my prowess in it. Right at that time, Meren called me and told me if I ever had anything to do in Magatia, make sure to stop by and see him.
6033.1:
I wound up heading to Magatia after seeing Meren's message. As soon as I saw him, however, instead of a hearty hug, he gave me a huge scolding. Apparently, he saw one of the items I made at the Free Market, and he was so disgusted by my poor quality of work that he vowed to set me straight by giving me a test.
The test is actually making an Intermediate Monster Crystal. Hmmm... this is quite intense.

#i4260003# #t4260003# #b#c4260003# / 1
6033.2: Meren gave me a lecture on how I had become complacent, and told me I had to start again from scratch. After passing his test by successfully creating the Intermediate Monster Crystal, he let me go, and I realized my item-producing skills have gotten that much better as a result of his words.
6033.name: Meren's Second Round of Teaching

6034.0: It's been a while since I started producing items. I think I am now at the point where Meren is starting to acknowledge my item-producing skills. He seems to be devoting all of his time to creating a new item. I better stop by and say hello...
6034.1: Meren had been devoting all of his time to creating a new item. When I visited him at Magatia, he seemed so into his work that he didn't even realize I was there, and kept on mumbling illegible things. That's whn I noticed something dropped behind his back. What is that?
6034.2: I visited Meren at a lab in Magatia, but he seemed very much into his work that he didn't notice me wakling in. That's when I noticed a piece of paper dropped from behind his back. The note contained a whole bunch of notes. What does it say?
6034.name: What Meren Dropped

6035.1: This piece of note that was found in Meren's lab may be his. I better return it to him.
6035.2: This piece of note that was found in Meren's lab may be his. I better return it to him.
6035.name: The Owner of the Note

6036.1: The piece of paper Meren dropped contained scribbles that seemed like a manual for a Gold Anvil. A Gold Anvil... sounds like something that'd be fun to make. Meren doesn't seem like he wants to make it... so maybe I should try it.\n\n#i4031980# #t4031980# #b#c4031980# / 1
6036.2: I managed to make a Gold Anvil and gave it to Meren. He seemed astounded by the fact that I was able to make it, and gave me a major praise for being able to do so.
6036.name: A Surprise Outcome

6100.0: I found a mysterious book deep in the #m230000000# sea while exploring.  It is Bowman-related and mentions mastery of a skill known as Eye of the Heart. There's also a fading inscription about obtaining something from the book itself. Could this be a skillbook? I must find out!  #p2040052# knows a lot about books.  I should ask if he can decipher anything useful from this book...
6100.1:
#b#p2040052##k read the book and speculated that the book must've been written with invisible ink to conceal valuable information. Clever...but not impossible to break. He says I have to get a special type of ink in order to read it. He can use the ink to restore the inscriptions so it is once again readable. The ingredients are #b#t04000183#, #t02022000#, and #t04006000##k...I hope this isn't all for naught...

#i4000183##t4000183#  #b#c4000183# / 50#k
#i2022000##t2022000#  #b#c2022000# / 10#k
#i4006000##t4006000#  #b#c4006000# / 30#k
#i4161018##t4161018#  #b#c4161018# / 1#k.
6100.2: I found the ingridients and returned them to #p2040052#. He said making the ink takes a bit of time, so I'll have to wait until it's ready.
6100.name: The Book of Invisible Ink

6101.1: After I handed him all the ingredients,  #p2040052# sprinkled the ink on the book.  Before our eyes, the ink soaked into the pages and restored the words! It revealed information about the Bowman's ultimate skill!  What could that be? It sounds powerful...I should go ask #b#p1012100##k. \n\n#t4161024#  #b#c4161024# / 1#k.
6101.2: When I asked #p1012100# about the book, she was shocked! I related the entire tale of the ink restoring the pages, and how #p2040052# mentioned it was made with invisible ink to prevent knowledge of this technique from spreading into unworthy hands. She has agreed to take a further look into the book to find out more.
6101.name: The Ancient Book

6102.1: While studying the book, Athena remarked that she's heard about the Bowman's Ultimate Skill but has never seen one of these books before. She told me that if one masters this skill, they might even surpass her in level.  To discover more, she told me to go see #bRene#k...\n\n#t4161025#  #b#c4161025# / 1#k for more information. This is shaping up to be quite a journey...
6102.2: I traveled to the frozen fields of El Nath and gave the book to Rene. She was intrigued by the book as well, and wants to study it a bit more before she tells me more information.
6102.name: The Bowman's Ultimate Skill

6103.1: Despite her vast knowledge of bow-based combat, #p2020010#, like #p1012100#, didn't know much about the skill. I hear #bShammos#k's rambling about something...Perhaps I should pay him a visit...\n\n#t4161026#  #b#c4161026# / 1#k
6103.2: #p2022003# took the book and started reading it. Would he know something? He certainly appeared focused on deciphering what this new skill could be...I hope he can tell me more!
6103.name: Shammos's Advice

6104.1: My hunch was right about #bShammos#k. He knew a bit more and was able to give me further details, but there's something strange about what #p2022003# said. Let's ask #b#p2020010##k. Finally getting somewhere! \n\n#t4161027#  #b#c4161027# / 1#k
6104.2: I took the book back to #p2020010# following a lead from #bShammos#k. Rene said that #p2022003# used to be human and that I should pay close attention to what he says--both as a warning and path to discovering more.
6104.name: New Guess

6105.1: I spoke with #p2020010#, who had a new suggestion to help me piece together this puzzle. She told me to go to see #b#p1061011##k in Sleepywood. I can sense the answers coming soon--they'd better, because my feet are tiring from all this walking! \n\n#t4161028#  #b#c4161028# / 1
6105.2: My journey continues...#p1061011# had no idea about the book. But he said he might be able to point me in the right direction to who would know about the book...
6105.name: The One Who Remembers...

6106.1: #p1061011# said #b#p1061012##k will know about the Bowman's ultimate skill. At last! I'm on my way there now! \n\n#t4161029# #b#c4161029# / 1
6106.2: #p1061012# was aware of the book and gave me the answers I needed. I see that my journey has just begun, but I will gain tremendous power should I see it through to completion. Onward!
6106.name: Insignificant Being

6107.1: #b#p1061012##k says he can send me to the Bowman's training place if I bring him #b#t4031466##k which is carried by #m910500000#. \n\n#i4031466##t4031466# #b#c4031466# / 50#k
6107.2: I gave 50 #t4031466#, which is needed to enter #m910500000#, to #p1061012#. I am one step closer to obtaining this ultimate skill. The anticipation is growing within me...
6107.name: Spiritual Stone of Darkness

6108.1: #b#p1061012##k said he'll teach me the ultimate skill once I go to #m910500000# and get #b300 #o9300085##k. It's almost within my grasp! \n\n#o9300085# #r#a61081##k
6108.2: After completing the training to catch Junior Balrogs in #m910500000#, I acquired the Bowman's ultimate skill! Power is now mine--I shall master this skill and use it triumph over my enemies in battle!
6108.name: Junior Balrog in a Different World

6110.0: I obtained a book I can't read. It looks like it's written in a strange language. The writing is crude, almost like an animal wrote it...a kind of monster language. I wonder if #b#p1022002##k would know how to read it. Couldn't hurt to speak with him...
6110.1: My hunch paid off. When I asked #b#p1022002##k about the book, he examined the language closer and came to a conclusion. He said the book is about the #bRush#k skill. He offered to translate, but he said that I must prove myself as one worthy to obtain such power--a true warrior in his eyes. I must eliminate #r200 #o9300087##k in #m910500100# located at the entrance of the Sanctuary, deep in Sleepywood. Manji saw that I was surprised by the high number and advised me to make a party with a few of like-minded companions to ensure victory. This is precisely what friends are for...\n\n#o9300087# #r#a61101##k
6110.2: With a bit of help from my trusty weapon, I easily defeated the requisite number that #p1022002##k requested. As promised, he translated the book, and it revealed the famed skill known as Rush. I can't wait to try it out!
6110.name: Manji's Test

6120.0: #b#p2081007##k, guardian of the holy dragon Nine Spirit. I heard he knows a lot about dragons.
6120.1: I met Raul, who introduced himself as the knight who guards the holy dragon, Nine Spirit. He needs help making the dragon grow and I've agreed to assist him. He told me to get #b#t04031449##k in order to make the baby dragon display it's potential power. #t04031449# can only be obtained from a living dragon....If I catch a Wyvern, I'm sure I can get it. \n\n#i4031449##t4031449# #b#c4031449#/20#k
6120.2: After a bit of Wyvern hunting, I brought #t4031449#, Raul breathed power to the baby dragon. Now the baby dragon has #r#q2321003##k's power!
6120.name: The Dragon's Guardian

6121.0: After speaking with #b#p2081007##k, he said the dragon has not reached maturity. There must be something I can do to increase its' power...
6121.1: Raul told me to gather #b25 #t4031482##k if I want to raise #q2321003#'s power. It's time to hunt! \n\n#i4031482##t4031482# #b#c4031482#/25#k
6121.2: After I gave Raul #t4031482#, he awakened #q2321003#'s power. I can feel it radiating...magnificent!
6121.name: Bahamut's Power 1

6122.0: I spoek with #b#p2081007##k, who mentioned that the dragon is not at its full power yet. I must find a way to increase its power further...perhaps through a ritual or item?
6122.1: Raul has agreed to help me further. He told me to gather #b30 #t04031483##k if I want to raise #q2321003#'s power. I should be able to strengthen the dragon even more! \n\n#i4031483##t4031483# #b#c4031483#/30#k
6122.2: After a long hunt, I gave Raul #t4031483#. Using it in an ancient ritual, he increased #q2321003#'s power even more. Yet something tells me there is more power within the dragon, waiting to be unlocked...
6122.name: Bahamut's Power 2

6123.0: The feeling I had within was confirmed by #b#p2081007##k. There is a way to unlock more of the dragon's power. I will not rest until I have discovered it. Raul has been helpful thus far--I wonder if he'd be willing to assist me again...
6123.1: Raul has agreed to help me again. I'm to gather #b35 #t04031484##k if I want to raise #q2321003#'s power. \n\n#i4031484##t4031484# #b#c4031484#/35#k
6123.2: Another long, but successful hunt. I gave Raul #t04031484#, and he increased #q2321003#'s power even more. When will the dragon reach its full power? It seems to be limitless...
6123.name: Bahamut's Power 3

6124.0: I once again seek to enhance the power of the dragon. After speaking with #b#p2081007##k, he says the dragon still hasn't reached its full power.  I must see this through to the end. The full power of the dragon must be a sight to behold. I must ask Raul for assistance once more to unleash the power of the dragon.
6124.1: The final step to unlock the dragon's power is at hand! Raul says if I get #b40#t4031485##k he will awaken #q2321003#'s power.  He says this will complete the dragon's power. My heart trembles with anticipation... \n\n#i4031485##t4031485# #b#c4031485#/40#k
6124.2: At last, the dragon's power is complete. And it shall truly be a sight to behold! I will use this power wisely...
6124.name: Bahamut's Completion

6130.0: I obtained a peculiar looking book. The entire book, cover to cover, is black so I can't read it.... I'm getting a strange vibe from the book. Perhaps #b#p2081200##k will know something about this book.
6130.1: #p2081200# said to go see #b#p2060100##k, the witch from the deep sea, to get information about this book. #p2060100#...? Why won't  #p2081200# just tell me about the book himself? Would #p2060100# really know anything? I'm skeptical, but I have no choice...I must know more! \n\n#i4001107##t4001107# #b#c4001107# / 1#k
6130.2: #p2060100#  didn't know much about the book itself. However, she seemed to know #bhow to read the book#k. She understood the language, and agreed to tell me what it means upon my return.
6130.name: Black Book

6131.1:
I went to see #p2060100# with #t4001107#. #p2060100# says I have to burn the book with cold flames in order to read it. A strange, but effective way of hiding the infromation contained within. The information has to be important if someone went through all this trouble. She's agreed to help me. I must gather  #b5 #t4000008#, 50#t4000081#, and 100#t4000150##k to make #t4001108#  which is needed to burn cold flames. Can I trust this witch? I hope she does not lead me down the wrong path...

#i4000008##t4000008# #b#c4000008#/5#k 
#i4000081##t4000081# #b#c4000081#/50#k 
#i4000150##t4000150# #b#c4000150#/100#k
6131.2: Success! I gave all the ingredients to #p2060100# to make #b#t4001108##k. Now, I must find a place to properly burn the book...perhaps the sea?
6131.name: Method of Contradiction

6132.1: I found an altar within a deep sea cavern that was emitting cold energy. If I start a cold fire and throw in the black book, I should find out more about the content inside--but what to do after? Perhaps taking the new book to #b#p2060100##k will yield answers. \n\n#i4161017##t4161017# #b#c4161017# / 1#k
6132.2: The book's identity has been revealed. It was #bCaron's Note#k! One journey ends as another begins...now to find out more!
6132.name: Cold Flame

6133.1: According to #p2060100#, the author of this book appears to be Caron, a boatman at the River of Death who takes spirits to the underworld. He wrote stories about ferrying those who died to the underworld; but yet returned, somehow brought back to life. As I continued to read, I noticed a familar name. It was #b#p1061011##k of #bSleepywood#k... #p2060100# told me I could find out about the secrets of death if I meet those who returned from the grave. There is a secret here that I must discover!
6133.2: #p1061011# knew about Caron as #p2060100# said. It appears there is a way to learn how to bring back the dead back to life. Such a technique would certainly come in handy during encounters with dangerous monsters. I must learn it!
6133.name: Caron's Note

6134.1: When I asked #p1061011# to teach me how to resurrect the dead, he told me that I have to experience death.  He told me to go to the dark place across from the Door of death, guarded by #bThanatos#k, at the #bBottom of Ludibrium clock tower#k. I'm a bit scared, but my spirit is telling me that this is the path to take.\n\n#i4031448##t4031448# #b#c4031448#/1#k
6134.2: That was a tough test, but somehow, I survived. I received the supremely powerful skill known as #b#q2321006##k.  #p1061011# said those who obtain such power should never abuse it. This technique, while powerful, breaks one of nature's most sacred laws, that of life and death. I should be careful...
6134.name: Resurrection

6140.0: #b#p2081400##k says he has something to tell me...perhaps I should pay him a visit.
6140.1: #b#p2081400##k told me to meet #b#p1052001##k. Now that I think about it, it's been a long time since I've seen the Dark Lord. He never seems to age...
6140.2: #p1052001# said he has some interesting suggestions and that if I'm interested, he'll tell me more.
6140.name: Return of the Dark Lord
6140.parent: The One Hidden in the Shadow

6141.0: #p1052001# says he has a good suggestion and has offered to tell me more. Perhaps I should accept. I've heard it is unwise to refuse a request from the Dark Lord.
6141.1: #b#p1052001##k said he wanted me to be his disciple and has entrusted me with disciplining his other students.  He told me to defeat his other #b6 disciples#k who are disguised as him and earn their loyalty.  He told me if I'm interested to come back to him and ask #bI want to know about being a Thief#k...Is this some sort of game? The Dark Lord is known for his wily tricks and deceitful ways, but also for great power...I will see where this path leads me, hopefully to a new skill! \n\n#o9300088# #r#a61411##k
6141.2: I defeated the imposters and earned their loyalty. I made #o9300088#, a powerful Thief, into my shadow partner. I can now use him and the other five students in battle to great effect. My enemies will never know what hit them...
6141.name: The Night Warrior
6141.parent: The One Hidden in the Shadow

6150.0: #b#p2040052##k of #b#m222020000##k says he has something to tell me...
6150.1:
#p2040052# talked about a warrior named #bSeram#k. He mentioned a singing shield which I can use to get information about the old techniques of Sayram. Then he told me to go see  #b#p2081000##k at #bLeafle#k to find more information about him...Let's go see #b#m240000000#'s Chief#k with the #b#t4161019##k that  
#p2040052# gave me. Should be an amusing trip at the least. A singing shield? I wonder...   

#i4161019##t4161019#  #b#c4161019# / 1#k
6150.2: Tatamo seems to know about Sayram, however, the singing shield is another matter. I wonder if this is all true or just some kind of joke...perhaps I should talk with Chief Tatamo again.
6150.name: The Great Warrior, Sayram

6151.1: #p2081000# knows about Sayram but doesn't know anything about the singing shield. He says that I might be able to find some information on it from the #b#t04031479##k which Sayram gave to Griffey, whom he dearly loved. So I'll head to Minar Forest and find the necklace from the #o8180001#. Should be a piece of cake...yea, right...\n\n#i4031479##t4031479# #b#c4031479#/1
6151.2: I found #t4031479#, and after some "persuasion", obtained the necklace. Now to return to Chief Tatamo and see what he says about this.
6151.name: Griffey's Necklace

6152.1: I brought the necklace back to Tatamo, the chief of Leafre. He looked at the picture inscribed on the #o8180001#'s necklace, and said that since #b#p1061012##k knows about Sayram, I should go show him the necklace. Off I go! \n\n#i4031467##t4031467# #b#c4031467#/1
6152.2: On Chief Tatamo's recommendation, I spoke with #p1061012#, who knew about the necklace and the Singing Shield. I must ask him for more information about the shield!
6152.name: Singing Shield

6153.1:
#b#p1061012##k said the picture on the necklace points to #m910500200#, the deepest part in the entrance of the Shrine. He said that I would find the Singing Shield there.  However, he said #m910500200# would be locked so I would have to eliminate #o9500139# to get the key....Will I really get Sayram's shield there? The Insignificant Being tells me to try taking the key I already used for another world to #b#p2040052##k as well...This is getting interesting, I'd better keep my weapon close! 

#i4031471##t4031471# #b#c4031471#/1#k
#i4031475##t4031475# #b#c4031475#/1#k
6153.2: I went to  #b#p2040052##k of #b#m222020000##k to find the singing shield. While talking to the Wiz, Wiz found the skill book from the singing shield.  This WAS the great warrior Sayram's skill! I have learned a new technique! Quite unexpected but excellent nonetheless. I shall use this in battle to defeat my enemies!
6153.name: Sayram's Skill

6160.0: #p2020009# says she has something he wants to tell me...perhaps I should pay him a visit and see what could be so important.
6160.1: #p2020009# said she has a book she really wants to show me and told me to see #b#p2040052##k in the Helios Tower. I wonder why she dropped off the book there? Maybe the information is meant to kept secret...
6160.2: #p2040052# agreed to find the book for me. I wonder what the book says, must be important...
6160.name: Robeira's Book

6161.1: #p2040052# said the book #p2020009# left for me is quite strange, and relates to Magicians somehow. I'm supposed to deliver it to #b#p1032001##k if I'm finished with it. Magician's story? What could it be? Maybe I can ask #p1032001##k.\n\n#t4161020# #b#c4161020# / 1#k
6161.2: Upon delivering the book to #p1032001#, I decided to ask about the book. My words met with a empty look and eerie silence. I may have just hit a nerve...
6161.name: A Magician's Story

6162.1: After an uneasy silence, #p1032001# spoke at last. He said that the main character of the book is none other than #p2022003#, who used to be a human and a genius Magician. Then he asked me to go check out the elder's official residence, #b#p2022003##k, to see how he's doing these days...
6162.2: #p2022003# is still out of it. But I think I heard him say #p1032001# ..
6162.name: Another Crazy Genius?!

6163.1: When I asked #p2022003# about #p1032001#, I could tell he was very resentful towards #p1032001# and #p2020009#. Let's go back to #b#p1032001##k and tell him about #p2022003#.
6163.2: #p1032001# looked disappointed as he said how #p2022003# used to be a great Magician...
6163.name: Shammos!

6164.1: #p2022003# seems very resentful.  #p1032001# asked me to tell him that he's sorry. But would #p2022003# even accept his apology?  Either way,  let's go to #b#p2022003##k and relay #p1032001#'s message.

8219.0: I heard that John Barricade has received news from his brother Jack!  I should go find John in Bigger Ben and see what he's learned.
8219.1: Apparently, Jack Barricade is in Masteria and has discovered Crimsonwood Keep deep in the Phantom Forest.  However, the last letter John received from his brother was dated over a month ago.  John wants me to head to Crimsonwood after him and see why Jack's communiques have stopped.  Looks like I need to make my way through the Phantom Forest... I'd better stock up on potions!
8219.2: I found Jack Barricade resting in a cave on Crimsonwood Mountain.  It turns out that after exploring the Masterian wilderness for weeks, Jack finally came across the ancient stronghold - only it wasn't deserted.  Jack was captured and imprisoned in the Keep by the evil soldiers I've been seeing around, but luckily managed to escape.  John will be relieved that Jack is okay.
8219.name: Finding Jack

8220.0: I lost the translated communique, then Let's go to Elpam Gorlab!
8220.1: I told Elpam Gorlab what I want.
8220.2: I got the translated communique from Elpam Gorlab again. Thank You!
8220.name: Translated Communique

8221.0: Lukan told me about the Valley of Heroes and the giant Menhir columns barring the way through.  He mentioned that the Heroic Statues that line the valley would also act as teleporters, for only someone who had an artifact known as the Marker of Heroism.  Perhaps someone well-versed in ancient artifacts would know something about these Markers of Heroism... I think I may have an idea on who to ask.  Otherwise, it's time for some ledge hopping!
8221.1: I was right: John Barricade's extensive knowledge about ancient civilizations and items has paid off again!  He'll give me the Barricades' Marker of Heroism if I reimburse him for the materials they had to acquire to recreate it: #b1 Power Crystal#k, #b10 Gold Ores#k and #b4 Typhon Feathers#k.  The only problem: Typhons nest in the upper reaches of the mountain!  To get up the mountain, I'll have to go through the Valley first!  Ugh!  Looks like a catch-22!  Hmmm, I guess I could see if someone else might have these feathers... I wonder if anyone else has already made it through the Valley on their own?
8221.2: John gave me the Marker of Heroism artifact after I brought him the hard-to-find Typhon feathers and the other materials.  Now I'll be able to the Heroic Statues to get through the Valley.  However, it's not all candy and cake yet; I still need to figure out the correct statues to use, but at least it'll make it easier for me to move around.  Guess I'll try each statue as I go along and see where they lead!
8221.name: The Mark of Heroism

8222.0: I've heard tell that many travelers get lost in the spooky Phantom Forest.  If I come across any of them, perhaps one of them will have an interesting tale to tell about the area.  I should search them out, but I better make sure I don't become one of these lost travelers myself... yikes!
8222.1: I met a knight lost in the Phantom Forest named #bLukan de Vrisien#k.  His armor is very ancient-looking, and he seems to be from another era.  Lukan asked if I knew anything about the unfriendly #bStormbreaker#k warriors wandering the forest.  He seems to hate them, though strangely, his armor looks almost exactly like theirs... lightning bolts and all!  Regarding this, Lukan remains tight-lipped... at least until I prove I'm not in league with them.  To gain his trust, and prove my fighting prowess, I need to #bdefeat these Stormbreakers#k and #bcollect 10 of their badges#k to bring to him.
8222.2: After defeating the Stormbreakers as he requested, Lukan explained that he is a #bStormcaster Knight#k from Crimsonwood Keep.  When I told him that Crimsonwood Keep was ancient history, and that Masteria had been lost for a millenium, he seemed at a loss for words.  Somehow, he has been transported to this time period, his future.  Strange things are brewing indeed.
8222.name: The Brewing Storm

8223.0: To enter the Grandmaster Hall of Crimsonwood Keep and find the new twisted Masters, Jack Barricade says I'll need to find some way to open the gate to the Keep's Inner Sanctum.  Perhaps someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep will know what I need... and I know just who to ask!
8223.1: I asked Lukan about the Inner Sanctum Gate, and as I surmised, he knew how to get in.  Being a well-respected Stormcaster Knight, he was given a #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k by the Keep's Grandmasters.  However, Lukan thinks that I'm mad to assault the castle and refuses to give me the key, calling it a suicide mission.  However, if I can whittle down the Keep's defenders, he'll relent and give me the Keystone.  I've already put the hurt on the Stormbreakers, but I'll need to defeat at least #b75 Windraiders, 75 Firebrands#k, and #b75 Nightshadows#k more to put a sizeable enough dent in this evil army!
8223.2: I defeated the twisted Crimsonwood warriors!  And true to his word, Lukan gave me his #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k.  He also said that although the Keystone will physically unlock the Inner Sanctum Gate, the red energy field that surrounds them is foreign to him, and likely a new addition by the Keep's new Masters.  I should take the key back to Jack Barricade and let him know what I've discovered.
8223.name: Storming the Castle

8224.0: I've heard people say that there's a band of bandits in the Phantom Forest.  Maybe they're responsible for the travelers that go missing in the woods.  Perhaps I should investigate and see if there is any truth to this story
8224.1: Turns out that these so-called bandits are not responsible for any disappearances, at least so they say.  However, I'm still not really sure why they're camped out here in the middle of these haunted woods.  Their leader, a mysterious tough named #bTaggrin#k, seems quite unfriendly to strangers.  Taggrin said that there was one thing I could do however: #bcut down the possessed Phantom Trees#b and bring him #b50#k of their #bseeds#k.  I'm not sure why he wants them, but I guess the fewer angry trees around the better for everyone.
8224.2: I fulfilled Taggrin's request and brought him the fallen seeds from the Phantom Trees.  He seemed to warm up to me for doing this, and has opened the bandit's camp up to me.  Now I can buy and sell things from their provisioner, Mo.  Whew, this has definitely saved me the effort of having to trek all the way back to NLC!
8224.name: The Fallen Woods

8225.0: Jack Barricade has given me the #bMap of Phantom Forest#k that he took from Taggrin.  He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square.  Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use.  Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin?  If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, #ballowing me to use the marked shortcuts#k and save time traveling.  But at the same time, there's a part of me that feels that this map still rightfully belongs to Taggrin.  What should I do?  It's a dilemma...
8225.1: I told Taggrin that I'd found Jack up the Crimsonwood Mountain, and explained Jack's purpose.  Taggrin was surprised when I offered to return his Map of Phantom Forest to him... and was moved by my gesture. He seems to have warmed up to me, and ask that I return and speak to him. What could he want?
8225.2: In return for making the honorable gesture of returning his map, Taggrin let me in on a secret of his own: he and his band are not bandits at all, but are actually #bRaven Ninjas#k, descendants of the ancient #bShadowknights#k!  They're here to discover what happened to their ancestral Keep and the reason behind the disappearance of Masteria.  As such, Taggrin is offering a bounty on the Keep's unrightful occupiers.  I can now speak to Joko to redeem any #rBadges#k I find off these corrupted warriors (the #rWindraiders#k, the #rStormbreakers#k, the #rFirebrands#k, and the #rNightshadowsRk) for #bmeso bounties#k, and possibly even #bRaven Ninja gear#k!  I can make #bone Badge Bounty Redemption per day#k
8225.name: The Right Path

8226.0: I should speak to Taggrin to see if he has another task for me.
8226.1: Taggrin has one more task for me: he wants me to hunt down the #bElder Wraiths#k and collect #b50 of their Elder Ashes#k.  Warning me that this would be no easy task, he explained that the wraiths are the souls of brave Crimsonwood Keep warriors who fell in battle in the forest, protecting the Keep from the invading Krakians.  Never given a proper burial, they have become mindless undead, threatening the Keep's foes and innocent travelers alike.  With these ashes, Taggrin intends to give these noble lost souls the final rest they so rightfully deserve.
8226.2: Taggrin was impressed that I manage to collect the ashes from the Elder Wraiths.  I can now speak to #bFiona#k about #bupgrading any Raven Ninja gear#k I may have!  Taggrin also mentioned that the talented ninja smith has experimented with some weapon designs of her own; I should speak to her about the possibility of #bcrafting new items#k from scratch.
8226.name: The Fallen Warriors

8227.0: I should see if Jack Barricade needs my help with anything...
8227.1: Jack needs John's help, and needs me to be the go-between.  He wants me to deliver a letter to his brother in NLC; the #bCoded Communique#k contains a transcription of some strange symbol code that he saw while being held in Crimsonwood Keep.  Hopefully, with his expertise in ancient languages, John should be able to decipher it.  I should hop to it!  I have a feeling some serious events are unfolding...
8227.2: Looks like Jack was right about the symbols he saw in the Grandmaster Council Hall; the Versalian code seems to indicate that the new Masters are planning to attack NLC with the soldiers they're training!  It's going to be up to us to stop them!
8227.name: Lost in Translation 1

8228.0: I should see if John needs my help with anything...
8228.1: After showing John the #bCoded Communique#k that Jack gave me, John used a Hyper Glyph to try to decipher the symbols... to no avail.  While John attempts to fix and recalibrate the Hyper Glyphs to work on these symbols, he asked me to show the letter around to the #bother experts in town#k.  Maybe they can shine some light on all this...
8228.2: I told John about Elpam's translation, and John was able to fill in some more of the blanks for me.  I need to get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...
8228.name: Lost in Translation 2

8229.0: I showed the #bCoded Communique#k to Elpam Gorlab, and he recognized the symbols as being #bVersalian#k!  Elpam translated what he could and gave me a #bTranslated Communique#k.  I should show this to John immediately!
8229.1: I must traverse Crimsonwood Mountain and get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...!
8229.2: I reached Jack and gave him the info-he's going through it all now...
8229.name: Lost in Translation 3

8230.0: The Versalian code that Jack uncovered and that Elpam translated points to some sort of imminent attack on New Leaf City by the Twisted Masters' army.  It's up to us to stop them!  I should talk to John...
8230.1: Someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep.  I think I have an idea who might be able to help.
8230.2: I brought Lukan's #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k to Jack.  I explained what Lukan told me: that this would unlock the gate mechanically, but the red energy field was a new development. Jack thinks he can figure out a solution for the magical barrier, but he'll need some time.  I should check in with him later and see if he's made any progress.
8230.name: Stemming the Tide

8231.0: With all the strange occurrences in Masteria and New Leaf City, Lita Lawless must be busy! I'll bet that she's willing to accept my help...maybe I can earn some mesos in the process! A quick jaunt to the Kerning City subway and I'll be on my way to New Leaf City!
8231.1: I spoke with Lita, and it looks like there a trickster roaming about the Phantom Forest. It caused her quite a bit of trouble-surprising for a warrion of her caliber. I've agreed to help rid the Forest of these nefarious creatures, and as proof, I have to bring her#b 30 of the strange silver clovers#k-she called them #bLucky Charms#k. I'll be on guard-that forest is haunted...or so I've heard...
8231.2: I ventured into the maddening Phantom Forest and came into contact with a number of the Leprechauns and after a series of battles, got 30 Lucky Charms. I returned them to Lita for the Bounty! She thanked me for my help, and mentioned that I can return to her for more bounty work!
8231.name: Fool's Gold

I've agreed to eliminate 30 of them, and bring their soiled rags to Lita as proof of valor. I'd better keep sharp-that forest has driven quite a few travelers mad with its confusion...
8233.2: I navigated the Phantom Forest and collected 30 of the Soiled Rags the Elder Wraiths had upon them. It was strange to finally fight one, they were eerily quiet for being so vicious. I wonder if there's more to their story...perhaps someone in the Phantom Forest would know...
8233.name: Rags to Riches

He was a former warrior of Crimsonwood Keep that was experimented on the mysterious Alchemist, the same one who corrupted the Krakians. He now roams the Phantom Forest, and I must bring his Jack O'Lantern head to Lita as proof of my triumph!
8235.2: It was a tough fight, but I brought down the mighty horseman and returned his Jack O'Lantern to Lita. I wonder how many other lives the mysterious Alchemist has ruined...
8235.name: One Step A-Head

8237.1: I spoke with Lita, and I'm pretty sure I'm getting the short end of the stick on this one. I have to venture into the Phantom Forest and find this creature they've named Bigfoot and claim its toe as the proof of bounty. Everyone else who's gone after this thing has never come back-I'd better stock up on potions and keep my guard up-who knows when it could appear?
8237.2: I found this mysterious creature, and Lita wasn't kidding when she said it wrecked everyone that came after it! Although, when I was fighting it, I got the feeling that the Leprechaun on its back was just luring him into things...maybe it just doesn't know better? At any rate, I returned the Toe to Lita and claimed the Bounty.  The more mesos, the better!
8237.name: Catch a Bigfoot by the Toe

8239.0: I've completed all Bounty Hunter bounties for Lita Lawless! I think its about time I'm deputized!  I should head to New Leaf City and find out more!
8239.1: I spoke with Lita, and she's all set to deputize me whenever I'm ready!  Completing all those quests was hard, but well worth the effort!
8239.2: I've been deputized by Lita Lawless as an official protector of New Leaf City!  I've sworn to defend the area, and Masteria in general from all future threats...and from what it looks like, there's going to be a lot of them!
8239.name: Bounty Master

8245.0: So If I head over to #b#p9010000##k, then I'll be able to receive an attendance sheet? I see... so this is to check my ardent attendance to MapleStory. Sounds very intriguing...
8245.1: #b#p9010000##k told me if I take this attendance sheet to #b#p9200000##k, then I'll be able to receive PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookie, and Fruit Roll Up in return. If I continue to gather the items for 14 days, then on the 15th day, I can get a special prize!  Apparently I have to come back everyday to claim the prize!
8245.2: As I was successful in checking my attendance, I received scrumptious lunch items in return. I better keep these items that I received from #p9200000# somewhere safe. \n#p9200000# told me if I give him all the items on the 15th day, I'll get something nice as well!
8245.name: Attendance Check

8246.0: I wonder what #b#p9200000##k will give me if I give him these items I collected for the last 2 weeks.
8246.1: I came to MapleStory everyday and collected all the scrumptious lunch items. From what I hear, it has something to do with the 5 types of snacks I collected...
8246.2: I gave #b#p9200000##k the lunch snacks I had collected for 14 days. Hope they didn't rot! Anyways, he seemed ecstatic and gave me a cool lunchbox that can be used as a weapon.
8246.name: Attendance Check

8247.0: I wonder what all the commotion is about. Rumor has it that there's a race going on. The team that collects the most Notebooks will win. The reward is also said to be very nice...
8247.1: I'm really anxious to find out which team is winning. I gotta get more players involved to win this race!
8247.2: I gave Maple Administrator the Notebook. She seemed very ecstatic, as if it was for him... seriously, what did she do with all those notebooks?
8247.name: Donate Your Notebook

8248.0: Tomorrow is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market!
8248.1: Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow! Come join us!
8248.2: Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow! Come join us!
8248.name: Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow!

8249.0: Today is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market!
8249.1: Today is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market! It's here every Sunday!
8249.2: Maple 7th Day Market is here today.
8249.name: Maple 7th Day Market

8251.0: Let's go to the Maple 7th Day Market and find Lazy Daisy, the daughter of the poultry farm owner.
8251.1: You will be rewarded for tending to Lazy Daisy's egg. The egg grows every time you hunt, and leaving the UI open will bring optimal results. And for the egg to grow into a chicken, you must apply the growth powder which is distributed by the Maple Admin daily. If you have succeeded in growing your egg to a chicken, you should go see Lazy Daisy who is visiting Henesys on Saturday.
8251.2: You have successfully hatched Lazy Daisy's egg! You will be rewarded if you succeed more than 5 times, so let's try again!
8251.name: Helping the daughter of the poultry farm owner, Lazy Daisy

8254.0: There are things to be done in order to tend Lazy Daisy's egg successfully. Let's go see the GM.
8254.1: You must go find the GM every day from Monday through Friday, and receive the growth powder and apply it on the egg.
8254.2: You receive the growth power for today. Hurry up and apply it on your chicken.
8254.name: Hatch the egg

8255.0: A new traveler is in the town of El Nath, I wonder what his story is...perhaps something to do with Zakum? I should pay him a visit; I heard his name is Adonis.
8255.1: I visited El Nath, and found Adonis. He's speaking to me now...
8255.2: Adonis and I had an enlightening conversation about Zakum, and the residents of the former town. It appears that Zakum gains additional power from what Adonis calls "Zakum Diamonds".  They are souls of those who fell in battle against the mighty Zakum.  As they were fellow warriors and adventurers like me, their souls must be released.  If I can find a relic of the old town, such as a Crystal Blade, Miner's Hat, El Nathian Cape or Cloak of Corruption and combine it with a Zakum Diamond, I can perform a 'Liberation Ritual" that will free the soul by transferring their power into that item.  I can then wear the enchanted item for extra strength in battle!  Only thing is, Zakum Diamonds only come from one place, Zakum himself.  This won't be easy...
8255.name: Lost Spirits

8257.0: It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!
8257.1: I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of #b#t2020029##k, a can of #b#t2022262##k, a #b#t2022263##k, bowl of #b#t2022264##k and best of all, #b#t2022261##k. They promised me an #b#t4031529##k if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins'... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner!  No dinner?  No way!  Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!
8257.2: My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my #b#t4031529##k! I guess doing chores does pay off! I can take this to any of the Store Vendors in New Leaf City, and receive a #bNexon Game Card#k for it! ...I'd better get out of here before Aunt Petunia shows up! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!
8257.name: Dinner Fixins'

8258.0: I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my #bAllowance#k! Now I can head to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k and obtain a #bNexon Game Card#k from one of the Vendors!
8258.1: I have my #bAllowance#k, and I'm on my way to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a #bNexon Game Card#k! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...
8258.2: I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my #bAllowance#k, I received a #bNexon Game Card#k! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in #bHenesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City#k if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad everyday until the end of the event, receive #bAllowance#k and get another #bNexon Game Card#k. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!
8258.name: Game On! <CVS>
