8289.0: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!
8289.1: Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...
8289.2: I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?
8289.name: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

8290.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws.  I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
8290.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma.  Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
8290.2: Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year.  I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.
8290.name: The Spirit of Maplemas

8291.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
8291.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
8291.2: Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...
8291.name: A Versal Tradition

8292.0: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.
8292.1: I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws.  In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year.  All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!
8292.2: I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws.  In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit!  Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k!  If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!a
8292.name: A Very Merry Maplemas

8293.0: Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo.  I should go see O-Pongo in New Leaf City if I want to give it to him.  Decisions, decisions...
8293.1: I'm thinking it's Versalmas for me this year!  All I have to do now to cement my decision is to actually give Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo.  I can't wait!  It's time for a change of pace!
8293.2: Looks like I'm celebrating Versalmas this year!  I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to O-Pongo, and he gave me this awesome #bVersalmas Hat#k for me to wear proudly!  Every time I bring O-Pongo presents I've collected from monsters, he'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents to him in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k.  I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards!  I'll need to bring him presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing O-Pongo more presents will also help me earn #bVersalmas Cheer#k!  If the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k, O-Pongo will have something really nice for me at the end of the event!
8293.name: Happy Versalmas to You

9143.1: #p9010000#는 #b달나라#k에 살고 있는 #b#p9001103##k가 맛있는 #b#t4031187##k을 구하고 있다고 말했다. 월묘가 송편을? 무슨 일이지? 금송편을 가지고 달나라로 가보자.
9143.2: #p9001103#는 요즘은 월묘의 떡보다 인간의 떡이 더 맛있는 것 같다며 그 비결이 뭔지 알기 위해 #t4031187#을 구하고 있다고 말했다. 비결을 알아내기 전까지 계속 #t4031187#을 구한다고 하니, #t4031187#이 생기는대로 가져다 주자.
9143.name: 월묘와 함께하는 풍요로운 추석

9150.0: 찹쌀가루와 꿀 단지, 기름병을 메이플 운영자에게 모아가면 추석 음식인 유과를 만들어 준다고 한다.
9150.1:
유과의 재료인 찹쌀가루와 신선한 식용 기름이 들어있는 기름병, 달콤한 꿀이 들어있는 꿀단지를 모아오라고 하였다.

#t4031184:# #b#c4031184#/1
#k#t4031185:# #b#c4031185#/1
#k#t4031186:# #b#c4031186#/1#k
9150.2: 재료를 모아 유과를 만들 수 있었다. 유과는 한과 중 하나로 찹쌀가루를 반죽하여 튀겨낸 다음 맛있는 꿀을 바르고 다시 고물을 묻혔다. 달콤한 향이 유과에서 풍겨 나온다.
9150.name: 추석 한과(유과) 만들기

9151.0: 유과 20개를 모아 한과세트로 만들어보는 건 어떨까? 선물하기에는 안성맞춤이겠는 걸?
9151.1: 유과 20개를 모아가니 정성이 가득 담긴 한과세트로 만들어준다는데.. \n\n#k#t2022038:# #b#c2022038#/20#k
9151.2: 유과 20개를 모아 정성이 가득 담긴 한과세트로 만들었다.
9151.name: 추석 한과세트 만들기

9152.0: 마련한 한과세트를 루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 갖고 가 추석 안부를 여쭤볼까..
9152.1: 루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 추석 안부를 여쭤볼까?
9152.2: 루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 한과세트를 선물하며 추석의 풍성함을 기원했다.
9152.name: 풍요로운 한가위

9153.0: #t4031188#에 대한 연구를 하는 사람이 있다던데, 누굴까? #b#p9010000##k를 찾아가 보자.
9153.1: #p9010000#는 #b달나라#k에 살고 있는 #b#p9001104##k가 #b#t4031188##k를 구하고 있다고 말했다. 월묘가 #t2022005#라니, 무슨 일일까? #t4031188#를 가지고 달나라로 가보자.
9153.2: #p9001104#는 인간이라는 종족에 대한 근원적인 연구에 몰두중이라며, 그를 위해 인간의 전통음식인 #t2022005#를 구하고 있다고 말했다. 연구를 마치기 전까지 계속 #t4031188#를 구한다고 하니, #t4031188#가 생기는대로 가져다 주자.
9153.name: 월묘와 함께하는 풍요로운 한가위

9154.2: #p9010000#는 지진 #t4032037#와 볶은 표고버섯, 데친 도라지를 꼬치에 꿰어 맛있는 #t2022352#을 만들어 주었다.
9154.name: 추석 화양적 만들기

9156.0: #t4032040#을 굉장히 먹고 싶어하는 사람이 있다는데, 누굴까? #b#p9010000##k를 찾아가 물어보자.
9156.1: #p9010000#는 #b달나라#k에 살고 있는 #b#p9001105##k가 #b#t4032040##k를 먹고 싶어한다고 말했다. 월묘가 떡 말고 다른 것도 먹나? #t4032040#를 가지고 달나라로 가보자.
9156.2: #p9001105#는 70년동안 오직 월묘의 떡만 먹었다며 이제 떡은 지긋지긋하다고 말했다. 이젠 #t2022352#을 먹고 싶다는데... #t2022352#을 먹은 #p9001105#는, 이렇게 맛있는 건 처음이라며 계속 가져다 달라고 말했다.
9156.name: 월묘와 함께하는 풍요로운 명절

9160.0: 메이플스토리에서 추석을 맞이하여 추석에 관련된 상식 문제를 준비했다는데? 각 마을의 메이플 운영자 NPC를 만나자.
9160.2: 송편, 토란탕, 화양적은 추석의 대표 음식이라고 할 수 있다.
9160.name: 추석 상식 1. 한국의 명절 추석

9161.1: 추석 명절 음식인 송편에 대한 문제입니다.
9161.2: 송편을 찔 때 솔잎을 함께 넣으면 향도 좋을 뿐 더러 방부의 역할도 하여 음식이 쉽게 상하지 않는다.
9161.name: 추석 상식 2. 추석 명절 음식 송편

9162.2: 추석은 가윗날, 한가위, 중추절이라고 불리우기도 한다.
9162.name: 추석 상식 3. 추석의 명칭

9163.2: 명절은 계절적·자연적 정서와 제례 및 민속적 요소가 내포되어, 우리 민족이 전통적으로 지내온 축일이다.
9163.name: 추석 상식 4. 우리나라의 명절

9165.2: 추석은 가을 秋(추), 저녁, 기울 夕(석)자로 秋夕이라고 표기한다.
9165.name: 추석 상식 6. 추석의 한자 표기법

9166.1: 추석에 하는 대표적인 명절 놀이는 어떤 것일까요?
9166.2: 해마다 음력 8월 한가윗날 밤에, 곱게 단장한 부녀자들이 수십 명씩 일정한 장소에 모여 손에 손을 잡고 원형으로 늘어서서,‘강강술래’라는 후렴이 붙은 노래를 부르며 빙글빙글 돌면서 뛰노는 놀이이다.
9166.name: 추석 상식 7. 추석 명절 놀이

9167.2: 홍동백서(紅東白西)는 붉은색은 동쪽, 흰색은 서쪽에 진설하는 것이다.
9167.name: 추석 상식 8. 홍동백서

9168.1: 조상의 묘의 잡초를 제거하고 돌보는 것을 무엇이라고 하죠?
9168.2: 조상의 묘를 찾아가 잡초를 베어주는 것을 벌초라고 한다.
9168.name: 추석 상식 9. 조상의 묘

9169.1: 차례를 지낸 제사 음식을 먹는 것을 무엇이라고 할까요?
9169.2: 추석에 관련된 상식 문제를 모두 풀었다. 추석에 관련된 많은 상식을 알게 되었다.
9169.name: 추석 상식 10. 차례상

9170.0: 메이플 운영자가 커닝시티의 넬라에 대해 부탁할 것이 있는 것 같다.
9170.1: 메이플 운영자가 자신의 부탁을 들어줄 준비가 되면 다시 말을 걸어달라고 하였다.
9170.name: 넬라의 추석

9171.0: 넬라에게 추석 기분을 복돋아줄 한복을 전해주기로 하였다.
9171.1: 넬라에게 가기 위해서는 일전에 받은 커닝시티 귀환 주문서를 써 보는게 어떨까?
9171.name: 넬라의 한복

9172.0: 넬라는 추석 연휴를 한가롭게 보내기 위해서는 자신이 맡고 있는 일을 대신해 줄 사람이 필요하다고 했다. 내가 그 일을 도와줘볼까?
9172.1: 넬라의 주황버섯 퇴치를 돕기로 하였다. 자신이 거의 그 수를 채웠기 때문에 20 마리 정도만 잡아준다면 된다고 하는데...내가 잡을 수 있을까?\n\n#o1210102# #r#a91721##k
9172.name: 넬라의 일 돕기

9173.0: 넬라는 지금까지 연휴를 이렇게 즐겁게 보낸 적이 없었다고 하는데...
9173.1: 추석 연휴에 달을 보고 소원을 빌었느냐며 넬라는 자신이 소원을 빌 수 있는 달이 들어있는 보따리를 주겠다고 한다. 무엇일까? 보따리를 열어볼까? \n\n#o9500000# #r#a91731##k
9173.2: 보따리 안에는 둥그런 보름달이 들어있었다. 그 보름달에 나의 소원을 빌었다.
9173.name: 넬라의 보름달

9180.0: NPC 메이플 운영자가 내게 무슨 부탁이 있는 건 아닐까? 만나보는 것이 좋을 것 같다.
9180.1: 운영자에게서 이얀이 추석 연휴를 어떻게 보내고 있는지 인사를 가보지 않겠냐고 하는데...
9180.2: 운영자는 이얀이 추석 연휴를 즐겁게 보내길 바라는 것 같다. 더 자세한 정보를 얻기 위해 운영자에게 다시 말을 걸어보자.
9180.name: 이얀의 추석

9181.2: 페리온의 이얀이 추석에 어떻게 지내고 있는지 만나보았다.
9181.name: 이얀에게 추석 안부를..

9182.1: 이얀은 페리온 주변에 나타나 사람들을 괴롭히는 와일드보어 30마리를 퇴치해줄 것을 부탁했다. \n\n#o2230102# #r#a91821##k
9182.2: 이얀의 일을 도와 페리온 주변에 나타나는 와일드 보어를 처치하였다.
9182.name: 이얀의 일 돕기

9183.1: 이얀이 나의 소원을 위해 보름달을 보여주겠다고 한다..이건..환상일까? \n\n#o9500001# #r#a91831##k
9183.name: 이얀의 보름달

9190.0: NPC 메이플 운영자가 내게 무슨 부탁이 있는 건 아닐까? 만나보는 것이 좋을 것 같다.
9190.1: 엘마가 추석을 어떻게 보내고 있는지 찾아가볼까? 그전에 우선 메이플 운영자가 내는 문제부터 풀어보자.
9190.2: 메이플 운영자는 엘마가 추석을 어떻게 보내고 있을지 궁금하다고 했다. 더 자세한 정보를 얻기 위해 다시 메이플 운영자에게 말을 걸어보자.
9190.name: 엘마의 추석

9191.1: 엘마가 추석을 어떻게 보내고 있는지 알아보기 위해 오르비스로 찾아갔다. 그런데.. 그녀는.. 나의 강함을 시험해보고자 하는 듯 한데... \n\n#t4000058# #b#c4000058#/30#k
9191.2: 네펜데스를 처치하여 엘마에게 나의 강함을 확인시켜주었다.
9191.name: 엘마의 트집

9192.1: 엘마를 도와 루나픽시의 달조각 20개를 모아주기로 하였다. \n\n#k#t4000060:# #b#c4000060#/20#k
9192.name: 엘마의 일 돕기

9193.1: 엘마는 자신을 도와준 나에게 보름달에 소원을 빌어보라며 신기한 보따리를 주었다. \n\n#o9500002# #r#a91931##k
9193.name: 엘마의 보름달

9210.0: 리스항구, 헤네시스, 오르비스, 루디브리엄에 있는 #r#p2041017##k를 찾아가보자. 그가 사랑의 초코스틱을 만들어 주겠다는데...
9210.1:
제과사 쿠커스에게 #t4031220# 1개와 #t2020028# 1개를 갖고 가면 #t4140000#을 만들 수 있다. #t2020028#는 4군데의 잡화 상점에서 구입할 수 있다는 것 같았고.. #t4031220#는 몬스터가 가끔 떨어뜨린다는 것 같은데.. 

#t4031220# #b#c4031220##k/1
#t2020028# #b#c2020028##k/1
9210.2: #p2041017#의 비법에 따라 호신부적의 기능을 하는 사랑의 초코스틱을 만들었다. 나의 이름이 새겨진 사랑의 초코스틱을 사랑하는 이에게 선물하자.
9210.name: 사랑의 초코스틱

9220.0: 대학수학능력 시험이 끝남과 동시에 축복을 빌어주는 쿠키를 나눠주고 있다고 한다. 운영자 NPC를 만나보자.
9220.1: 엘리니아의 요정 윙이 쿠키를 나눠주고 있다는데.... 그를 만나볼까?
9220.2: 엘리니아의 요정 윙이 나눠주는 쿠키를 받았다. 이 자그마한 쿠키가 어떤 효과를??
9220.name: 수능 끝! 행복 시작!

9230.0: 대학수학능력 시험이 끝남과 동시에 축복을 빌어주는 쿠키를 나눠주고 있다고 한다. 운영자 NPC를 만나보자.
9230.1: 운영자 NPC는 루디브리엄의 마르셀님이 축복의 염원을 담은 쿠키를 나눠주고 있다고 하였다. 루디브리엄이라.. 엘리니아 정거장에서 오르비스행 배를 타고.. 그 곳에서 다시 루디브리엄으로 가는 배를 타면 된다고 했지?
9230.2: 루디브리엄의 마르셀님을 만나 쿠키를 받았다. 이 자그마한 쿠키의 효과가 궁금하다.
9230.name: 수능 끝! 행복 시작!!

9240.0: 대학수학능력 시험이 끝남과 동시에 축복을 빌어주는 쿠키를 나눠주고 있다고 한다. 운영자 NPC를 만나보자.
9240.1: 오르비스의 엘나스 마을에 있는 제이드가 쿠키를 잔뜩 준비해두고 나눠주고 있다고 한다. 엘리니아에서 오르비스 행 배를 타고 엘나스 마을로 가볼까?
9240.2: 엘나스의 벤치에 앉아있던 제이드 군이 쿠키를 나눠주었다. 이 쿠키가 어떤 축복을 내려준다는 걸까?
9240.name: 수능 끝! 행복 시작!!!

9260.0: I heard #p2002002# of Happyville has lost something very important...
9260.1: I heard #p2002002# of Happyville lost something very important, so I went to see her. I found her crying, and it turns out that... she lost her horn?!? How can you lose a horn?? She asked me to find her horn but... where can it be?\n\n#t4031063# #b#c4031063##k/1
9260.2: I found Torr's horn at the Cash Shop, and gave it back to her. She was ecstatic, to say the least. I hope she doesn't lose it anymore...
9260.name: Torr's Horn

9261.1: #m100010000#에 쓸쓸하게 웅크려 앉은 #p1012110#. 어쩐지 평소보다도 더 외로워 보이는 얼굴로 #p1012110#은 #p2001000# 할아버지에게 편지를 전달해 달라고 말했다. 크리스마스에도 혼자 저렇게 쓸쓸해 보이니 도와줘야겠다는 생각이 들기는 하는데… #b#p2001000##k는 어디 있더라? 평소에는 만나기 어려운 사람인 것 같은데…? #b#m101000000#의 #p1022101##k라면 알고 있지 않을까?
9261.2: 행복한 마을에 있는 #p2001000#에게 #b#t04031426##k를 가져다 주었다. 그는 #p1012110#의 선물을 준비해 줄 테니, 조금 후에 다시 오라고 말했다. 다행히도 이번에는 #p1012110#도 선물을 받을 수 있을 것 같다.
9261.name: 앤의 편지

9262.0: #t04031426#를 받은 #p2001000#는 뭔가 #p1012110#에게 줄 선물을 준비한 모양인데...
9262.1: #m209000000#에서 #p2001000#에게 #t04031426#를 전달하였다. 다행히도 #p2001000#는 #p1012110#을 알고 있었고, #b선물#k도 주었다. 그러니까 마을 안에 얌전히 있었어야지, 왜 항상 마을 밖에서 놀고 있는 거야, #p1012110#은? 그나저나, 이 선물을 이제 다시 #b#p1012110##k에게 가져다 주어야 하는데…
9262.2: 선물을 받은 #p1012110#은 모처럼 활짝 웃으며 기뻐했다. 그러니까 마을 안에 얌전히 있지 그랬니…

9263.0: #b#m221000000##k를 지키고 있는 #b#p2050011##k이 요새 먹고 싶은 게 있다는데…
9263.1: 언제나 딱딱한 분위기의 #m221000000#… 출동을 하고 싶지만 안 시켜준다고 투덜거리는 #p2050011#을 만났다. 임무가 지겨워서인지 #p2050011#은 빙수가 먹고 싶다고 한다. #b#m209000000##k에 맛있는 빙수를 만들 수 있는 재료가 있다고 하는데… #m209000000#까지 가는 방법은 #b#p1022101##k가 알고 있다고 한다.
9263.2: #p2001000#에게 #p2050011#의 사정을 이야기하자,  #p2001000#는 눈사람들에게서 눈뭉치를 구해다 주기로 했다. …눈사람들에게 그런 짓을 해도 되는 거야? 어쨌든 조금 있다가 가 보기로 하자.
9263.name: 케빈의 빙수 재료

9264.1: 다행히도 마음씨 좋은 #p2001000#가 #t04031428#를 공짜로 주었다. 이제 이걸 #b#p2050011##k에게 다시 가져다주면 되겠군… 평범한 눈하고 크게 다르지 않아 보이는데, 이게 정말 맛있을까?
9264.2: #p2050011#에게 #t04031428#를 가져다주었다. 이미 과일에 시럽까지 준비해놓고 기다린 #p2050011#… 도대체 임무는 언제 하는 걸까?

9265.1: #p1022101#는 크리스마스 준비에 한창인 #m209000000#의 소식을 전하며, 전 메이플 월드를 여행할 루돌프들을 위해 #b#t2120008# 1개#k만 구해 #b#p2001000# 할아버지#k에게 전해 달라고 말했다.  \n\n#t2120008# #b#c2120008##k/1

9290.1: 나룻배 위에서 한가롭게 낚시를 즐기고 있는 태공은 아내에게 가져다 줄 #t4000166#을 구하지 못했다면서 근심에 잠겨있다. 태공 대신 #b#t4000166# 20개#k를 구해서 아랫마을에 사는 태공의 부인 #b연이 할머니#k에게 전해주기로 했다.\n\n#t4000166# #b#c4000166##k/20

#t4000171# #b#c4000171##k/10
#o5100005# #r#a92911#

9320.0: 몬스터들이 출현하기 시작하면서 평화로운 메이플스토리의 세계가 흔들리기 시작했다. 메이플스토리의 평화를 위해 여행자들의 발걸음이 시작된지 그로부터 1000일이 지났다. 메이플스토리를 구하기 위해 가장 먼저 용기를 내 이 곳을 찾았던 그 영웅의 행방은?? 리스항구에서 그를 가장 처음 만났다던 #b존#k을 만나보자.
9320.1: 말이 없을 것 같던 존에게 말을 걸자 그는 "소문을 들었어요?"라는 말로 자신의 영웅을 만났던 이야기를 시작하였다. 자신에게 용기를 준 그의 행방이 궁금하다고 하였다. 그건 나도 마찬가지인 걸? 존은 그 영웅에게 만지를 소개시켜 주었다고 하였으니... 전사의 마을로 가볼까?
9320.2: 리스항구의 존이 말하던 그 영웅의 흔적을 조금은 찾은 것 같다. 만지에게 메이플스토리의 혼란이 시작된 경위를 전해듣고 지금까지 줄곧 여행을 다니며 몬스터를 퇴치하고 있다는데...
9320.name: 바람에 실려온 이야기

9321.0: 천 일전 나타난 그 영웅의 행방에 대해서 묘연하다고만 말하던... 만지는 좀 더 기억하고 있는 것이 없을까?
9321.1: 500일도 전 그 영웅이 온 몸에 상처투성이로 나타나 자신의 가방을 잃어버린 일에 대해 이야기 해주었다고 하였다. 그 가방 안에는 앞으로 그 여행자의 계획에 대해 적혀 있었다고 하는데... 와일드보어 지역을 지나오던 길에 급습한 와일드보어에게 가방을 빼앗겼다는데...
9321.2: 와일드보어에게서 되찾아온 그의 가방에는 각 종 포션들과 메이플깃발...그리고 그의 일기장이 들어있었다. 만지는 나에게 그의 일기장을 주면서 일기장에 적힌 단서를 보고 그를 찾아 떠나라고 했다.
9321.name: 그의 가방

9322.1: 가방에서 나온 일기장을 펼쳐보자 이 곳에 와서 적은 여행 기록이 적혀있다. 그의 앞으로의 계획에 대해서도 알 수 있을 것 같은데.. 일기장을 뒤져 그가 어디로 갔을지 찾아보자.
9322.2: 던전의 또 다른 문 앞에서 그윈을 만났다. 그의 이상을 이루기 위해 저토록 희생하는 모습이라니... 그윈을 도와 메이플스토리의 평화가 찾아오는 날까지.. 모험을 멈추지 말아야겠다는 생각이 들었다.
9322.name: 영웅의 행방

9323.0: 그윈이 무언가 감사의 표시를 하고 싶어하는 것 같다.
9323.1: 그윈이 감사의 표시로 내가 갖고 있던 메이플스토리 1000일 기념 깃발에 이동속도 옵션을 15로 증가시켜겠다고 하는데...

9952.1: 카산드라는 요즘 각 마을에서 일어나고 있는 이상한 일에 대해 말해주었다. 겨울이 시작되면서 마을 어딘가에 누가 만들었는지 알 수 없는 정체불명의 눈사람이 세워지고 있다고 한다. 단순히 눈사람이라면 상관없겠지만, 이 눈사람은 살아 움직이면서 마을 사람들에게 장난을 치고 있다고 하는데... 마을 사람들은 골칫거리인 눈사람을 퇴치해 주면 보상을 해주기로 약속했다면서 나에게 이 일을 해보지 않겠냐고 제안했다.\n\n#o9500319# #r#a99521##k
9952.2: 마을 사람들의 골칫거리인 거대 눈사람을 퇴치했다. 하지만 녹아서 사라지고 있는 눈사람을 보고 있자니, 눈사람은 단지 사람들과 놀고싶었던 것이 아닌지... 눈사람이 없는 겨울이 너무 쓸쓸하지는 않을까하는 생각이 들었다.

9953.0: 거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고, 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏었다. 그런데 왠지 따뜻한 느낌이 드는 이유는 뭘까?
9953.1: 거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고 바닥에 떨어진 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏어드는 순간, 행복한 마을에 있던 나뭇가지 눈사람으로부터 나뭇가지를 가지고 찾아와 달라는 전언이 왔다. 나에게 해주고 싶은 이야기가 있다고 하는데... 행복한 마을로 찾아가 봐야할 것 같다.
9953.2: 행복한 마을에 있는 나뭇가지 눈사람은 마을에 나타난 꼬마 눈사람에 대해 이야기 해줬다. 장난이 심하긴 했지만, 사람들을 좋아하던 꼬마 눈사람을 미워하지 말아달라면서 나뭇가지에 깃든 눈의 마법으로 루돌프의 뿔에 새로운 마법을 깃들게 해주었다.

Once you earn the respect and trust of all the agents, and receive #bAgent N's Receiver, Agent C's Titanium Receiver, Ultimate Agent Suit, Agent O's Leather Gloves and the Agent Cape#k, I will give you the #bUltimate Agent Shoes#k as a gift.

One day, he will appear at Nihal Desert, the next day at Orbis, and the day after that, he will be at Perion.  If you want, I can assign you to this mission.  #bSpecial Agent O and I are close friends.

You can never know where he is exactly at any given moment.  Why don't you first try going to the closest mini dungeon?  Just tell him #bAgent G sent you.

no.0: ...If you're afraid, then becoming an agent isn't for you.  And If you can't overcome those fears, those fears will always own you.

yes.0: I'm assuming you've already heard about 'Master M'?  It is very powerful... which makes it very dangerous.  Finding Master M is the most important thing.  However, it is a very difficult task.

I will tell you why I established New Leaf City.

The one condition was that I could never leave the continent.  Ever.  I agreed without hesitation.

1.0: I remember way back, when I still lived in Kerning City; I had a dream...or perhaps a nightmare.  I saw everything working in a twisted sense of order, everyone in the Maple World had a vacant look upon their face, and the sky itself had turned black.  I saw a terrifying beast, large, powerful, with endless arms.  I saw pure misery - nothing could match its strength.  It had taken over the Maple World.  I remember seeing my friends as slaves to this horrible beast, and I remember the voice which told me I could stop it.
1.1: The next thing I knew, I stood in this very spot.  Subani helped me construct the city, the spirit's light growing dimmer with each task of strength.  Finally, when the city was finished, Subani told me that I could not tell a soul of what I knew, until the time was right. I had to let things happen as if I knew nothing.  Then, Subani was gone...vowing to return when most needed.  To see you standing here before me proves that you have the strength, courage and honor to be a new hero of Masteria. The storm is still coming, but I like our chances with you around.

yes.0: So relax for the time being, you've certainly earned it.  I have a feeling our adventures here are just getting started!

0.4:
After leaving the realm of Ellinia where I began my training, and having exhausted my avenues of learning at an early age, I traveled the distant reaches of space for many years in search of new things, new ways to improve on my abilities as a magician.  Other than a few not-so-amicable run-ins with the Grays, it turns out that space is...well, mostly made of space.
Just when I had despaired of finding new frontiers to explore, I heard that Masteria had appeared off of Victoria Island, emerging from the depths of the sea!  The tales of this place had always intrigued me-this land is rumored to be where those come to find their destiny; or in other words, gain greater power.  I had heard legends of the Grandmasters of the fabled Crimsonwood Keep, how they were without peer in their chosen professions.  Exactly the sort of place I'd been looking for to extend my knowledge!  Who knew that that such a place would be on the very planet that I'd left?  And as luck would have it, one of the very things I had searched for in space has been found here!

#b#L0#What are you looking for exactly?#l
0.5: In my pursuit of power, I have become a weapons crafter by trade.  I design all kinds... from handheld armaments to star-breakers on battle cruisers.  Years ago, I came across a very rare element called #bWhite Versal Materia#k. I had only a small sample of it but even in that small amount I saw the potential of the material!  It could be used to create weapons of tremendous power!  I studied it extensively, and drew up many schematics for weapon designs.  But alas, I did not have enough of the material to actually construct any of these weapons.  I had thought that it was a material found in outer space, and truth be told, one of the primary reasons why I journeyed into the far reaches of the galaxy was to find more.  But from what I've learned, it's not even from this world!  Rather, it's from an alternate dimension of the Maple World...a world called Versal!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Whoa!#l
0.6: Imagine my amazement upon my arrival in Masteria when I began to hear that adventurers here have been finding it! Should you find any, please return it to me!  In exchange for allowing me to try out and perfect my designs, you can keep the weapon I create.  Deal?

Children from all over Maple World used to come here to see his creations and beg their parents to buy them-- and Jonas would hold lavish parties every holiday for them. Whew, it's no easy task I tell you!  I had crossed off everyone on my list except for one last name -- Elpam Gorlab!

In my shock at arriving here -- and to see one our most esteemed Versalians here in a strange new world on Versalmas! -- I almost forgot to give him his present!  Hoy, that would have been a first -- an undelivered gift! After giving Elpam his gift, which he was happy to receive, I asked him for more information about where "here" was. He told me that this place is called the "Maple World," a place I had only heard about in Versalian legend!  In these tales, it's said that the sun shines in this world everyday!  When Elpam told me that this was actually true, I almost fell over!  And you can imagine how hard that would be to do given my size! <chuckles> I never thought the legends to be true!
Even now, I can hardly believe it!  The welcome sight of an eternal sun swells my chest with happiness! At first, I was at a lost to be in a different world, but I've realized that this also makes the Maple World a perfect place for Versalmas!

#b#L0#A perfect place for Versalmas?  Um... why is that?#l#k
0.6: Because Versalmas is a celebration of the Sun!  You see, in Versal, it is perpetually dark... I believe that you have "night" here as well.  Well, it is night all the time in Versal.  But once a year, our sun comes back... for 30 glorious days straight, which we call the "30 Days of Delight"!  Versalmas Day is the first of these days, and each day after, while the sun shines, we celebrate Versalmas.  Each day of Versalmas, everyone, not just the young, receive gifts from their loved ones. So you see, because the sun shines here in the Maple World every day, why then... it's Versalmas here every day!  Hooray!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Well the gift-giving part sounds a bit like our Maplemas. Food, indeed!  Of course!  What is a holiday without food?  Food is one of the hallmarks of Versalmas tradition, and personally my favorite part!
 Whereas you people here enjoy what you call your "#bMaplemas Ham#k," we have #bSmoked Salmon#k for our traditional dinner, which sounds much more delicious to me!  I hope you get the chance to try some!  And perhaps I will try your ham as well!  There are also a host of other traditional holiday dishes, such as those tasty #bCaramel Onions#k and my favorite, #bSugar-coated Olives#k!  I am happy to say that I have a bag full of these with me which I would be happy to share! The most popular Versalmas gifts are gifts of food!
I have also heard that you decorate a tree with lights and ornamentation.  We do the same!  Only we decorate a #bCactus#k instead.  We Versalians sing many of our songs of praise to the sun as we dance around our #bVersalmas Cactus#k!  And... er, you may have noticed that Versalians are somewhat pale.  Because we're no longer used to the bright sunlight, #bSunblock#k is a popular and useful gift for this holiday as well!
It is so strange how we are from different worlds yet we have similar customs!

1.0: You have done it!  As I promised, here is the key to the Inner Sanctum.

mob.0: There are still too many warriors guarding the Keep.  I cannot, in good conscience, give you the Keystone. Return when you have decimated their ranks.

yes.0: Lightening Field? The Grandmasters would never shield the entry to their Council Hall in such an offensive manner! Perhaps someone in your time who has studied such things can provide a solution.

1.0: Well, well... looks like the pup's got some bite after all!  I see that you're tough enough to at least survive in this forest.  Looks like I might have to re-evaluate where you stand in the food chain.  Hmm.  I'll admit you've made these woods a little safer by what you've done.  And for that, you're welcome here in our camp.

item.0: I said #b50 Phantom Seeds#k.  Count 'em and you'll see you're still short.  It ain't as flashy as fighting, but last I checked, basic math was still considered a necessary life skill.

yes.0: "Bandits."  Ha!  That's a good one!

1.0: I want to thank you again for returning our map.  This gesture tells me something of who you are.  Perhaps someone to be trusted... a potential ally.  Time will tell if my faith is misplaced.
1.1: You asked me once what we were, if not bandits. <smiles> So I tell you this now: We are members of the #bRaven Ninja Clan#k, and hail from an island called the Isle of Vigilance off the northern shores of Masteria.
1.2: We Raven Ninjas trace our lineage back to the ancient Masterian guild of the #bShadowknights#k, so you could consider Crimsonwood Keep our ancestral home.  Our mission here is to discover the reason for Masteria's disappearance and its return.  It is almost certainly tied with the current events at the Keep, and what you and this Jack Barricade are pursuing.
1.3: Based on what you have told me, I have expanded our mission to include the elimination of these trespassers that now occupy Crimsonwood Keep.  <smiles>  It's what we do best.  But we will #bpay a bounty for the badges#k of those you happen to dispatch as well.  Consider yourself a contractor.  My brother #bJoko#k will handle the details so you should speak to him.

yes.0: Oh, and keep this map.  Jack may have been right to entrust you with it.  Until we meet again, friend.

#b#L0#Versalmas?!  What are you talking about, little girl?  There's no such thing as Versalmas!#l#k
#b#L1#Listen, little girl, I've got more important things to do than answer stupid kid questions.#l

0.2: No, silly!  O-Pongo is real!  He's right here in New Leaf City... go look if you don't believe me!  He's just like Maple Claws except he's big and green and a mouse and wears purple instead of red!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Ok...#l
0.3: Well, maybe he's not exactly alike, but he's the Maple Claws from his world -- the world of Versal!  O-Pongo told me all about it!  He told me about how it's usually dark but that the sun shines day after day after Versalmas comes and how all the kids dance and sing together and get special treats and candies!  It sounds very exciting--more exciting than Maplemas!  Well, maybe not more-- I do like all the presents I get from my parents on Maplemas.  But you get presents for Versalmas too!  I was already going to ask Maple Claws for a new pair of skis and other stuff, but I don't know what kind of presents since I've never had Versalmas before... so maybe Versalmas presents are even better!  But Maplemas Trees are so pretty and I love decorating them!  So-- Oh, I don't know!  Both holidays sound so good but I don't know if I'm allowed to celebrate both...\r\n<looks sad>\r\nPlease... can you... can you help me decide?  You're older than I am... you should know!  Pleaaaaase!

I'm sure you know this already but you can get to Happyville by speaking to #bRooney#k, and she'll take you there.  Then come back and tell me which holiday I should celebrate!  I've been working on my wishlist all year long and I know I'm going to get everything on it because I've been a really good girl!  Please, hurry!  I need to know who's bringing me presents this year!\r\nI can't wait to hear back from you!  Both holidays sound so great!  I can't wait to celebrate, uh--the right holiday!

My helpers and I had finally finished gathering them all when my present storehouse was broken into... and a bunch of the presents were stolen!  These were presents that were already wrapped and simply waiting for delivery!  Without these presents and with Maplemas Day so near, thousands of children in the Maple World will go without presents this year!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#That's terrible! I'd be glad to help you with that, of course!#l
0.3: Thank you, I knew you had the Maplemas spirit in you.  I know who's taken my presents: monsters.  Monsters simply have no manners, taking what's not theirs, but they love presents as much as any kid.  In a way, my heart goes out to them. <sigh> If you happen to find any presents from any bad monsters who've taken them from me, please return them to me as soon as you can.  Hmmm.  But I sense that there's another reason why you've come to see me.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, Maple Claws, a little girl named Suzy asked me to speak with you.#l
0.4: So, Suzy is having a hard time finding her Maplemas spirit this year?  I see.  Sometimes, with the hustle and bustle of everyday life, it's easy for us to forget to treat each other with simple kindnesses.  This is why the holidays are important... it's a time to let us remember the best in us and our fellow Maplers.  But something tells me there's something more to Suzy's dilemma.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, she spoke to a mouse named O-Pongo who told her about something called Versalmas. Tell her that as long as she doesn't forget that, Maple Claws will remember her and bring her presents every year.\r\nWill you tell her that?  You will?  Thank you, and a Merry Maplemas to you, too!

0.1: I'm here because it's that time of year!  It's Versalmas time again!  I'm the Versalmas Mouse so I'm here to spread Versalmas cheer!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Versalmas?  What's that?#l#k
0.2: Why, Versalmas is the most wonderful holiday in all of Versal!  How wonderful?  Why, so wonderful that everyone loves Versalmas!  Versalmas is even better than birthdays!  Why, just imagine the best birthday you've ever had... and Versalmas is a hundred times better than that!  It's the most celebrated holiday in Versal!  Well... it's actually the only holiday celebrated in Versal.  But it's still wonderful, nonetheless!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Um, so why are you here?  Shouldn't you be in Versal for that?#l#k
0.3:
As for why I'm here, it's a strange story.  As the Versalmas Mouse, I'm bound by Versalmas law to deliver a present to every Versalian, no matter how far and wide they are located in Versal.  Whew, it's no easy task I tell you!  I had crossed off everyone on my list except for one last name -- Elpam Gorlab!
I had Elpam's gift all ready to go, but I couldn't find him anywhere!  So, I asked my trusty steed, Pwnzer, to "sniff" out where he was, and take me to him, crackity-splat!

#b#L0#Er, I'm guessing Pwnzer is a reindeer?#l#k
0.4:
Reindeer?  What's that?  No, Pwnzer is an ostrich, of course!  He would be offended if you thought of him as anything but!  Anyway, I yelled "To Elpam Gorlab, Pwnzer, and away!" and lo and behold --POOF!-- I arrived beside Elpam, here by this strange tower, in a completely different world!
In my shock at arriving here -- and to see one our most esteemed Versalians here in a strange new world on Versalmas! -- I almost forgot to give him his present!  Hoy, that would have been a first -- an undelivered gift!  Elpam was just as surprised to see me here -- why, he almost fell down from his perch on that metal tower!  <chuckles> It was a pleasant surprise though, I assume!

#b#L0#I'm sure...#l#k
0.5:
After giving Elpam his gift, which he was happy to receive, I asked him for more information about where "here" was. He told me that this place is called the "Maple World," a place I had only heard about in Versalian legend!  In these tales, it's said that the sun shines in this world everyday!  When Elpam told me that this was actually true, I almost fell over!  And you can imagine how hard that would be to do given my size! <chuckles> I never thought the legends to be true!
Even now, I can hardly believe it!  The welcome sight of an eternal sun swells my chest with happiness! At first, I was at a lost to be in a different world, but I've realized that this also makes the Maple World a perfect place for Versalmas!

#b#L0#A perfect place for Versalmas?  Um... why is that?#l#k
0.6: Because Versalmas is a celebration of the Sun!  You see, in Versal, it is perpetually dark... I believe that you have "night" here as well.  Well, it is night all the time in Versal.  But once a year, our sun comes back... for 30 glorious days straight, which we call the "30 Days of Delight"!  Versalmas Day is the first of these days, and each day after, while the sun shines, we celebrate Versalmas.  Each day of Versalmas, everyone, not just the young, receive gifts from their loved ones. So you see, because the sun shines here in the Maple World every day, why then... it's Versalmas here every day!  Hooray!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Well the gift-giving part sounds a bit like our Maplemas.  Er, have you heard about Maplemas?#l#k
0.7:
That is what everyone I've met has been telling me!  It does seem that your Maplemas is very similar to our Versalmas.  This is quite exciting to me!  Perhaps we can exchange customs and gifts!

#b#L0#What are the differences?  Do you have different foods and traditions for Versalmas?#l#k
#b#L1#That seems to be the problem.  Do you remember a girl named Suzy?  She asked me to speak with you.#l#k

She told me about how she loved candy canes, and I told her in turn about our #bSugar-coated Olives#k, which are simply delicious! She seemed very excited about new types of presents and told me all about her #bWishlist#k. My, my, that girl certainly wants quite a few specific things!\r\nSo you say that she needs help to determine whether she should celebrate Versalmas this year?  Hoy, then... would you be kind enough to convey a message to her from me?

no.0: I understand that you may think our customs to be strange at first.  But I hope that in time, you will reconsider, and give new customs a chance.  Happy Versalmas!

Food, indeed!  Of course!  What is a holiday without food?  Food is one of the hallmarks of Versalmas tradition, and personally my favorite part!
 Whereas you people here enjoy what you call your "#bMaplemas Ham#k," we have #bSmoked Salmon#k for our traditional dinner, which sounds much more delicious to me!  I hope you get the chance to try some!  And perhaps I will try your ham as well!  There are also a host of other traditional holiday dishes, such as those tasty #bCaramel Onions#k and my favorite, #bSugar-coated Olives#k!  I am happy to say that I have a bag full of these with me which I would be happy to share! The most popular Versalmas gifts are gifts of food!
I have also heard that you decorate a tree with lights and ornamentation.  We do the same!  Only we decorate a #bCactus#k instead.  We Versalians sing many of our songs of praise to the sun as we dance around our #bVersalmas Cactus#k!  And... er, you may have noticed that Versalians are somewhat pale.  Because we're no longer used to the bright sunlight, #bSunblock#k is a popular and useful gift for this holiday as well!
It is so strange how we are from different worlds yet we have similar customs!

yes.0: Thank you.  I understand that she - and you, for that matter - may be used to your own traditions for the holidays.  But I think there's a place for Versalmas here in the Maple World as well. 1.0: Here is my message for the little one called Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As great as Caramel Onions and Sugar-coated Olives may be -- and certainly are! -- Versalmas is about celebrating and sharing the things that we have, and not wanting more than we need.  If Maplemas is like Versalmas, then we both believe in the gift of sharing.  I do believe that even in your world, used to the traditions of Maplemas, there is room for Versalmas as well.\r\nThank you for giving her my message.  I certainly hope Suzy -- and you! -- choose to celebrate Versalmas with me this year!  Happy Versalmas to you, and may your days be bright!
